name: SRGInequality.srg_parameter_identity
statement:
lemma srg_parameter_identity (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hv : 0 < v) :
    k * (k - lambda - 1) = (v - k - 1) * mu
proof:
:=
  h.param_eq G hv

name: SRGInequality.principal_eigenvector
statement:
lemma principal_eigenvector (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) :
    Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) (Function.const V 1) =
      Function.const V (k : Real)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  calc
    _ = (k : Real) * 1 :=
      G.adjMatrix_mulVec_const_apply_of_regular (α := Real) h.regular
    _ = _ := by simp

name: SRGInequality.complete_multipartite_srg_mu_eq_degree
statement:
lemma complete_multipartite_srg_mu_eq_degree
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hcmp : G.IsCompleteMultipartite)
    (hne : Not (G = (⊤ : SimpleGraph V))) :
    mu = k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hnadj⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
  have hcommon : G.commonNeighbors a b = G.neighborSet a := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact hz.1
    · intro haz
      have hzb : G.Adj z b := by
        by_contra hzb
        have hby : ¬ G.Adj b z := by
          simpa [adj_comm] using hzb
        have hnaz : ¬ G.Adj a z := hcmp.trans a b z hnadj hby
        exact (hnaz haz).elim
      exact ⟨haz, (G.mem_neighborSet b z).2 hzb.symm⟩
  have hc := h.of_not_adj hab hnadj
  have hc' : Fintype.card (G.neighborSet a) = mu := by
    simpa only [hcommon] using hc
  rw [G.card_neighborSet_eq_degree, h.regular.degree_eq] at hc'
  exact hc'.symm

name: SRGInequality.disconnected_srg_mu_zero
statement:
lemma disconnected_srg_mu_zero
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hV : Nonempty V)
    (hconn : Not G.Connected) :
    mu = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := hV
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : V, ¬ G.Reachable x y := by
    by_contra hn
    apply hconn
    rw [connected_iff_exists_forall_reachable]
    exact ⟨x, by
      intro z
      by_contra hz
      exact hn ⟨z, hz⟩⟩
  have hxy : x ≠ y := by
    intro hxy
    apply hy
    simpa [hxy]
  have hna : ¬ G.Adj x y := by
    intro hadj
    exact hy hadj.reachable
  have hcard := h.of_not_adj hxy hna
  have hempty : G.commonNeighbors x y = (∅ : Set V) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · intro hz
      exact False.elim (hy (hz.1.reachable.trans hz.2.symm.reachable))
    · intro hz
      simpa using hz
  have hzero : Fintype.card (G.commonNeighbors x y) = 0 := by
    simpa [hempty]
  omega

name: SRGInequality.disconnected_srg_is_complete_multipartite
statement:
lemma disconnected_srg_is_complete_multipartite
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hV : Nonempty V)
    (hconn : Not G.Connected) :
    (Gᶜ).IsCompleteMultipartite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmu : mu = 0 := disconnected_srg_mu_zero h hV hconn
  unfold SimpleGraph.IsCompleteMultipartite
  constructor
  intro u v w huv hvw
  simp only [compl_adj, not_and_or, not_not] at huv hvw ⊢
  rcases huv with rfl | huv
  · exact hvw
  rcases hvw with rfl | hvw
  · exact Or.inr huv
  by_cases huw : u = w
  · exact Or.inl huw
  right
  by_contra hnuw
  have hcard := h.of_not_adj huw hnuw
  have hz : v ∈ G.commonNeighbors u w := ⟨huv, hvw.symm⟩
  have hzero : Fintype.card (G.commonNeighbors u w) = 0 := by
    rw [hmu] at hcard
    exact hcard
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card (G.commonNeighbors u w) := by
    exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨v, hz⟩
  omega

name: SRGInequality.nonprimitive_srg_is_complete_multipartite
statement:
lemma nonprimitive_srg_is_complete_multipartite
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {G : SimpleGraph V} [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected)
    (hnp : Not (PrimitiveSRG G)) :
    G.IsCompleteMultipartite
proof:
:= by
  have hnc : Not (Gᶜ).Connected := by
    intro hcc
    exact hnp ⟨hc, hcc⟩
  simpa using disconnected_srg_is_complete_multipartite h.compl hc.nonempty hnc

name: SRGInequality.integer_of_rational_quadratic_root
statement:
lemma integer_of_rational_quadratic_root
    {q : Rat} {a b : Int}
    (h : q ^ 2 + (a : Rat) * q + (b : Rat) = 0) :
    Exists (fun z : Int => q = (z : Rat))
proof:
:= by
  let p : Polynomial Int := X ^ 2 + (C a * X + C b)
  have hp : p.Monic := by
    dsimp [p]
    apply monic_X_pow_add
    have hmax : LE.le (max (C a * X).degree (C b).degree) 1 :=
      max_le (degree_C_mul_X_le _) (le_trans degree_C_le (by norm_num))
    have hdeg : LE.le (C a * X + C b).degree 1 :=
      le_trans (degree_add_le _ _) hmax
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hdeg (by norm_num)
  have hr : aeval q p = 0 := by
    dsimp [p]
    simp only [aeval_def, eval₂_add, eval₂_mul, eval₂_X_pow, eval₂_C]
    simpa [pow_two, add_assoc, add_left_comm, add_comm, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
      mul_assoc] using h
  have hres : Exists (fun z : Int => And (q = (z : Rat))
      (Dvd.dvd z (p.coeff 0))) :=
    exists_integer_of_is_root_of_monic hp hr
  let z : Int := Classical.choose hres
  have hz : q = (z : Rat) := (Classical.choose_spec hres).1
  exact Exists.intro z hz

name: SRGInequality.restrictedPos_rational_of_unequal_multiplicities
statement:
lemma restrictedPos_rational_of_unequal_multiplicities
    {r s : Real} {k lambda mu f g : Nat}
    (hfg : Not (f = g))
    (hsum : r + s = (lambda : Real) - mu)
    (htrace : (k : Real) + (f : Real) * r + (g : Real) * s = 0) :
    Exists (fun q : Rat => (q : Real) = r)
proof:
:= by
  let kr : Rat := k
  let lr : Rat := lambda
  let mr : Rat := mu
  let fr : Rat := f
  let gr : Rat := g
  let q : Rat := (-kr - gr * (lr - mr)) / (fr - gr)
  have hdenR : Not ((f : Real) - (g : Real) = 0) := by
    intro hz
    apply hfg
    exact_mod_cast sub_eq_zero.mp hz
  have hr : r = (-(k : Real) - (g : Real) * ((lambda : Real) - mu)) /
      ((f : Real) - (g : Real)) := by
    field_simp [hdenR]
    nlinarith [hsum, htrace]
  refine Exists.intro q ?_
  dsimp [q, kr, lr, mr, fr, gr]
  rw [hr]
  simp only [Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_sub, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_neg,
    Rat.cast_natCast]

name: SRGInequality.integer_real_root_of_rational_root
statement:
lemma integer_real_root_of_rational_root
    {r : Real} {a b : Int}
    (hpoly : r ^ 2 + (a : Real) * r + (b : Real) = 0)
    (hrat : Exists (fun q : Rat => (q : Real) = r)) :
    Exists (fun z : Int => (z : Real) = r)
proof:
:= by
  let q : Rat := Classical.choose hrat
  have hqr : (q : Real) = r := Classical.choose_spec hrat
  have hpolyR : (q : Real) ^ 2 + (a : Real) * (q : Real) + (b : Real) = 0 := by
    simpa [hqr] using hpoly
  have hpolyQ : q ^ 2 + (a : Rat) * q + (b : Rat) = 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hpolyR
  have hzq := integer_of_rational_quadratic_root hpolyQ
  let z : Int := Classical.choose hzq
  have hzq' : q = (z : Rat) := Classical.choose_spec hzq
  refine Exists.intro z ?_
  rw [hqr.symm, hzq']
  norm_num

name: SRGInequality.srg_restrictedPos_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities
statement:
lemma srg_restrictedPos_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)) :
    Exists (fun z : Int => (z : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨_, htrace, _, hsum, _⟩
  have hrat := restrictedPos_rational_of_unequal_multiplicities
    (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (s := restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (k := k) (lambda := lambda) (mu := mu)
    (f := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
    (g := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
    hfg hsum htrace
  have hroot := restrictedPos_is_root (k := k) (lambda := lambda) (mu := mu)
    (spectral_discriminant_nonneg_of_ne_complete G h hne)
  have hpoly : (restrictedPos k lambda mu) ^ 2 +
      ((mu : Real) - lambda) * restrictedPos k lambda mu +
      ((mu : Real) - k) = 0 := by
    nlinarith [hroot]
  have hpoly' : (restrictedPos k lambda mu) ^ 2 +
      (((mu : Int) - (lambda : Int) : Int) : Real) * restrictedPos k lambda mu +
      (((mu : Int) - (k : Int) : Int) : Real) = 0 := by
    norm_num
    exact hpoly
  exact integer_real_root_of_rational_root hpoly' hrat

name: SRGInequality.srg_restrictedNeg_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities
statement:
lemma srg_restrictedNeg_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)) :
    Exists (fun z : Int => (z : Real) = restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  rcases srg_restrictedPos_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg with ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨_, _, _, hsum, _⟩
  refine ⟨(lambda : Int) - (mu : Int) - z, ?_⟩
  have hz' : (z : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu := hz
  norm_num at *
  linarith [hsum]

name: SRGInequality.srg_restrictedNeg_gap_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities
statement:
lemma srg_restrictedNeg_gap_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)) :
    Exists (fun z : Int => (z : Real) = -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  rcases srg_restrictedNeg_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg with ⟨z, hz⟩
  refine ⟨-z, ?_⟩
  rw [Int.cast_neg]
  linarith

name: SRGInequality.srg_integer_gap_at_least_two_of_unequal_multiplicities
statement:
lemma srg_integer_gap_at_least_two_of_unequal_multiplicities
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu) :
    Exists (fun z : Int => 2 ≤ z ∧ (z : Real) = -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨_, _, _, hsum, hprod⟩
  have hmu := mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hmuR : (0 : Real) < mu := by exact_mod_cast hmu
  have hmu_le : (mu : Real) ≤ k := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_le_degree_of_ne_complete G h hne
  have hsnonpos : restrictedNeg k lambda mu ≤ 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hspos : 0 < restrictedNeg k lambda mu := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hprodpos : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu :=
      mul_pos hr hspos
    nlinarith [hprod, hmu_le]
  have hsneg : restrictedNeg k lambda mu < 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hsz : restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0 := le_antisymm hsnonpos (le_of_not_gt hn)
    have hkm : (k : Real) = mu := by nlinarith [hprod]
    have hlam_lt : (lambda : Real) < mu := by
      have hlam := lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
      nlinarith [hkm, hlam]
    nlinarith [hsum, hsz, hr, hlam_lt]
  rcases srg_restrictedNeg_gap_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg with ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hzpos : (0 : Real) < z := by rw [hz]; linarith
  have hz_ne_one : z ≠ 1 := by
    intro hz1
    have hsminus : restrictedNeg k lambda mu = -1 := by
      have hz1R : (z : Real) = 1 := by norm_num [hz1]
      nlinarith [hz, hz1R]
    exact srg_restrictedNeg_ne_neg_one G h hc hne hsminus
  have hzge : 2 ≤ z := by
    have hzint : (0 : Int) < z := by exact_mod_cast hzpos
    omega
  exact ⟨z, hzge, hz⟩

name: SRGInequality.srg_restrictedPos_zero_implies_mu_eq_degree
statement:
lemma srg_restrictedPos_zero_implies_mu_eq_degree
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr0 : restrictedPos k lambda mu = 0) :
    mu = k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨_, _, _, _, hprod⟩
  have hmuR : (mu : Real) = k := by
    nlinarith [hprod, hr0]
  exact_mod_cast hmuR

name: SRGInequality.srg_unequal_multiplicity_integer_classification
statement:
lemma srg_unequal_multiplicity_integer_classification
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu) :
    Exists (fun z : Int => 2 ≤ z ∧ (z : Real) = -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  exact srg_integer_gap_at_least_two_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg hr

name: SRGInequality.srg_restrictedPos_nonnegative
statement:
lemma srg_restrictedPos_nonnegative
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤)) :
    0 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨_, _, _, _, hprod⟩
  have hmu_le : (mu : Real) ≤ k := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_le_degree_of_ne_complete G h hne
  have hgap := restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  by_contra hn
  have hrneg : restrictedPos k lambda mu < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hn
  have hsneg : restrictedNeg k lambda mu < 0 := by linarith
  have hprodpos : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu :=
    mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hrneg hsneg
  nlinarith [hprod, hmu_le, hprodpos]

name: SRGInequality.srg_restrictedPos_zero_or_positive
statement:
lemma srg_restrictedPos_zero_or_positive
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤)) :
    restrictedPos k lambda mu = 0 ∨ 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hzero : restrictedPos k lambda mu = 0
  · exact Or.inl hzero
  · exact Or.inr (lt_of_le_of_ne
      (srg_restrictedPos_nonnegative G h hc hne) (Ne.symm hzero))

name: SRGInequality.int_ge_two_cases
statement:
lemma int_ge_two_cases {z : Int} (hz : 2 ≤ z) :
    z = 2 ∨ z = 3 ∨ 4 ≤ z
proof: := by omega

name: SRGInequality.srg_integer_gap_three_way_split
statement:
lemma srg_integer_gap_three_way_split
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu) :
    Exists (fun z : Int =>
      (z : Real) = -restrictedNeg k lambda mu ∧
      (z = 2 ∨ z = 3 ∨ 4 ≤ z))
proof:
:= by
  rcases srg_integer_gap_at_least_two_of_unequal_multiplicities
      G h hc hne hfg hr with ⟨z, hz, hzt⟩
  exact ⟨z, hzt, int_ge_two_cases hz⟩

name: SRGInequality.target_of_integer_case_certificate
statement:
theorem target_of_integer_case_certificate
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hcase :
      Or
        (And (t = 2) (And (r ≤ 7) (mu ≤ r + 4)))
        (Or
          (And (t = 3) (And (13 ≤ r)
            (And (r ≤ 34) (mu ≤ 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)))))
          (Or
            (And (2 ≤ t) (0 ≤ discriminantC2 r t))
            (Or
              (And (4 ≤ t) (And (discriminantC2 r t < 0)
                (And (KreinBound k r t)
                  (And (k = r * t + mu) (qGeneral r t ≤ 0)))))
              (And (4 ≤ t) (StrictAbsoluteCertificate r t mu)))))) :
    v * k / t ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcase with h2 | hrest
  · rcases h2 with ⟨t2, hr7, hmuL⟩
    subst t
    simpa using target_of_t2_small hr hr7 hmu hmuL hv (by simpa using hgap)
  · rcases hrest with h3 | hrest
    · rcases h3 with ⟨t3, hr13, hr34, hmuK⟩
      subst t
      simpa using target_of_t3_mid hr13 hr34 hmu hmuK hv (by simpa using hgap)
    · rcases hrest with hc2 | hrest
      · exact target_of_c2_nonneg hr hc2.1 hmu hc2.2 hv hgap (by linarith)
      · rcases hrest with hq | hstrict
        · rcases hq with ⟨t4, hc2, hK, hk, hQ⟩
          exact target_of_general_Q_nonpos hr t4 hmu hc2 hK hk hQ hv hgap
        · rcases hstrict with ⟨t4, hs⟩
          have htpos : 0 < t := by linarith
          exact target_of_strict_absolute_case hr htpos hmu hv hgap
            hs.hc2 hs.hc0 hs.hdisc hs.hzero hs.hrootcount hs.hA0 hs.hAplus
            hs.hstrict hs.hAK hs.hcases hs.hN

name: SRGInequality.srg_integer_restricted_spectrum
statement:
theorem srg_integer_restricted_spectrum
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)) :
    And
      (Exists (fun z : Int => (z : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu))
      (Exists (fun z : Int => (z : Real) = -restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact srg_restrictedPos_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg
  · exact srg_restrictedNeg_gap_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_complete_multipartite_parameters
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_complete_multipartite_parameters
    {v k s g : Real} {m n : Real}
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hv : v = m * n)
    (hk : k = m * (n - 1))
    (hs : s = -m)
    (hg : g = n - 1) :
    v * k / s ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hv, hk, hs, hg]
  exact complete_multipartite_branch_target hm hn

name: SRGInequality.equal_multiplicity_linear_relation_real
statement:
lemma equal_multiplicity_linear_relation_real
    {v k f r s lambda mu : Real}
    (hpart : v = 1 + f + f)
    (htrace : k + f * r + f * s = 0)
    (hsum : r + s = lambda - mu) :
    2 * k = (v - 1) * (mu - lambda)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul := congrArg (fun x : Real => f * x) hsum
  ring_nf at hmul htrace
  have hkrel : k = f * (mu - lambda) := by
    nlinarith [hmul, htrace]
  rw [hpart]
  ring_nf
  nlinarith [hkrel]

name: SRGInequality.srg_equal_multiplicity_linear_relation
statement:
theorem srg_equal_multiplicity_linear_relation
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu) :
    2 * (k : Real) =
      ((v : Real) - 1) * ((mu : Real) - lambda)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨art, htrace, _, hsum, _⟩
  have hpartR : (v : Real) = 1 +
      (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast art
  have hfgR : (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) =
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfg
  apply equal_multiplicity_linear_relation_real
    (f := (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real))
    (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (s := restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (v := (v : Real)) (k := (k : Real))
    (lambda := (lambda : Real)) (mu := (mu : Real))
  · nlinarith [hpartR, hfgR]
  · have hmulS := congrArg
      (fun x : Real => x * restrictedNeg k lambda mu) hfgR
    nlinarith [htrace, hmulS]
  · exact hsum

name: SRGInequality.conference_mu_parameter_reduction
statement:
lemma conference_mu_parameter_reduction
    {v k lambda mu : Real}
    (hkpos : 0 < k)
    (hparam : k * (k - lambda - 1) = (v - k - 1) * mu)
    (hrel : mu - lambda = 1)
    (hk : 2 * k = v - 1) :
    4 * mu = v - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hvk : v - k - 1 = k := by linarith
  have hlam : lambda = mu - 1 := by linarith
  rw [hvk, hlam] at hparam
  nlinarith [hparam]

name: SRGInequality.conference_sqrt_witness
statement:
lemma conference_sqrt_witness
    {v k _mu : Real}
    (hkpos : 0 < k)
    (hk : 2 * k = v - 1) :
    Exists (fun w : Real => 1 < w ∧ w ^ 2 = v)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : 1 < v := by linarith
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := le_of_lt (lt_trans (by norm_num) hv)
  let w : Real := Real.sqrt v
  have hwsq : w ^ 2 = v := by
    dsimp [w]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt hv0
  have hwpos : 0 < w := by
    dsimp [w]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by linarith)
  have hw1 : 1 < w := by
    nlinarith [hwsq, hv, hwpos]
  exact ⟨w, hw1, hwsq⟩

name: SRGInequality.nat_cast_sub_sub_real
statement:
lemma nat_cast_sub_sub_real
    {k lambda : Nat} (h : lambda + 1 ≤ k) :
    ((k - lambda - 1 : Nat) : Real) =
      (k : Real) - lambda - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlam : lambda ≤ k := by omega
  have hone : 1 ≤ k - lambda := by omega
  norm_num [Nat.cast_sub hlam, Nat.cast_sub hone]

name: SRGInequality.conference_spectralDelta_eq_w
statement:
lemma conference_spectralDelta_eq_w
    {k lambda mu v w : Real}
    (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (hv : w ^ 2 = v)
    (hrel : lambda - mu = -1)
    (hk : 2 * k = v - 1)
    (hmu : 4 * mu = v - 1) :
    Real.sqrt ((lambda - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * (k - mu)) = w
proof:
:= by
  have harg : (lambda - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * (k - mu) = w ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hv, hrel, hk, hmu]
  rw [harg]
  exact (Real.sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq (sq_nonneg w) hw).2 rfl

name: SRGInequality.conference_restricted_root_formulas
statement:
lemma conference_restricted_root_formulas
    {k lambda mu v w : Real}
    (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (hv : w ^ 2 = v)
    (hrel : lambda - mu = -1)
    (hk : 2 * k = v - 1)
    (hmu : 4 * mu = v - 1) :
    (((lambda - mu) + Real.sqrt ((lambda - mu) ^ 2 +
      4 * (k - mu))) / 2 = (-1 + w) / 2) ∧   (((lambda - mu) - Real.sqrt ((lambda - mu) ^ 2 +
      4 * (k - mu))) / 2 = (-1 - w) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := conference_spectralDelta_eq_w hw hv hrel hk hmu
  rw [hrel] at hD
  constructor <;> rw [hrel, hD]

name: SRGInequality.conference_restrictedNeg_eq
statement:
lemma conference_restrictedNeg_eq
    {k lambda mu : Nat} {v w : Real}
    (hw : 0 ≤ w)
    (hv : w ^ 2 = v)
    (hrel : (lambda : Real) - mu = -1)
    (hk : 2 * (k : Real) = v - 1)
    (hmu : 4 * (mu : Real) = v - 1) :
    restrictedNeg k lambda mu = (-1 - w) / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold restrictedNeg spectralDelta
  exact (conference_restricted_root_formulas
    (k := (k : Real)) (lambda := (lambda : Real))
    (mu := (mu : Real)) hw hv hrel hk hmu).2

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_conference_certificate
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_conference_certificate
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
    {w : Real} (hw : 1 < w)
    (hv : w ^ 2 = (v : Real))
    (hrel : (lambda : Real) - mu = -1)
    (hk : 2 * (k : Real) = (v : Real) - 1)
    (hmu : 4 * (mu : Real) = (v : Real) - 1) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨art, _, _, _, _⟩
  have hpartR : (v : Real) = 1 +
      (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
    exact art
  have hfgR : (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) =
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast hfg
  have hg : (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) =
      ((v : Real) - 1) / 2 := by
    nlinarith [hpartR, hfgR]
  have hk' : (k : Real) = ((v : Real) - 1) / 2 := by
    nlinarith [hk]
  have hw0 : 0 ≤ w := by linarith
  have hsneg := conference_restrictedNeg_eq
    (k := k) (lambda := lambda) (mu := mu) (v := (v : Real))
    (w := w) hw0 hv hrel hk hmu
  have hs' : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = (1 + w) / 2 := by
    nlinarith [hsneg]
  rw [hk', hs', hg]
  convert conference_branch_target hw using 1
  · rw [hv]
    ring
  · rw [← hv]

name: SRGInequality.srg_integer_gap_three_way_real
statement:
theorem srg_integer_gap_three_way_real
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected) (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu) :
    (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 2) ∨
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3) ∨
      (4 ≤ -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  rcases srg_integer_gap_three_way_split G h hc hne hfg hr with ⟨z, hzEq, hzCases⟩
  rcases hzCases with rfl | rfl | hz4
  · left
    norm_num at hzEq
    linarith
  · right; left
    norm_num at hzEq
    linarith
  · right; right
    nlinarith [hzEq, (show (4 : Real) ≤ (z : Real) by exact_mod_cast hz4)]

name: SRGInequality.conference_integer_parameter_reduction
statement:
lemma conference_integer_parameter_reduction
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (hkpos : 0 < (k : Real))
    (hkv : (k : Real) < (v : Real) - 1)
    (heq : 2 * (k : Real) =
      ((v : Real) - 1) * ((mu : Real) - lambda)) :
    (mu : Real) - lambda = 1 ∧
      2 * (k : Real) = (v : Real) - 1
proof:
:= by
  have hv1 : 0 < (v : Real) - 1 := by linarith
  have htwok : 0 < 2 * (k : Real) := by linarith
  have htwok_lt : 2 * (k : Real) < 2 * ((v : Real) - 1) := by linarith
  have hdpos : 0 < (mu : Real) - lambda := by
    rw [heq] at htwok
    nlinarith
  have hdlt : (mu : Real) - lambda < 2 := by
    rw [heq] at htwok_lt
    nlinarith
  have hdint : Exists (fun z : Int => (z : Real) = (mu : Real) - lambda) := by
    refine ⟨(mu : Int) - (lambda : Int), ?_⟩
    norm_num
  rcases hdint with ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hzposR : (0 : Real) < (z : Real) := by simpa [hz] using hdpos
  have hzpos : (0 : Int) < z := by exact_mod_cast hzposR
  have hzltR : (z : Real) < 2 := by simpa [hz] using hdlt
  have hzlt : z < 2 := by exact_mod_cast hzltR
  have hz1 : z = 1 := by omega
  have hdiff : (mu : Real) - lambda = 1 := by
    calc
      (mu : Real) - lambda = (z : Real) := hz.symm
      _ = 1 := by simp [hz1]
  constructor
  · exact hdiff
  · rw [hdiff] at heq
    nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.srg_conference_parameter_certificate
statement:
theorem srg_conference_parameter_certificate
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hfg : positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
    (hkpos : 0 < (k : Real))
    (hkv : (k : Real) < (v : Real) - 1)
    (hlk : lambda + 1 ≤ k) :
    Exists (fun w : Real =>
      1 < w ∧ w ^ 2 = (v : Real) ∧
        ((lambda : Real) - mu = -1) ∧
          (2 * (k : Real) = (v : Real) - 1) ∧
            (4 * (mu : Real) = (v : Real) - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : 2 * (k : Real) =
      ((v : Real) - 1) * ((mu : Real) - lambda) :=
    @srg_equal_multiplicity_linear_relation V _ _ G _ v k lambda mu h hc hne hfg
  have hred := conference_integer_parameter_reduction hkpos hkv hlin
  have hvk1 : k + 1 ≤v := by
    have hkvNat : k < v := by
      exact_mod_cast (show (k : Real) < v by linarith [hkv])
    omega
  have hvpos : 0 < (v : Real) := by linarith [hkv]
  have hvNat : 0 < v := by exact_mod_cast hvpos
  have hparamN := srg_parameter_identity G h hvNat
  have hparamCast :
      ((k * (k - lambda - 1) : Nat) : Real) =
        (((v - k - 1) * mu : Nat) : Real) := by
     exact_mod_cast hparamN
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul,
    nat_cast_sub_sub_real hlk, nat_cast_sub_sub_real hvk1] at hparamCast
  have hmu : 4 * (mu : Real) = (v : Real) - 1 :=
    conference_mu_parameter_reduction hkpos hparamCast hred.1 hred.2
  rcases conference_sqrt_witness (_mu := (mu : Real)) hkpos hred.2 with ⟨w, hw, hwv⟩
  exact ⟨w, hw, hwv, by nlinarith [hred.1], hred.2, hmu⟩

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_classified_spectrum
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_classified_spectrum
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hclass :
      Or
        (Exists (fun m : Real => Exists (fun n : Real =>
          2 ≤ m ∧ 2 ≤ n ∧ v = m * n ∧ k = m * (n - 1) ∧
            -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = -m ∧
            (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) = n - 1)))
        (Or
          (ArithmeticCase (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
            (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) (k : Real))
          ((-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 *
            (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
            ((positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) + 1) -
            (v : Real) * k = 0))) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hclass with hmulti | hrest
  · rcases hmulti with ⟨m, n, hm, hn, hv, hk, hs, hg⟩
    exact srg_target_of_complete_multipartite_parameters hm hn hv hk hs hg
  · exact srg_target_of_verified_cases_or_gap_zero G h hc hne ht0 hr hrest

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_integer_case_certificate_graph
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_integer_case_certificate_graph
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hcase :
      Or
        (And (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 2)
          (And (restrictedPos k lambda mu <= 7)
            ((mu : Real) <= restrictedPos k lambda mu + 4)))
        (Or
          (And (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3)
            (And (13 <= restrictedPos k lambda mu)
              (And (restrictedPos k lambda mu <= 34)
                ((mu : Real) <= 2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu *
                  (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
                  (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3)))))
          (Or
            (And (2 <= -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
              (0 <= discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
                (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)))
            (Or
              (And (4 <= -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
                (And (discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
                    (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0)
                  (And (KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
                      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
                    (And ((k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu *
                        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) + (mu : Real))
                      (qGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
                        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) <= 0)))))
              (And (4 <= -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
                (StrictAbsoluteCertificate (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
                  (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))))))) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 <=
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨part, _, _, _, _⟩
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast part
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - (v : Real) * k =
      discriminantPoly r t (mu : Real) * auxiliaryPoly r t (mu : Real) /
        ((mu : Real) ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2) := by
    dsimp [r, t, f, g]
    exact srg_gap_factorization G h hc hne ht0
  have htpos : 0 < t := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact neg_pos.mpr (by
        have hp := (srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne).2.2.2.2
        have hprod : restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu = (mu : Real) - k := hp
        have hmu_le : (mu : Real) <= (k : Real) := by
          exact_mod_cast mu_le_degree_of_ne_complete G h hne
        have hnonneg : 0 <= restrictedPos k lambda mu * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := by
          nlinarith [hprod, hmu_le]
        have hneprod : Not (restrictedPos k lambda mu * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) = 0) := by
          intro hz
          apply ht0
          nlinarith [hz, hr]
        have hmul : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne hnonneg (Ne.symm hneprod)
        exact (mul_pos_iff.mp hmul).elim
          (fun hh => by linarith [hh.2]) (fun hh => by linarith [hr, hh.1]))
  have hcase' :
      Or
        (And (t = 2) (And (r ≤ 7) ((mu : Real) ≤ r + 4)))
        (Or
          (And (t = 3) (And (13 ≤ r)
            (And (r ≤ 34) ((mu : Real) ≤ 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)))))
          (Or
            (And (2 ≤ t) (0 ≤ discriminantC2 r t))
            (Or
              (And (4 ≤ t) (And (discriminantC2 r t < 0)
                (And (KreinBound (k : Real) r t)
                  (And ((k : Real) = r * t + (mu : Real))
                    (qGeneral r t ≤ 0)))))
              (And (4 ≤ t) (StrictAbsoluteCertificate r t (mu : Real)))))) := by
    simpa [r, t] using hcase
  have hout := target_of_integer_case_certificate
    (r := r) (t := t) (mu := (mu : Real)) (k := (k : Real))
    (f := f) (g := g) (v := (v : Real))
    (by simpa [r] using hr) htpos hmu hv hgap hcase'
  simpa [r, t, f, g] using hout

name: SRGInequality.srg_absolute_case_or_strict
statement:
theorem srg_absolute_case_or_strict
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (ht : 0 < -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    Or
      (absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) = 0)
      (0 < absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg := srg_absolutePolyGeneral_nonneg G h hc hne hr ht hA
  by_cases hzero : absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) = 0
  · exact Or.inl hzero
  · exact Or.inr (lt_of_le_of_ne hnonneg (Ne.symm hzero))

name: SRGInequality.count_three_positive_roots
statement:
lemma count_three_positive_roots
    {P : Polynomial Real} {x y z : Real}
    (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (hx : P.eval x = 0) (hy : P.eval y = 0) (hz : P.eval z = 0)
    (hxp : 0 < x) (hyp : 0 < y) (hzp : 0 < z)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z) :
    3 ≤ P.roots.countP (fun u : Real => 0 < u)
proof:
:= by
  have hxm : x ∈ P.roots :=
    (P.mem_roots hP).2 (by simpa [Polynomial.IsRoot] using hx)
  have hym : y ∈ P.roots :=
    (P.mem_roots hP).2 (by simpa [Polynomial.IsRoot] using hy)
  have hzm : z ∈ P.roots :=
    (P.mem_roots hP).2 (by simpa [Polynomial.IsRoot] using hz)
  have hcx : 1 ≤ P.roots.count x :=
    (Nat.succ_le_iff).2 (Multiset.count_pos.mpr hxm)
  have hcy : 1 ≤ P.roots.count y :=
    (Nat.succ_le_iff).2 (Multiset.count_pos.mpr hym)
  have hcz : 1 ≤ P.roots.count z :=
    (Nat.succ_le_iff).2 (Multiset.count_pos.mpr hzm)
  have hle : (x ::ₘ y ::ₘ z ::ₘ 0 : Multiset Real) ≤ P.roots := by
    rw [Multiset.le_iff_count]
    intro a
    by_cases hax : a = x
    · subst a
      simp only [Multiset.count_cons, Multiset.count_zero, if_pos]
      rw [if_neg hxy, if_neg hxz]
      exact hcx
    by_cases hay : a = y
    · subst a
      simp only [Multiset.count_cons, Multiset.count_zero, if_pos]
      rw [if_neg hxy.symm, if_neg hyz]
      exact hcy
    by_cases haz : a = z
    · subst a
      simp only [Multiset.count_cons, Multiset.count_zero, if_pos]
      rw [if_neg hxz.symm, if_neg hyz.symm]
      exact hcz
    simp [hax, hay, haz]
  have hc := Multiset.countP_le_of_le
    (p := fun u : Real => 0 < u) hle
  have hs : Multiset.countP (fun u : Real => 0 < u)
      (x ::ₘ y ::ₘ z ::ₘ 0 : Multiset Real) = 3 := by
    rw [Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos (y ::ₘ z ::ₘ 0) hxp,
      Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos (z ::ₘ 0) hyp,
      Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos (0 : Multiset Real) hzp]
    norm_num
  rw [hs] at hc
  exact hc

name: SRGInequality.exists_root_between_of_sign
statement:
lemma exists_root_between_of_sign
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a b : Real}
    (hab : a < b) (ha : 0 < P.eval a) (hb : P.eval b < 0) :
    ∃ x, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ P.eval x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have him := intermediate_value_Ioo' (le_of_lt hab)
    P.continuous.continuousOn
  have hz : (0 : Real) ∈ Set.Ioo (P.eval b) (P.eval a) := ⟨hb, ha⟩
  rcases him hz with ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx.1, hx.2, hxe⟩

name: SRGInequality.exists_root_between_of_sign_rev
statement:
lemma exists_root_between_of_sign_rev
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a b : Real}
    (hab : a < b) (ha : P.eval a < 0) (hb : 0 < P.eval b) :
    ∃ x, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ P.eval x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have him := intermediate_value_Ioo (le_of_lt hab)
    P.continuous.continuousOn
  have hz : (0 : Real) ∈ Set.Ioo (P.eval a) (P.eval b) := ⟨ha, hb⟩
  rcases him hz with ⟨x, hx, hxe⟩
  exact ⟨x, hx.1, hx.2, hxe⟩

name: SRGInequality.three_pos_roots_of_signs
statement:
lemma three_pos_roots_of_signs
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a b c d : Real}
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (hc0 : 0 < c)
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c < d)
    (ha : 0 < P.eval a) (hb : P.eval b < 0)
    (hc : P.eval c = 0) (hd : P.eval d < 0)
    (he : ∃ e, d < e ∧ 0 < P.eval e) :
    ∃ x y z, 0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z ∧
      P.eval x = 0 ∧ P.eval y = 0 ∧ P.eval z = 0 ∧
      x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hax, hxb, hxr⟩ := exists_root_between_of_sign hab ha hb
  obtain ⟨e, hde, hepos⟩ := he
  obtain ⟨z, hdz, hze, hzr⟩ := exists_root_between_of_sign_rev hde hd hepos
  refine ⟨x, c, z, ?_, ?_, ?_, hxr, hc, hzr, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact lt_of_le_of_lt ha0 hax
  · exact hc0
  · linarith
  · linarith
  · linarith
  · linarith

name: SRGInequality.no_nonneg_middle_for_quartic
statement:
lemma no_nonneg_middle_for_quartic
    {P : Polynomial Real} {muPlus mu muK : Real}
    (hrootcount : P.roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ 2)
    (hzero : 0 < P.eval 0) (hplus : P.eval muPlus < 0)
    (hmu : 0 ≤ P.eval mu) (hK : P.eval muK < 0)
    (horder : 0 < muPlus ∧ muPlus < mu ∧ mu < muK)
    (hdegree : 0 < P.degree) (hlc : 0 ≤ P.leadingCoeff) : False
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hmu0 : P.eval mu = 0
  · have hevent : ∀ᶠ x : Real in Filter.atTop, 0 < P.eval x :=
      (P.tendsto_atTop_of_leadingCoeff_nonneg hdegree hlc).eventually_gt_atTop 0
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Filter.Eventually.exists_forall_of_atTop hevent
    let e : Real := max (muK + 1) z
    have he : muK < e ∧ 0 < P.eval e := by
      constructor
      · dsimp [e]
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_max_left _ _)
      · exact hz e (le_max_right _ _)
    obtain ⟨x, y, z', hx, hy, hz', hxr, hyr, hzr, hxy, hxz, hyz⟩ :=
      three_pos_roots_of_signs (by norm_num)
        (by linarith [horder.1, horder.2.1])
        horder.1 horder.2.1 horder.2.2 hzero hplus hmu0 hK
        ⟨e, he.1, he.2⟩
    have hP : P ≠ 0 := Polynomial.ne_zero_of_degree_gt hdegree
    have hc := count_three_positive_roots hP hxr hyr hzr hx hy hz' hxy hxz hyz
    omega
  · have hmu' : 0 < P.eval mu := lt_of_le_of_ne hmu (Ne.symm hmu0)
    exact no_strict_middle_for_quartic hrootcount hzero hplus hmu' hK horder

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_degree_leading_nonneg
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_degree_leading_nonneg
    {r t : Real} (_hr : 0 < r) (ht : 1 < t) :
    0 < (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).degree ∧
      0 ≤ (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : generalA4 r t ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [generalA4]
    nlinarith
  have hn : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).natDegree = 4 := by
    change (C (generalA4 r t) * X ^ 4 + C (generalA3 r t) * X ^ 3 +
      C (generalA2 r t) * X ^ 2 + C (generalA1 r t) * X +
      C (generalA0 r t)).natDegree = 4
    exact quartic_natDegree_of_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
      (a4 := generalA4 r t) (a3 := generalA3 r t)
      (a2 := generalA2 r t) (a1 := generalA1 r t)
      (a0 := generalA0 r t) h4
  have hP : absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hdeg := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial Real => p.natDegree) h
    simp at hdeg
    omega
  have hd : 0 < (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).degree := by
    rw [Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hP, hn]
    norm_num
  have ht1 : 1 < t := by linarith
  have hcl := absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_coeffList (r := r) (t := t) ht1
  have hclne : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).coeffList ≠ [] := by
    rw [hcl]
    simp
  have hh := Polynomial.head_coeffList
    (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t) hclne
  have hh' : generalA4 r t =
      (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).leadingCoeff := by
    simpa [hcl] using hh
  constructor
  · exact hd
  · rw [← hh']
    dsimp [generalA4]
    positivity

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3_degree_leading_nonneg
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3_degree_leading_nonneg
    {r : Real}
    (hcoeff : (absolutePoly3Polynomial r).coeffList =
      [4, -2 * (r ^ 2 - 21 * r - 12),
        -2 * (5 * r ^ 3 - 93 * r ^ 2 - 108 * r - 18),
        -6 * r * (r + 1) * (2 * r ^ 2 - 69 * r - 45),
        324 * r ^ 2 * (r + 1) ^ 2]) :
    0 < (absolutePoly3Polynomial r).degree ∧
      0 ≤ (absolutePoly3Polynomial r).leadingCoeff
proof:
:= by
  let P := absolutePoly3Polynomial r
  have hclne : P.coeffList ≠ [] := by
    rw [hcoeff]
    simp
  have hh := Polynomial.head_coeffList P hclne
  have hh' : (4 : Real) = P.leadingCoeff := by
    simpa [P, hcoeff] using hh
  have hlen := Polynomial.length_coeffList_eq_withBotSucc_degree P
  rw [hcoeff] at hlen
  have hd : P.degree = (4 : WithBot Nat) := by
    apply (WithBot.succ_strictMono (α := Nat)).injective
    simpa using hlen.symm
  constructor
  · rw [hd]
    norm_num
  · rw [← hh']
    norm_num

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3Polynomial_coeffList
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3Polynomial_coeffList (r : Real) :
    (absolutePoly3Polynomial r).coeffList =
      [4, -2 * (r ^ 2 - 21 * r - 12),
        -2 * (5 * r ^ 3 - 93 * r ^ 2 - 108 * r - 18),
        -6 * r * (r + 1) * (2 * r ^ 2 - 69 * r - 45),
        324 * r ^ 2 * (r + 1) ^ 2]
proof:

    (a4 := (4 : Real))

    (a1 := -6 * r * (r + 1) * (2 * r ^ 2 - 69 * r - 45))

name: SRGInequality.t3_nonstrict_mu_le_muPlus_of_rootcount
statement:
lemma t3_nonstrict_mu_le_muPlus_of_rootcount
    {r mu : Real}
    (hr35 : 35 ≤ r)
    (_hcoeff : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r 3).coeffList =
      [generalA4 r 3, generalA3 r 3, generalA2 r 3, generalA1 r 3, generalA0 r 3])
    (hrootcount : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r 3).roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x) ≤ 2)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePoly3 r 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePoly3 r (muPlusFormula r 3) < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 ≤ absolutePoly3 r mu)
    (hAK : absolutePoly3 r
      (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) < 0)
    (hmuK : mu ≤ 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) :
    mu ≤ muPlusFormula r 3
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hpluslt : muPlusFormula r 3 < mu := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hmulK : mu < 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3) := by
    by_contra hle
    have heq : mu = 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3) :=
      le_antisymm hmuK (le_of_not_gt hle)
    rw [heq] at hAmu
    linarith
  have hc2 : discriminantC2 r 3 < 0 := by
    simp [discriminantC2]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 6)]
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r 3 := discriminantC0_pos (by linarith) (by norm_num)
  have hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r 3 := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    have hp : discriminantC2 r 3 * discriminantC0 r 3 < 0 :=
      mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc2 hc0
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (discriminantC1 r 3), hp]
  have hposPlus : 0 < muPlusFormula r 3 :=
    muPlus_pos_of_c2_neg_c0_pos hc2 hc0 hdisc
  have hpoly : ∀ x : Real, absolutePoly3 r x = absolutePolyGeneral r 3 x := by
    intro x
    simp [absolutePoly3, absolutePolyGeneral]
    ring
  have hzero' : 0 < Polynomial.eval 0 (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r 3) := by
    rw [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval]
    rw [← hpoly 0]
    exact hA0
  have hplus' : Polynomial.eval (muPlusFormula r 3)
      (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r 3) < 0 := by
    rw [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval]
    simpa [hpoly] using hAplus
  have hmu' : 0 ≤ Polynomial.eval mu (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r 3) := by
    rw [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval]
    simpa [hpoly] using hAmu
  have hK' : Polynomial.eval (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3))
      (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r 3) < 0 := by
    rw [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval]
    simpa [hpoly] using hAK
  have hdl := absolutePolyGeneral_degree_leading_nonneg
    (r := r) (t := (3 : Real)) (by linarith) (by norm_num)
  have hfalse := no_nonneg_middle_for_quartic hrootcount hzero' hplus'
    hmu' hK' ⟨hposPlus, hpluslt, hmulK⟩ hdl.1 hdl.2
  exact hfalse

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t3_low
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t3_low
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hr12 : restrictedPos k lambda mu ≤ 2)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu ) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have ht : 2 <= -restrictedNeg k lambda mu := by rw [htEq]; norm_num
  have hc2 : 0 ≤ discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := by
    rw [htEq]
    simp [discriminantC2]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 6)]
  exact srg_target_of_c2_nonneg G h hc hne hr ht hc2

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t2_krein_small
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t2_krein_small
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hr7 : restrictedPos k lambda mu <= 7)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 2)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu ) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hk : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu *
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) + (mu : Real) := by
    nlinarith [degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne]
  have hE : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu + 2 * 2 - 2 ^ 2 := by
    norm_num
    linarith
  have hmuL : (mu : Real) <= restrictedPos k lambda mu + 4 := by
    have hL := mu_le_krein_threshold hK hk (by simpa [htEq] using hE)
    rw [htEq] at hL
    norm_num at hL
    have hrne : Not (restrictedPos k lambda mu = 0) := by linarith
    calc
       (mu : Real) <=
        restrictedPos k lambda mu * (4 + restrictedPos k lambda mu) /
          restrictedPos k lambda mu := hL
      _ = restrictedPos k lambda mu + 4 := by field_simp [hrne]; ring
  have ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0) := by norm_num [htEq]
  exact srg_target_of_verified_cases_or_gap_zero G h hc hne ht0 hr
    (Or.inl (Or.inl (And.intro htEq (And.intro hr7 hmuL))))

name: SRGInequality.t3_high_strict_mu_le_muPlus
statement:
lemma t3_high_strict_mu_le_muPlus
    {r mu : Real}
    (hr36 : 36 ≤ r)
    (hcoeff : (absolutePoly3Polynomial r).coeffList =
      [4, -2 * (r ^ 2 - 21 * r - 12),
        -2 * (5 * r ^ 3 - 93 * r ^ 2 - 108 * r - 18),
        -6 * r * (r + 1) * (2 * r ^ 2 - 69 * r - 45),
        324 * r ^ 2 * (r + 1) ^ 2])

    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePoly3 r 0)

    (hAK : absolutePoly3 r (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) < 0)
     (hmuK : mu <= 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) :
    mu ≤ muPlusFormula r 3
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hpluslt : muPlusFormula r 3 < mu := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hmulK : mu < 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3) := by
    by_contra hle
    have heq : mu = 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3) := le_antisymm hmuK (le_of_not_gt hle)
    rw [heq] at hAmu
    linarith
  have hzero' : 0 < Polynomial.eval 0 (absolutePoly3Polynomial r) := by
    simpa [absolutePoly3Polynomial_eval] using hA0
  have hplus' : Polynomial.eval (muPlusFormula r 3)
      (absolutePoly3Polynomial r) < 0 := by
    simpa [absolutePoly3Polynomial_eval] using hAplus
  have hmu' : 0 < Polynomial.eval mu (absolutePoly3Polynomial r) := by
    simpa [absolutePoly3Polynomial_eval] using hAmu
  have hK' : Polynomial.eval (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3))
      (absolutePoly3Polynomial r) < 0 := by
    simpa [absolutePoly3Polynomial_eval] using hAK
  have hc2 : discriminantC2 r 3 < 0 := by
    simp [discriminantC2]

  exact absolutePoly3_no_strict_middle hr36 hcoeff hzero' hplus' hmu' hK'
    (And.intro (muPlus_pos_of_c2_neg_c0_pos hc2 hc0 hdisc)
      (And.intro hpluslt hmulK))

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t3_high_strict
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t3_high_strict
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr36 : 36 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hstrict : 0 < absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (mu : Real))
    (hcoeff : (absolutePoly3Polynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu)).coeffList =
      [4, -2 * (restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 - 21 * restrictedPos k lambda mu - 12),
        -2 * (5 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 3 - 93 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 -
          108 * restrictedPos k lambda mu - 18),
        -6 * restrictedPos k lambda mu * (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 1) *
          (2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 - 69 * restrictedPos k lambda mu - 45),
        324 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 * (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 1) ^ 2])
    (hrootcount : (absolutePoly3Polynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu)).roots.countP
      (fun x => 0 < x) ≤ 2)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3) < 0)
    (hAK : absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu * (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
        (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3)) < 0) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu ) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu := by linarith
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0) := by norm_num [htEq]
  have hk : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu * 3 + (mu : Real) := by
    nlinarith [degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne, htEq]
  have hc2 : discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 < 0 := by
    simp [discriminantC2]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 6)]
  have hE : 0 < energyE (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 := by
    exact c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr (by norm_num) hc2
  have hmuK : (mu : Real) <= 2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu * (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
        (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3) := by
    have hK3 : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 := by
      simpa [htEq] using hK
    have hL := mu_le_krein_threshold hK3 hk (by simpa [energyE] using hE)
    norm_num at hL
    have hden' : restrictedPos k lambda mu + 6 - 9 = restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3 := by ring
    rw [hden'] at hL
    have hdenpos : 0 < (restrictedPos k lambda mu : Real) - 3 := by linarith [hr36]
    have hLnorm : (mu : Real) <= 2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu * (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
          (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3) := by
      simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hL
    have hL' : (mu : Real) * (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3) <=
          2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu * (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) := by
      exact (le_div_iff₀ hdenpos).mp hLnorm
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hdenpos).mpr
    exact hL'
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 :=
    discriminantC0_pos hr (by norm_num)
  have hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (discriminantC1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3)]
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt hc0
  have hmuPlus : (mu : Real)  ≤ muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 := by
    apply t3_high_strict_mu_le_muPlus
      (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu) (mu := (mu : Real))
      hr36 hcoeff hrootcount hA0 hAplus hstrict hAK hmuK
  have hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 (mu : Real) :=
    discriminant_nonneg_up_to_muPlus hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero (le_of_lt hmu) hmuPlus
  have hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 (mu : Real) :=
    le_of_lt (auxiliaryPoly_pos hr (by norm_num) hmu)
  have hout := srg_target_of_D_nonneg G h hc hne ht0
    (by simpa [htEq] using hD) (by simpa [htEq] using hN)
  simpa [htEq] using hout

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_rootcount_of_large_range
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_rootcount_of_large_range
    {r t : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (ht4 : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr0 : 2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t ≤ r) :
    (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  exact absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_range hr (by linarith) hr0

name: SRGInequality.t2AbsoluteH_neg
statement:
lemma t2AbsoluteH_neg
    {r mu : Real} (hr : 8 ≤ r) (hm : 7 ≤ mu) (hmr : mu ≤ r + 4) :
    t2AbsoluteH r mu < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : 0 ≤ mu := by linarith
  have hmu2 : mu ^ 2 ≤ (r + 4) * mu := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hm0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hmr)]
  have hq : mu ^ 2 + (7 + r - 2 * r ^ 2) * mu +
      (-2 * r ^ 3 + 10 * r ^ 2 + 12 * r + 49 +
        7 * (r - 2 * r ^ 2)) < 0 := by
    nlinarith [hmu2, sq_nonneg (r - 8)]
  have hsec : t2AbsoluteH r mu - t2AbsoluteH r 7 =
      (mu - 7) * (mu ^ 2 + 7 * mu + 49 +
        (r - 2 * r ^ 2) * (mu + 7) +
        (-2 * r ^ 3 + 10 * r ^ 2 + 12 * r)) := by
    dsimp [t2AbsoluteH]
    ring
  have hsec' : t2AbsoluteH r mu - t2AbsoluteH r 7 ≤ 0 := by
    rw [hsec]
    have hmu7 : 0 ≤ mu - 7 := by linarith
    nlinarith [hq]
  have h7 : t2AbsoluteH r 7 < 0 := by
    dsimp [t2AbsoluteH]
    have hp : 0 < 2 * r ^ 2 + 2 * r - 49 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 8)]
    nlinarith [mul_pos (by linarith : 0 < 3 * r + 7) hp]
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_t2_factor
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_t2_factor (r mu : Real) :
    absolutePolyGeneral r 2 mu =
      (mu + 2 * r + 2) * t2AbsoluteH r mu
proof:
:= by
  simp [absolutePolyGeneral, t2AbsoluteH]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t2_large_absolute
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t2_large_absolute
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr8 : 8 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 2)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu := by linarith
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hk : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu * 2 + (mu : Real) := by
    nlinarith [degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne, htEq]
  have hmuL : (mu : Real) <= restrictedPos k lambda mu + 4 := by
    have hE : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu + 2 * 2 - 2 ^ 2 := by norm_num; linarith
    have hKt : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu *
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) + (mu : Real) := by
      simpa [htEq] using hk
    have hEt : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu + 2 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
        - (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)^2 := by
      simpa [htEq] using hE
    have hL := mu_le_krein_threshold hK hKt hEt
    rw [htEq] at hL
    norm_num at hL
    have hrne : Not (restrictedPos k lambda mu = 0) := by linarith
    calc
      (mu : Real) <=
        restrictedPos k lambda mu * (4 + restrictedPos k lambda mu) /
          restrictedPos k lambda mu := hL
      _ = restrictedPos k lambda mu + 4 := by field_simp [hrne]; ring
  have hmu6 : (mu : Real) <= 6 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hmu6lt : (6 : Real) < (mu : Real) := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hmuNat : 6 < mu := by exact_mod_cast hmu6lt
    have hm7Nat : 7 <= mu := by omega
    have hm7 : 7 <= (mu : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hm7Nat
    have hH := t2AbsoluteH_neg (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (mu := (mu : Real)) (by simpa using hr8) hm7 hmuL
    have hnonneg := srg_absolutePolyGeneral_nonneg G h hc hne hr (by norm_num [htEq]) hA
    have hfac : 0 < (mu : Real) + 2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu + 2 := by linarith
    have hpoly : absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 2 (mu : Real) < 0 := by
      rw [absolutePolyGeneral_t2_factor]
      nlinarith
    have hnonneg' : 0 <= absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 2 (mu : Real) := by
      simpa [htEq] using hnonneg
    linarith
  have hD : 0 <= discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 2 (mu : Real) := by
    have hc2 : discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 2 < 0 := by
      simp [discriminantC2]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 6)]
    have hzero : 0 <= discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 2 0 := by
      rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
      exact le_of_lt (discriminantC0_pos hr (by norm_num))
    have hsix := discriminantPoly_t2_at_six_nonneg (by simpa using hr8)
    exact discriminant_nonneg_of_concave_threshold (le_of_lt hc2)
      (le_of_lt hmu) hmu6 hzero hsix (by norm_num)
  have hN : 0 <= auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 2 (mu : Real) := by
    dsimp [auxiliaryPoly]
    positivity
  have ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0) := by norm_num [htEq]
  exact srg_target_of_D_nonneg G h hc hne ht0 (by simpa [htEq] using hD) (by simpa [htEq] using hN)

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t2_external_bounds
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t2_external_bounds
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 2)
    (hint : Exists (fun z : Int => (z : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu))
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr7 : restrictedPos k lambda mu ≤ 7
  · exact srg_target_of_t2_krein_small G h hc hne hr hr7 htEq hK
  · have hr8 : 8 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu := by
       let z : Int := Classical.choose hint
       have hz : (z : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu := Classical.choose_spec hint
       have hz7R : (7 : Real) < (z : Real) := by simpa [hz] using (lt_of_not_ge hr7)
       have hz7 : (7 : Int) < z := by exact_mod_cast hz7R
       have hz8 : (8 : Int) <= z := by omega
       have hz8R : (8 : Real) <= (z : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hz8
       simpa [hz] using hz8R
    exact srg_target_of_t2_large_absolute G h hc hne hr8 htEq hK hA

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t2_unequal_integer_route
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t2_unequal_integer_route
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}

      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))

    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 2)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)

        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  have hint := srg_restrictedPos_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg
  exact srg_target_of_t2_external_bounds G h hc hne hr htEq hint hK hA

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_at_muPlus_neg_of_range
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_at_muPlus_neg_of_range
    {r t : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r)
    (ht4 : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr0 : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 ≤ r)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t) :
    absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t := discriminantC0_pos hr (by linarith)
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt hc0
  have hR := general_remainder_vertex_neg_of_range ht4 hr0 hc2
  have hN1 := general_n1_neg_of_range ht4 hr0 (ne_of_lt hc2)
  let delta : Real := -discriminantC2 r t
  let R1 : Real := generalR1 r t
  let R0 : Real := generalR0 r t
  have hdelta : 0 < delta := by dsimp [delta]; linarith
  have hR1 : R1 < 0 := by
    have hn : delta ^ 3 * R1 < 0 := by
      simpa [generalN1, delta, R1] using hN1
    by_contra hnot
    have hR1non : 0 ≤ R1 := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hpow : 0 < delta ^ 3 := by positivity
    have hnon : 0 ≤ delta ^ 3 * R1 :=
      mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hpow) hR1non
    linarith
  have hvertex : R1 *
      (-discriminantC1 r t / (2 * discriminantC2 r t)) + R0 < 0 := by
    simpa [R1, R0] using hR
  have horder : -discriminantC1 r t /
      (2 * discriminantC2 r t) ≤ muPlusFormula r t := by
    dsimp [muPlusFormula]
    have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (discriminantQuadratic r t) :=
      Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hd : 2 * discriminantC2 r t < 0 := by linarith
    apply (div_le_iff_of_neg hd).2
    field_simp [ne_of_lt hc2]
    nlinarith [hs]
  have hlin := linear_remainder_neg_of_ge_vertex hR1 hvertex horder
  have hquad : discriminantC2 r t * (muPlusFormula r t) ^ 2 +
      discriminantC1 r t * muPlusFormula r t + discriminantC0 r t = 0 := by
    have hz := discriminantPoly_at_muPlus_zero (ne_of_lt hc2) hdisc
    simpa [discriminantPoly_expand] using hz
  have hdiv := absolutePolyGeneral_division_certificate
    (r := r) (t := t) (mu := muPlusFormula r t) (ne_of_lt hc2)
  dsimp at hdiv
  change absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) =
    (generalQ2 r t * (muPlusFormula r t) ^ 2 +
        generalQ1 r t * muPlusFormula r t + generalQ0 r t) *
      (discriminantC2 r t * (muPlusFormula r t) ^ 2 +
        discriminantC1 r t * muPlusFormula r t + discriminantC0 r t) +
      R1 * muPlusFormula r t + R0 at hdiv
  rw [hdiv, hquad]
  simpa [R1, R0] using hlin

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_at_muPlus_neg_of_remainder
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_at_muPlus_neg_of_remainder
    {r t : Real}
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t)
    (hN1 : generalN1 r t < 0)
    (hR : generalR1 r t *
      (-discriminantC1 r t / (2 * discriminantC2 r t)) +
      generalR0 r t < 0) :
    absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0
proof:
:= by
  let delta : Real := -discriminantC2 r t

  let R0 : Real := generalR0 r t
  have hdelta : 0 < delta := by dsimp [delta]; linarith
  have hR1 : R1 < 0 := by
    have hn : delta ^ 3 * R1 < 0 := by
      simpa [generalN1, delta, R1] using hN1
    by_contra hnot
    have hR1non : 0 ≤ R1 := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hpow : 0 < delta ^ 3 := by positivity
    have hnon : 0 ≤ delta ^ 3 * R1 :=
      mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hpow) hR1non
    linarith
  have hvertex : R1 *
      (-discriminantC1 r t / (2 * discriminantC2 r t)) + R0 < 0 := by
    simpa [R1, R0] using hR
  have horder : -discriminantC1 r t /
      (2 * discriminantC2 r t) ≤ muPlusFormula r t := by
    dsimp [muPlusFormula]
    have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (discriminantQuadratic r t) :=
      Real.sqrt_nonneg _
    have hd : 2 * discriminantC2 r t < 0 := by linarith
    apply (div_le_iff_of_neg hd).2
    field_simp [ne_of_lt hc2]
    nlinarith [hs]
  have hlin := linear_remainder_neg_of_ge_vertex hR1 hvertex horder
  have hquad : discriminantC2 r t * (muPlusFormula r t) ^ 2 +
      discriminantC1 r t * muPlusFormula r t + discriminantC0 r t = 0 := by
    have hz := discriminantPoly_at_muPlus_zero (ne_of_lt hc2) hdisc
    simpa [discriminantPoly_expand] using hz
  have hdiv := absolutePolyGeneral_division_certificate
    (r := r) (t := t) (mu := muPlusFormula r t) (ne_of_lt hc2)
  dsimp at hdiv
  change absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) =
    (generalQ2 r t * (muPlusFormula r t) ^ 2 +
        generalQ1 r t * muPlusFormula r t + generalQ0 r t) *
      (discriminantC2 r t * (muPlusFormula r t) ^ 2 +
        discriminantC1 r t * muPlusFormula r t + discriminantC0 r t) +
      R1 * muPlusFormula r t + R0 at hdiv
  rw [hdiv, hquad]

name: SRGInequality.F_certificate_pos_at_t3
statement:
lemma F_certificate_pos_at_t3 {r : Real} (hr35 : 35 ≤ r) :
    0 < F_certificate r 3
proof:
:= by
  let p : Real := r - 35
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := by dsimp [p]; linarith
  have hrp : r = p + 35 := by dsimp [p]; ring
  rw [hrp]
  dsimp [F_certificate]
  ring_nf
  positivity

lemma G_certificate_pos_at_t3 {r : Real} (hr35 : 35 ≤ r) :
