name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3_at_muPlus_neg_of_large_range
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3_at_muPlus_neg_of_large_range
    {r : Real} (hr35 : 35 ≤ r) :
    absolutePoly3 r (muPlusFormula r 3) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < r := by linarith
  have hc2 : discriminantC2 r 3 < 0 := by
    simp [discriminantC2]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 6)]
  have hc2ne : Not (discriminantC2 r 3 = 0) := by linarith
  have hN1 : generalN1 r 3 < 0 := by
    have hfac := general_n1_factor (r := r) (t := 3) hc2ne
    have hF := F_certificate_pos_at_t3 hr35
    have hpos : 0 < (3 : Real) ^ 2 * (r + 1) * (r + 3) ^ 2 *
        F_certificate r 3 := by positivity
    nlinarith [hfac]
  have hR : generalR1 r 3 *
      (-discriminantC1 r 3 / (2 * discriminantC2 r 3)) +
      generalR0 r 3 < 0 := by
    have hfac := general_W_factor (r := r) (t := 3) hc2ne
    have hG := G_certificate_pos_at_t3 hr35
    have hWpos : 0 < generalW r 3 := by
      rw [hfac]
      positivity
    exact remainder_at_quadratic_vertex_neg
      (c2 := discriminantC2 r 3) (c1 := discriminantC1 r 3)
      (R1 := generalR1 r 3) (R0 := generalR0 r 3)
      (delta := -discriminantC2 r 3)
      (n1 := generalN1 r 3) (n0 := generalN0 r 3)
      (W := generalW r 3) hc2 rfl rfl rfl rfl hWpos
  have hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r 3 := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (discriminantC1 r 3),
      mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc2
        (discriminantC0_pos hr (by norm_num : (2 : Real) ≤ 3))]
  have hgen := absolutePolyGeneral_at_muPlus_neg_of_remainder
    (r := r) (t := 3) hc2 hdisc hN1 hR
  convert hgen using 1
  all_goals
    norm_num [absolutePoly3, absolutePolyGeneral]
    ring

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_general_q_pos_strict_range_external
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_general_q_pos_strict_range_external
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (ht4 : 4 ≤ -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (hr0 : 2 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 3 -
      3 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 + 1 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (_hQ : 0 < qGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hstrict : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))
    (hcases : Or
      (LE.le (mu : Real)
        (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)))
      (And
        (0 < muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
        (And
          (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
            (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < (mu : Real))
          ((mu : Real) < muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
            (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)))))
    (_hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  have part := hs.1
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast part
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - (v : Real) * k =
      discriminantPoly r t (mu : Real) * auxiliaryPoly r t (mu : Real) /
        ((mu : Real) ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2) := by
    dsimp [r, t, f, g]
    exact srg_gap_factorization G h hc hne
      (by simpa [t] using (ne_of_gt (show 0 < -restrictedNeg k lambda mu by linarith)))
  have hrt : 0 < t := by dsimp [t]; linarith
  have hrr : 0 < r := by simpa [r] using hr
  have htc : 4 ≤ t := by simpa [t] using ht4
  have hrc : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 ≤ r := by simpa [r, t] using hr0
  have hK' : KreinBound (k : Real) r t := by simpa [r, t] using hK
  have hk : (k : Real) = r * t + (mu : Real) := by
    dsimp [r, t]
    simpa [add_comm] using (degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne)
  have _hQ' : 0 < qGeneral r t := by simpa [r, t] using _hQ
  have hstrict' : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t (mu : Real) := by
    simpa [r, t] using hstrict
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t := discriminantC0_pos hrr (by linarith)
  have hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (discriminantC1 r t),
      mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by simpa [r, t] using hc2) hc0]
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt hc0
  have hE : 0 < energyE r t := c2_neg_implies_E_pos hrr (by linarith) (by simpa [r, t] using hc2)
  have hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0 := by
    have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith [htc]
    have hr1 : 0 < r + 1 := by linarith [hrr]
    dsimp [absolutePolyGeneral, generalA0]
    have hmu0 : 0 <= (mu : Real) := le_of_lt hmu
    have h1 : 0 < r ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hrr
    have h2 : 0 < t ^ 4 := by positivity
    have h3 : 0 < (r + 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith [hrr])
    have h4 : 0 < (t - 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos ht1
    simpa [mul_assoc] using (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos h1 h2) h3) h4)
  have hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0 := by
    apply absolutePolyGeneral_at_muPlus_neg_of_range hrr htc
      (by linarith [hrc]) (by simpa [r, t] using hc2) hdisc
  have hAK : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muKFormula r t) < 0 := by
    exact absolutePolyGeneral_at_muK_neg htc hrc hE
  have hrootcount : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x) <= 2 := by
    by_cases hrsmall : r ≤ 2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t
    · have ha3 : generalA3 r t < 0 := generalA3_neg_bridge htc hrc
      have ha1 : 0 < generalA1 r t :=
        generalA1_pos_bridge htc hrc hrsmall
      exact absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_pos_range hrr
        (by linarith [htc]) ha3 ha1
    · exact absolutePolyGeneral_rootcount_of_large_range hrr htc
        (le_of_not_ge hrsmall)
  have hcases' : Or (LE.le (mu : Real) (muPlusFormula r t))
      (And (0 < muPlusFormula r t)
        (And (muPlusFormula r t < (mu : Real))
          ((mu : Real) < muKFormula r t))) := by
    dsimp [r, t]
    exact hcases
  have hN : 0 <= auxiliaryPoly r t (mu : Real) := by
    exact le_of_lt (auxiliaryPoly_pos hrr (by linarith [htc]) hmu)
  have hout := target_of_strict_absolute_case hrr hrt hmu hv hgap
    (by simpa [r, t] using hc2) hc0 hdisc hzero hrootcount hA0 hAplus
    hstrict' hAK hcases' hN
  simpa [r, t, f, g] using hout

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_general_q_pos_strict_auto
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_general_q_pos_strict_auto
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (ht4 : LE.le 4 (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hr0 : 2 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 3 -
      3 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 + 1 <= restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (_hQ : 0 < qGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hstrict : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hk : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu *
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) + (mu : Real) := by
    simpa [add_comm] using (degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne)
  have hE : 0 < energyE (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := by
    exact c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr (by linarith [ht4]) hc2
  have hmuK : LE.le (mu : Real)
      (muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) := by
    exact mu_le_krein_threshold hK hk hE
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := discriminantC0_pos hr (by linarith [ht4])
  have hdisc : LE.le 0 (discriminantQuadratic (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (discriminantC1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)), mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc2 hc0]
  have hplus : 0 < muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) :=
    muPlus_pos_of_c2_neg_c0_pos hc2 hc0 hdisc
  have hcases : Or
      (LE.le (mu : Real) (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)))
      (And (0 < muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) (And
        (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < (mu : Real))
        ((mu : Real) < muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)))) := by
    by_cases hle : LE.le (mu : Real)
      (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    · exact Or.inl hle
    · have hpluslt := lt_of_not_ge hle
      have hmulK : (mu : Real) < muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := by
        by_contra hnot
        have heq : (mu : Real) = muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
            (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := le_antisymm hmuK (le_of_not_gt hnot)
        rw [heq] at hstrict
        have hneg := absolutePolyGeneral_at_muK_neg ht4 hr0 hE
        linarith
      exact Or.inr (And.intro hplus (And.intro hpluslt hmulK))
  exact srg_target_of_general_q_pos_strict_range_external G h hc hne hr ht4
    hr0 hc2 hK _hQ hstrict hcases hA

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_general_q_pos_nonstrict_auto
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_general_q_pos_nonstrict_auto
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (ht4 : 4 ≤ -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (hr0 : 2 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 3 -
      3 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 + 1 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (_hQ : 0 < qGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hE : 0 < energyE (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := by
    exact c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr (by linarith [ht4]) hc2
  have hk : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu *
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) + (mu : Real) := by
    simpa [add_comm] using (degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne)
  have hmuK : LE.le (mu : Real)
      (muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) :=
    mu_le_krein_threshold hK hk hE
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := discriminantC0_pos hr (by linarith [ht4])
  have hdisc : LE.le 0 (discriminantQuadratic (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (discriminantC1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)), mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc2 hc0]
  have hplus : 0 < muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) :=
    muPlus_pos_of_c2_neg_c0_pos hc2 hc0 hdisc
  have hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) 0 := by
    have ht1 : 0 < (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) - 1 := by linarith [ht4]
    have hr1 : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu + 1 := by linarith
    dsimp [absolutePolyGeneral, generalA0]
    have hmu0 : 0 ≤ (mu : Real) := le_of_lt hmu
    have h1 : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hr
    have h2 : 0 < (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 4 := by positivity
    have h3 : 0 < (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 1) ^ 2 :=
      sq_pos_of_pos hr1
    have h4 : 0 < ((-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) - 1) ^ 2 :=
      sq_pos_of_pos ht1
    simpa [mul_assoc] using (mul_pos (mul_pos (mul_pos h1 h2) h3) h4)
  have hrc : 2 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 3 -
      3 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu := by
    linarith [hr0]
  have hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
      (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) < 0 := by
    apply absolutePolyGeneral_at_muPlus_neg_of_range
      hr ht4 hrc (by simpa using hc2) hdisc
  have hAK : absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
      (muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) < 0 := by
    exact absolutePolyGeneral_at_muK_neg ht4 hr0 hE
  have hrootcount : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)).roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x) ≤ 2 := by
    by_cases hrsmall : restrictedPos k lambda mu ≤
        2 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 3 -
          2 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 - (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    · have ha3 : generalA3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0 :=
        generalA3_neg_bridge ht4 hr0
      have ha1 : 0 < generalA1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) :=
        generalA1_pos_bridge ht4 hr0 hrsmall
      exact absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_pos_range hr
        (by linarith [ht4]) ha3 ha1
    · exact absolutePolyGeneral_rootcount_of_large_range hr ht4
        (le_of_not_ge hrsmall)
  have hnonneg := srg_absolutePolyGeneral_nonneg G h hc hne hr
    (by linarith [ht4]) hA
  have hcases : LE.le (mu : Real)
      (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hpluslt : muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < (mu : Real) := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hmulK : (mu : Real) < muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := by
      by_contra hnotK
      have heq : (mu : Real) = muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := le_antisymm hmuK (le_of_not_gt hnotK)
      rw [heq] at hnonneg
      linarith
    have ht1 : (1 : Real) < -restrictedNeg k lambda mu := by
      linarith [ht4]
    have hdegLead :=
      absolutePolyGeneral_degree_leading_nonneg
        (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (t := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu) hr ht1
    have hA0' : 0 < Polynomial.eval 0
        (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) := by
      simpa [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval] using hA0
    have hAplus' : Polynomial.eval
        (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
        (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) < 0 := by
      simpa [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval] using hAplus
    have hnonneg' : 0 ≤ Polynomial.eval (mu : Real)
        (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) := by
      simpa [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval] using hnonneg
    have hAK' : Polynomial.eval
        (muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
        (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) < 0 := by
      simpa [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval] using hAK
    have hfalse := no_nonneg_middle_for_quartic hrootcount hA0' hAplus'
      hnonneg' hAK'
      ⟨hplus, hpluslt, hmulK⟩ hdegLead.1 hdegLead.2
    exact False.elim hfalse
  have hzero : LE.le 0 (discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) 0) := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt hc0
  have hD : LE.le 0 (discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real)) :=
    discriminant_nonneg_up_to_muPlus hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero
      (le_of_lt hmu) hcases
  have hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real)) :=
    le_of_lt (auxiliaryPoly_pos hr (by linarith [ht4]) hmu)
  exact srg_target_of_D_nonneg G h hc hne (by linarith [ht4]) hD hN

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t3_high_strict_at35
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t3_high_strict_at35
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr35 : 35 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hnonneg : 0 ≤ absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (mu : Real))
    (hcoeff : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3).coeffList =
      [generalA4 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3,
        generalA3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3,
        generalA2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3,
        generalA1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3,
        generalA0 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3])
    (hrootcount : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3).roots.countP
      (fun x => 0 < x) ≤ 2)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3) < 0)
    (hAK : absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu * (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
        (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3)) < 0) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu ) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu := by linarith
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0) := by norm_num [htEq]
  have hk : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu * 3 + (mu : Real) := by
    nlinarith [degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne, htEq]
  have hc2 : discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 < 0 := by
    simp [discriminantC2]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 6)]
  have hE : 0 < energyE (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 := by
    exact c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr (by norm_num) hc2
  have hmuK : (mu : Real) <=
      2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu * (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
        (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3) := by
    have hK3 : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 := by
      simpa [htEq] using hK
    have hL := mu_le_krein_threshold hK3 hk (by simpa [energyE] using hE)
    norm_num at hL
    have hdenX : restrictedPos k lambda mu + 6 - 9 = restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3 := by ring
    rw [hdenX] at hL
    have hdenpos : 0 < (restrictedPos k lambda mu : Real) - 3 := by linarith [hr35]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hdenpos] at hL
    apply (le_div_iff₀ hdenpos).mpr
    ring_nf at hL
    nlinarith [hL]
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 :=
    discriminantC0_pos hr (by norm_num)
  have hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (discriminantC1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3)]
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt hc0
  have hmuPlus : (mu : Real)  ≤       muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 :=
    t3_nonstrict_mu_le_muPlus_of_rootcount hr35 hcoeff hrootcount hA0 hAplus
      (by simpa [htEq] using hnonneg) hAK hmuK
  have hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 (mu : Real) :=
    discriminant_nonneg_up_to_muPlus hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero (le_of_lt hmu) hmuPlus
  have hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 (mu : Real) :=
    le_of_lt (auxiliaryPoly_pos hr (by norm_num) hmu)
  have hout := srg_target_of_D_nonneg G h hc hne ht0
    (by simpa [htEq] using hD) (by simpa [htEq] using hN)
  simpa [htEq] using hout

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t3_c2_range
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t3_c2_range
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
