name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t3_complete_route
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t3_complete_route
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (_hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hroute :
       Or (LE.le (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 12)
        (Or
          (And (13 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
             (And (LE.le (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 34)
              ((mu : Real) ≤ 2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu *
                (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
                  (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3))))
          (And (35 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
            (And (0 ≤ absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (mu : Real))
              (And ((absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3).coeffList =
                [generalA4 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3,
                  generalA3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3,
                  generalA2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3,
                  generalA1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3,
                  generalA0 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3])
              (And
                ((absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3).roots.countP
                  (fun x => 0 < x) ≤ 2)
                (And (0 < absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 0)
                  (And
                    (absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
                      (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3) < 0)
                    (absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
                      (2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu *
                        (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
                          (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3)) < 0))))))))) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hroute with hr12 | hroute
  · exact srg_target_of_t3_c2_range G h hc hne _hr hr12 htEq
  · rcases hroute with hmid | hhigh
    · exact srg_target_of_t3_mid G h hc hne hmid.1 hmid.2.1 htEq hK
    · exact srg_target_of_t3_high_strict_at35 G h hc hne hhigh.1 htEq hK
        hhigh.2.1 hhigh.2.2.1 hhigh.2.2.2.1
        hhigh.2.2.2.2.1 hhigh.2.2.2.2.2.1 hhigh.2.2.2.2.2.2

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t3_external_bounds
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t3_external_bounds
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)))
    (_hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real))
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hint := srg_restrictedPos_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg
  let z : Int := Classical.choose hint
  have hz : (z : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu := Classical.choose_spec hint
  by_cases hr12 : restrictedPos k lambda mu ≤ 12
  · exact srg_target_of_t3_c2_range G h hc hne _hr hr12 htEq
  have hr13 : (13 : Real) ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu := by
    have hz13 : (13 : Int) ≤ z := by
      have hznot : ¬ z ≤ 12 := by
        intro hz12
        apply hr12
        rw [← hz]
        exact_mod_cast hz12
      omega
    rw [← hz]
    exact_mod_cast hz13
  by_cases hr34 : restrictedPos k lambda mu ≤ 34
  · exact srg_target_of_t3_mid G h hc hne hr13 hr34 htEq hK
  have hr35 : (35 : Real) ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu := by
    have hz35 : (35 : Int) ≤ z := by
      have hznot : ¬ z ≤ 34 := by
        intro hz34
        apply hr34
        rw [← hz]
        exact_mod_cast hz34
      omega
    rw [← hz]
    exact_mod_cast hz35
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (mu : Real) :=
    srg_absolutePoly3_nonneg G h hc hne htEq (by linarith [_hr]) hA
  have hcoeff := absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_coeffList
    (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu) (t := (3 : Real)) (by norm_num)
  have hA0 : 0 < absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 0 := by
    norm_num [absolutePoly3]
    positivity
  have hAplus : absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3) < 0 :=
    absolutePoly3_at_muPlus_neg_of_large_range hr35
  have hAK : absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu * (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
        (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3)) < 0 := by
    exact absolutePoly3_at_krein_neg (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu) hr35
  have hrootcount :
      (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3).roots.countP
        (fun x => 0 < x) ≤ 2 := by
    have ha3 : generalA3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 < 0 := by
      have hfac : generalA3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 =
          -2 * ((restrictedPos k lambda mu - 35) *
            (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 14) + 478) := by
        simp [generalA3]
        ring
      rw [hfac]
      have h1 : 0 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu - 35 := by linarith
      have h2 : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu + 14 := by linarith
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 (le_of_lt h2)]
    by_cases hz35eq : z = 35
    · have hrEq : restrictedPos k lambda mu = 35 := by
        rw [← hz, hz35eq]
        norm_num
      have ha1 : 0 < generalA1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 := by
        rw [hrEq]
        norm_num [generalA1]
      exact absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_pos_range
        (by linarith [hr35]) (by norm_num) ha3 ha1
    · have hz36 : (36 : Int) ≤ z := by
        have hznot : ¬ z ≤ 35 := by
          intro hzle
          have hz35le : (35 : Int) ≤ z := by
            have hr35z : (35 : Real) ≤ (z : Real) := by
              simpa [hz] using hr35
            exact_mod_cast hr35z
          exact hz35eq (by omega)
        omega
      have hr36 : (36 : Real) ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu := by
        rw [← hz]
        exact_mod_cast hz36
      have ha2 : generalA2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 ≤ 0 := by
        have hform : generalA2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 =
            -2 * (5 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 3 -
              93 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 -
              108 * restrictedPos k lambda mu - 18) := by
          simp [generalA2]
          ring
        rw [hform]
        have hfac : 5 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 3 -
            93 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 -
            108 * restrictedPos k lambda mu - 18 =
            (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 36) *
              (5 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 +
                87 * restrictedPos k lambda mu + 3024) + 108846 := by ring
        rw [hfac]
        have h1 : 0 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu - 36 := by linarith
        have h2 : 0 < 5 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 +
            87 * restrictedPos k lambda mu + 3024 := by positivity
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 (le_of_lt h2)]
      have ha1 : generalA1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 < 0 := by
        have hform : generalA1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) 3 =
            -(restrictedPos k lambda mu * 3 *
              (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 1) * 2) *
              (2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 -
                69 * restrictedPos k lambda mu - 45) := by
          simp [generalA1]
          ring
        rw [hform]
        have hp : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu * 3 *
            (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 1) * 2 := by positivity
        have hb : 0 < 2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 -
            69 * restrictedPos k lambda mu - 45 := by
          have hfac : 2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 -
              69 * restrictedPos k lambda mu - 45 =
              (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 36) *
                (2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu + 3) + 63 := by ring
          rw [hfac]
          have h1 : 0 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu - 36 := by linarith
          have h2 : 0 < 2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu + 3 := by linarith
          nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 (le_of_lt h2)]
        nlinarith [mul_pos hp hb]
      exact absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_neg_range
        (by linarith [hr35]) (by norm_num) ha3 ha2 ha1
  exact srg_target_of_t3_high_strict_at35 G h hc hne hr35 htEq hK
    hnonneg hcoeff hrootcount hA0 hAplus hAK

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_equal_external_bounds
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_equal_external_bounds
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)))
    (_hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hfg : positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hkposNat := degree_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hkpos : 0 < (k : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hkposNat
  have hkvNat : k < v - 1 := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, hneab, hab⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
    have hnotuniv : ¬ G.IsUniversal a := by
      intro ha
      exact hab (ha hneab)
    have hdeg := (G.degree_lt_card_sub_one a).mpr hnotuniv
    rw [h.card] at hdeg
    simpa [h.regular.degree_eq] using hdeg
  have hkv : (k : Real) < (v : Real) - 1 := by
    have hvpos : 1 ≤ v := by omega
    have hcast : ((v - 1 : Nat) : Real) = (v : Real) - 1 := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hvpos]
      norm_num
    rw [← hcast]
    exact_mod_cast hkvNat
  have hlam := lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hlk : lambda + 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hcert := srg_conference_parameter_certificate G h hc hne hfg
    hkpos hkv hlk
  rcases hcert with ⟨w, hw, hwv, hrel, hk, hmu⟩
  exact srg_target_of_conference_certificate G h hc hne hfg hw hwv hrel hk hmu

name: SRGInequality.qPoly_coeffList
statement:
lemma qPoly_coeffList {t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    (qPoly t).coeffList =
      [2*t-1, -2*t^3*(2*t-3), -t^2*(t-1)*(5*t+1),
       2*t^3*(t^3-2*t^2-t+1), t^5*(t-2)]
proof:
:= by
  apply quartic_coeffList_of_coefficients
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.qPoly_eval
statement: lemma qPoly_eval (t r : Real) : (qPoly t).eval r = qGeneral r t
proof:
:= by
  simp [qPoly, qGeneral]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.qPoly_at_zero_neg
statement: lemma qPoly_at_zero_neg {t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t) : 0 < (qPoly t).eval 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [qPoly_eval]
  norm_num [qGeneral]
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  exact mul_pos (pow_pos ht0 5) (by linarith)

name: SRGInequality.qPoly_at_a_neg
statement:
lemma qPoly_at_a_neg {t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    (qPoly t).eval (t * (t - 2) * (t + 1)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [qPoly_eval]
  let p : Real := t - 4
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := by dsimp [p]; linarith
  have htp : t = p + 4 := by dsimp [p]; ring
  rw [htp]
  dsimp [qGeneral]
  ring_nf
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg hp 2, pow_nonneg hp 3, pow_nonneg hp 4,
    pow_nonneg hp 5, pow_nonneg hp 6, pow_nonneg hp 7]

name: SRGInequality.qPoly_at_S_neg
statement:
lemma qPoly_at_S_neg {t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    (qPoly t).eval (2 * t^3 - 3 * t^2) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [qPoly_eval]
  let p : Real := t - 4
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := by dsimp [p]; linarith
  have htp : t = p + 4 := by dsimp [p]; ring
  rw [htp]
  dsimp [qGeneral]
  ring_nf
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg hp 2, pow_nonneg hp 3, pow_nonneg hp 4,
    pow_nonneg hp 5, pow_nonneg hp 6, pow_nonneg hp 7]

name: SRGInequality.qPoly_rootcount
statement:
lemma qPoly_rootcount {t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    (qPoly t).roots.countP (fun x : Real => 0 < x) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc := qPoly_coeffList ht
  have h4 : 0 < 2*t - 1 := by linarith
  have h3 : -2*t^3*(2*t-3) < 0 := by
    have hp : 0 < 2*t^3 := by positivity
    have hq : 0 < 2*t-3 := by linarith
    nlinarith [mul_pos hp hq]
  have h2 : -t^2*(t-1)*(5*t+1) < 0 := by
    have hp : 0 < t^2 := by positivity
    have hq1 : 0 < t-1 := by linarith
    have hq2 : 0 < 5*t+1 := by linarith
    nlinarith [mul_pos hp (mul_pos hq1 hq2)]
  have h1 : 0 < 2*t^3*(t^3-2*t^2-t+1) := by
    have hid : t^3-2*t^2-t+1 = (t-4)*(t^2+2*t+7) + 29 := by ring
    rw [hid]
    have hu : 0 ≤ t-4 := by linarith
    have hv : 0 < t^2+2*t+7 := by positivity
    have hi : 0 < (t-4)*(t^2+2*t+7) + 29 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hu (le_of_lt hv)]
    positivity
  have h0 : 0 < t^5*(t-2) := by
    have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
    exact mul_pos (pow_pos ht0 5) (by linarith)
  have hvar : (qPoly t).signVariations ≤ 2 := by
    simp +decide only [hc, Polynomial.signVariations, List.destutter,
      List.map_cons, sign_pos h4, sign_neg h3, sign_neg h2, sign_pos h1,
      sign_pos h0]
  exact roots_countP_pos_le_two_of_signVariations hvar

name: SRGInequality.qGeneral_pos_implies_integer_range
statement:
lemma qGeneral_pos_implies_integer_range
    {r t : Real} {z w : Int}
    (ht : 4 ≤ t) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hq : 0 < qGeneral r t)
    (hz : (z : Real) = r) (hw : (w : Real) = t) :
    2 * t^3 - 3 * t^2 + 1 ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have ha : t * (t - 2) * (t + 1) < r := by
    dsimp [discriminantC2] at hc2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - t * (t - 2) * (t + 1))]
  have h0 : 0 < (qPoly t).eval 0 := qPoly_at_zero_neg ht
  have haq : (qPoly t).eval (t * (t - 2) * (t + 1)) < 0 := qPoly_at_a_neg ht
  have hSq : (qPoly t).eval (2 * t^3 - 3 * t^2) < 0 := qPoly_at_S_neg ht
  have hqr : 0 < (qPoly t).eval r := by simpa [qPoly_eval] using hq
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have ha0 : 0 < t * (t - 2) * (t + 1) := by
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos ht0 (by linarith)) (by linarith)
  by_contra hnot
  have hrs : r ≤ 2 * t^3 - 3 * t^2 := by
    have hri : r < 2 * t^3 - 3 * t^2 + 1 := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hS : ((2 * w^3 - 3 * w^2 : Int) : Real) = 2 * t^3 - 3 * t^2 := by
      norm_num [hw]
    have hri' : (z : Real) < ((2 * w^3 - 3 * w^2 + 1 : Int) : Real) := by
      rw [hz]
      norm_num [hS]
      exact hri
    have hzlt : z < 2 * w^3 - 3 * w^2 + 1 := by exact_mod_cast hri'
    have hzle' : z ≤ 2 * w^3 - 3 * w^2 := by omega
    have hzle : (z : Real) ≤ ((2 * w^3 - 3 * w^2 : Int) : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hzle'
    rw [hz, hS] at hzle
    exact hzle
  have hrslt : r < 2 * t^3 - 3 * t^2 := by
    by_contra heq
    have heq' : r = 2 * t^3 - 3 * t^2 := le_antisymm hrs (le_of_not_gt heq)
    rw [heq'] at hqr
    linarith
  obtain ⟨x, hx1, hx2, hxr⟩ := exists_root_between_of_sign
    (a := 0) (b := t * (t - 2) * (t + 1)) (by linarith) h0 haq
  obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2, hyr⟩ := exists_root_between_of_sign_rev
    (a := t * (t - 2) * (t + 1)) (b := r) (by linarith) haq hqr
  obtain ⟨z', hz1, hz2, hzr⟩ := exists_root_between_of_sign
    (a := r) (b := 2 * t^3 - 3 * t^2) hrslt hqr hSq
  have hrootcount := qPoly_rootcount ht
  have hxyz : x ≠ y := by linarith
  have hxz : x ≠ z' := by linarith
  have hyz : y ≠ z' := by linarith
  have hn : (qPoly t).natDegree = 4 := by
    change (C (2*t - 1) * X^4 + C (-2*t^3*(2*t-3)) * X^3 +
      C (-t^2*(t-1)*(5*t+1)) * X^2 +
      C (2*t^3*(t^3-2*t^2-t+1)) * X + C (t^5*(t-2))).natDegree = 4
    exact quartic_natDegree_of_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
      (a4 := 2*t - 1) (a3 := -2*t^3*(2*t-3))
      (a2 := -t^2*(t-1)*(5*t+1))
      (a1 := 2*t^3*(t^3-2*t^2-t+1)) (a0 := t^5*(t-2)) (by linarith)
  have hP : qPoly t ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hn
    simp at hn
  have hthree := count_three_positive_roots hP hxr hyr hzr
    hx1 (lt_trans ha0 hy1) (by linarith) hxyz hxz hyz
  omega

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_unequal_external_bounds
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_unequal_external_bounds
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)))
    (_hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hfg : Not (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit := srg_integer_gap_three_way_real G h hc hne hfg _hr
  have hint := srg_restrictedPos_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg
  let z : Int := Classical.choose hint
  have hz : (z : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu := Classical.choose_spec hint
  have hintNeg := srg_restrictedNeg_integer_of_unequal_multiplicities G h hc hne hfg
  let w : Int := -Classical.choose hintNeg
  have hwNeg : ((Classical.choose hintNeg : Int) : Real) = restrictedNeg k lambda mu :=
    Classical.choose_spec hintNeg
  have hw : (w : Real) = -restrictedNeg k lambda mu := by
    dsimp [w]
    norm_num [hwNeg]
  rcases hsplit with ht2 | ht3 | ht4
  · exact srg_target_of_t2_unequal_integer_route G h hc hne hfg _hr ht2 hK hA
  · exact srg_target_of_t3_external_bounds G h hc hne _hr ht3 hK hA hfg
  · have ht4r : (4 : Real) ≤ -restrictedNeg k lambda mu := ht4
    have hc2 : 0 ≤ discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ∨
        discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0 := by
      exact le_or_gt 0 _
    rcases hc2 with hc2pos | hc2neg
    · exact srg_target_of_c2_nonneg G h hc hne _hr
        (by linarith [ht4r]) hc2pos
    · have hk : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu *
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) + (mu : Real) := by
        simpa [add_comm] using
          (degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne)
      rcases le_or_gt (qGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) 0 with hq | hq
      · apply srg_target_of_integer_case_certificate_graph G h hc hne
          (by linarith [ht4r]) _hr
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl
          ⟨by linarith [ht4r], hc2neg, hK, hk, hq⟩)))
      · have hr0 : 2 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 3 -
            3 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 + 1 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu := by
          exact qGeneral_pos_implies_integer_range (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu)
            (t := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (z := z) (w := w)
            (by linarith [ht4r]) _hr hc2neg hq hz hw
        exact srg_target_of_general_q_pos_nonstrict_auto G h hc hne _hr
          (by linarith [ht4r]) hr0 hc2neg hK hq hA

name: SRGInequality.srg_target
statement:
theorem srg_target
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hcertificate :
      Or
        (ArithmeticCase (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) (k : Real))
        ((-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 *
          (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
          ((positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) + 1) -
          (v : Real) * k = 0)) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  exact srg_target_of_verified_cases_or_gap_zero G h hc hne ht0 hr hcertificate

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_complete_external_bounds
statement:
theorem srg_target_complete_external_bounds
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)^2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hfg : positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  · exact srg_target_of_equal_external_bounds G h hc hne hr hfg
  · exact srg_target_of_unequal_external_bounds G h hc hne hr hfg hK hA

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_restrictedPos_zero
statement:
theorem srg_target_restrictedPos_zero
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)))
    (hr0 : restrictedPos k lambda mu = 0) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)^2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hkposNat := degree_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hkpos : 0 < (k : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hkposNat
  have hvNat : 0 < v := by
    obtain ⟨a, b, hneab, hab⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
    have hnotuniv : ¬ G.IsUniversal a := by
      intro ha
      exact hab (ha hneab)
    have hdeg := (G.degree_lt_card_sub_one a).mpr hnotuniv
    rw [h.card] at hdeg
    have hvk : k < v - 1 := by simpa [h.regular.degree_eq] using hdeg
    omega
  have hvpos : 0 < (v : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hvNat
  have hmu : mu = k := srg_restrictedPos_zero_implies_mu_eq_degree G h hc hne hr0
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨hpart, htrace, _, hsum, _⟩
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have ht : 0 < t := by
    dsimp [t]
    have hgap := restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
    linarith [hgap]
  have hkg : (k : Real) = g * t := by
    dsimp [t, g]
    rw [hr0] at htrace
    nlinarith [htrace]
  have hlam : (lambda : Real) = (k : Real) - t := by
    dsimp [t] at hsum ⊢
    rw [hr0] at hsum
    norm_num [hmu] at hsum ⊢
    linarith
  have hvrel : (v : Real) = (k : Real) + t := by
    have hp := srg_parameter_identity G h hvNat
    norm_num [hmu, hlam] at hp
    have hkne : (k : Real) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hkpos
    nlinarith [hp]
  have htg : t ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht
  have hgt : 0 ≤ g := by positivity
  have hlamlt : lambda < k := lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have htk : ((k - lambda : Nat) : Real) = t := by
    have hsum' := hsum
    rw [hr0] at hsum'
    have hmuR : (mu : Real) = k := by exact_mod_cast hmu
    rw [hmuR] at hsum'
    dsimp [t]
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hlamlt)]
    norm_num at hsum'
    linarith
  have htone : (2 : Real) ≤ t := by
    have htge : (1 : Real) ≤ t := by
      have hsub : 1 ≤ k - lambda := Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt.mpr hlamlt
      have hsubR : (1 : Real) ≤ ((k - lambda : Nat) : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hsub
      rw [htk] at hsubR
      exact hsubR
    have htne : t ≠ 1 := by
      intro ht1
      obtain ⟨a, b, hneab, hab⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
      have hnotuniv : ¬ G.IsUniversal a := by
        intro ha
        exact hab (ha hneab)
      have hdeg := (G.degree_lt_card_sub_one a).mpr hnotuniv
      rw [h.card] at hdeg
      have hvk : v = k + 1 := by
        have hvreal := hvrel
        rw [ht1] at hvreal
        exact_mod_cast hvreal
      have hreg := h.regular.degree_eq a
      rw [hvk] at hdeg
      simp [hreg] at hdeg
    have hneq : k - lambda ≠ 1 := by
      intro heq
      apply htne
      calc
        t = ((k - lambda : Nat) : Real) := htk.symm
        _ = 1 := by norm_num [heq]
    have hsub2 : 2 ≤ k - lambda := by omega
    rw [← htk]
    exact_mod_cast hsub2
  have htarget : (v : Real) * k / t^2 ≤ g * ((v : Real) - g) := by
    rw [hvrel, hkg]
    field_simp [htg]
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hgt (by linarith : 0 ≤ t - 1),
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg g) (by linarith : 0 ≤ t - 2)]
  simpa [t, g] using htarget

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_complete_external_bounds_auto
statement:
theorem srg_target_complete_external_bounds_auto
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)))
    (hK : Not (restrictedPos k lambda mu = (k : Real)) ->
      Not (restrictedNeg k lambda mu = -1) ->
      BookKreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hA : PrimitiveSRG G ->
      AbsoluteBound (v : Real)
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)^2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  rcases srg_restrictedPos_zero_or_positive G h hc hne with hr0 | hr
  · exact srg_target_restrictedPos_zero G h hc hne hr0
  · have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
    have hrne : Not (restrictedPos k lambda mu = (k : Real)) := by
      intro heq
      exact restrictedPos_ne_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne heq.symm
    have hsne : Not (restrictedNeg k lambda mu = -1) := by
      exact srg_restrictedNeg_ne_neg_one (G := G) h hc hne
    have hkposNat := degree_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
    have hkpos : 0 < (k : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hkposNat
    have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
    have hsum := hs.2.2.2.1
    have hvNat : 0 < v := by
      obtain ⟨a, b, hneab, hab⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
      have hnotuniv : ¬ G.IsUniversal a := by
        intro ha
        exact hab (ha hneab)
      have hdeg := (G.degree_lt_card_sub_one a).mpr hnotuniv
      rw [h.card] at hdeg
      have hvk : k < v - 1 := by simpa [h.regular.degree_eq] using hdeg
      omega
    have hkrel : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu *
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) + (mu : Real) := by
      simpa [add_comm] using degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne
    have htpos : 0 < -restrictedNeg k lambda mu := by
      have hprod := hs.2.2.2.2
      have hmu_le : (mu : Real) ≤ (k : Real) := by
        exact_mod_cast mu_le_degree_of_ne_complete G h hne
      have hsnonpos : restrictedNeg k lambda mu ≤ 0 := by
        by_contra hn
        have hspos : 0 < restrictedNeg k lambda mu := lt_of_not_ge hn
        have hprodpos : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu :=
          mul_pos hr hspos
        nlinarith [hprod, hmu_le]
      by_contra hn
      have hsnonneg : 0 ≤ restrictedNeg k lambda mu := by
        linarith
      have hsz : restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0 :=
        le_antisymm hsnonpos hsnonneg
      have hlam := lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
      nlinarith [hsum, hsz, hr, hlam, hkrel]
    have hK' : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) := by
      have hh := hK hrne hsne
      dsimp [KreinBound, BookKreinBound] at hh ⊢
      nlinarith [hh]
    have hprim : PrimitiveSRG G := by
      by_contra hnp
      have hcmp := nonprimitive_srg_is_complete_multipartite h hc hnp
      have hmu_eq : mu = k :=
        complete_multipartite_srg_mu_eq_degree h hcmp hne
      have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
      have hprod := hs.2.2.2.2
      have hsum := hs.2.2.2.1
      have hlam := lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
      have hs0 : restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0 := by
        have hzero : restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0 := by
          calc
            restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu =
                (mu : Real) - k := hprod
            _ = 0 := by norm_num [hmu_eq]
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hzero with hr0 | hs0
        · exfalso
          exact (ne_of_gt hr) hr0
        · exact hs0
      have hlamR : (lambda : Real) < (k : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hlam
      have hmuR : (mu : Real) = (k : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hmu_eq
      nlinarith [hsum, hs0, hlamR, hmuR]
    exact srg_target_complete_external_bounds G h hc hne hr hK' (hA hprim)

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_strict_certificate
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_strict_certificate
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (ht : 0 < -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (hstrict :
      0 < absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hdisc : LE.le 0 (discriminantQuadratic (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)))
    (hzero : LE.le 0 (discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) 0))
    (hrootcount :
      (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)).roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x) ≤ 2)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
        (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) < 0)
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
        (muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) < 0)
    (hcases :
      Or
        (LE.le (mu : Real)
          (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
            (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)))
        (And
          (0 < muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
            (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
          (And
            (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
              (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < (mu : Real))
            ((mu : Real) < muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
              (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)))))
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  have part := hs.1
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast part
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - (v : Real) * k =
      discriminantPoly r t (mu : Real) * auxiliaryPoly r t (mu : Real) /
        ((mu : Real) ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2) := by
    dsimp [r, t, f, g]
    exact srg_gap_factorization G h hc hne (by exact ne_of_gt ht)
  have hout := target_of_strict_absolute_case hr ht hmu hv hgap
    (by simpa [r, t] using hc2) (by simpa [r, t] using hc0)
    (by simpa [r, t] using hdisc) (by simpa [r, t] using hzero)
    hrootcount (by simpa [r, t] using hA0)
    (by simpa [r, t] using hAplus)
    (by simpa [r, t] using hstrict)
    (by simpa [r, t] using hAK)
    (by simpa [r, t] using hcases) hN
  simpa [r, t, f, g] using hout

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_q_pos_strict_range
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_q_pos_strict_range
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
     (ht4 : 4 <= -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (hr0 : 2 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 3 -
      3 * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 + 1 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hsign : Or (0 < generalA1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
      (And (LE.le (generalA2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) 0)
        (generalA1 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0)))
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hk : (k : Real) = restrictedPos k lambda mu *
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) + mu)
    (hQ : 0 < qGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
        (muPlusFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) < 0)
    (hstrict : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
        (muKFormula (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) < 0)
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  have part := hs.1
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast part
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - (v : Real) * k =
      discriminantPoly r t (mu : Real) * auxiliaryPoly r t (mu : Real) /
        ((mu : Real) ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2) := by
    dsimp [r, t, f, g]
    have htpos : 0 < -restrictedNeg k lambda mu := by linarith
    exact srg_gap_factorization G h hc hne (ne_of_gt htpos)
  have htpos : 0 < t := by dsimp [t]; linarith
  have hout := target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_q_pos_range hr htpos hmu hv hgap
    ht4 hr0 hsign hc2 hK hk hQ hA0 hAplus hstrict hAK hN
  simpa [r, t, f, g] using hout

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_multiplicity_or_arithmetic_certificate
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_multiplicity_or_arithmetic_certificate
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hc : G.Connected)
    (hne : Not (G = ⊤))
    (ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hcert :
      Or
        (And
          (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
            negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
          (Exists (fun w : Real =>
            1 < w ∧ w ^ 2 = (v : Real) ∧
            ((lambda : Real) - mu = -1) ∧
            (2 * (k : Real) = (v : Real) - 1) ∧
            (4 * (mu : Real) = (v : Real) - 1))))
        (Or
          (ArithmeticCase (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
            (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) (k : Real))
          ((-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 *
            (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
            ((positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) + 1) -
            (v : Real) * k = 0))) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  cases hcert with
  | inl hconf =>
    have hfg := hconf.1
    have hex := hconf.2
    let w : Real := Classical.choose hex
    have hwcon := Classical.choose_spec hex
    have hw := hwcon.1
    have hv := hwcon.2.1
    have hrel := hwcon.2.2.1
    have hk := hwcon.2.2.2.1
    have hmu := hwcon.2.2.2.2
    exact srg_target_of_conference_certificate G h hc hne hfg hw hv hrel hk hmu
  | inr hrest =>
    exact srg_target_of_verified_cases_or_gap_zero G h hc hne ht0 hr hrest

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_coeff_expansion
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_coeff_expansion (r t mu : Real) :
    absolutePolyGeneral r t mu =
      generalA4 r t * mu ^ 4 + generalA3 r t * mu ^ 3 +
        generalA2 r t * mu ^ 2 + generalA1 r t * mu + generalA0 r t
proof:
:= by
  simp [absolutePolyGeneral, generalA4, generalA3, generalA2, generalA1, generalA0]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_division_certificate
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_division_certificate
    {r t mu : Real} (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t ≠ 0) :
    let a4 := generalA4 r t
    let a3 := generalA3 r t
    let a2 := generalA2 r t
    let a1 := generalA1 r t
    let a0 := generalA0 r t
    let c2 := discriminantC2 r t
    let c1 := discriminantC1 r t
    let c0 := discriminantC0 r t
    let q2 := a4 / c2
    let q1 := (a3 - q2 * c1) / c2
    let q0 := (a2 - q2 * c0 - q1 * c1) / c2
    let r1 := a1 - q1 * c0 - q0 * c1
    let r0 := a0 - q0 * c0
    absolutePolyGeneral r t mu =
      (q2 * mu ^ 2 + q1 * mu + q0) *
          (discriminantC2 r t * mu ^ 2 + discriminantC1 r t * mu + discriminantC0 r t) +
        r1 * mu + r0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp
  rw [absolutePolyGeneral_coeff_expansion]
  exact quartic_division_certificate hc2

name: SRGInequality.remainder_at_quadratic_vertex_neg
statement:
lemma remainder_at_quadratic_vertex_neg
    {c2 c1 R1 R0 delta n1 n0 W : Real}
    (hc2 : c2 < 0) (hdelta : delta = -c2)
    (hn1 : n1 = delta ^ 3 * R1) (hn0 : n0 = delta ^ 3 * R0)
    (hW : W = 2 * c2 * n0 - c1 * n1) (hWpos : 0 < W) :
    R1 * (-c1 / (2 * c2)) + R0 < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdelta_pos : 0 < delta := by linarith
  have hden : 2 * c2 * delta ^ 3 < 0 := by
    have hpow : 0 < delta ^ 3 := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hc2ne : c2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hc2
  have hid : R1 * (-c1 / (2 * c2)) + R0 = W / (2 * c2 * delta ^ 3) := by
    rw [hW, hn1, hn0]
    field_simp [hc2ne, ne_of_gt hdelta_pos]
    ring
  rw [hid]
  exact div_neg_of_pos_of_neg hWpos hden

name: SRGInequality.linear_remainder_neg_of_ge_vertex
statement:
lemma linear_remainder_neg_of_ge_vertex
    {R1 R0 muC x : Real} (hR1 : R1 < 0)
    (hvertex : R1 * muC + R0 < 0) (horder : muC ≤ x) :
    R1 * x + R0 < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmono : R1 * x ≤ R1 * muC := by
    nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.generalA3_neg_bridge
proof:
:= by
  simpa [generalA3] using absolutePolyGeneral_a3_neg_of_range ht hr

name: SRGInequality.generalA2_nonpos_bridge
proof:
:= by
  simpa [generalA2] using absolutePolyGeneral_a2_nonpos_of_range ht hr

name: SRGInequality.generalA1_pos_bridge
statement:
lemma generalA1_pos_bridge {r t : Real}
    (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr0 : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 ≤ r)
    (hr1 : r ≤ 2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t) :
    0 < generalA1 r t
proof:
:= by
  simpa [generalA1] using absolutePolyGeneral_a1_pos_of_range ht hr0 hr1

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_nonneg_of_absolute_gap
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_nonneg_of_absolute_gap
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hk : k = r * t + mu)
    (hf : f = k * (t - 1) * (k + t) / (mu * (r + t)))
    (hg : g = (k + f * r) / t)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hmu : mu ≠ 0) (hrt : r + t ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hgap : 0 ≤ f * (f + 3) - 2 * v) :
    0 ≤ absolutePolyGeneral r t mu
proof:
:= by
  rw [absolutePolyGeneral_formula_identity hk hf hg hv hmu hrt ht]
  have hsq : 0 ≤ mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2 := by positivity
  exact mul_nonneg hsq hgap

name: SRGInequality.F_certificate_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hu : 0 ≤ t - 4 := by linarith
  have hp : 0 ≤ r - (2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2) := by linarith
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  dsimp [F_certificate]
  positivity

name: SRGInequality.G_certificate_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hu : 0 ≤ t - 4 := by linarith
  have hp : 0 ≤ r - (2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2) := by linarith
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  dsimp [G_certificate]
  positivity

name: SRGInequality.general_n1_factor
statement:
lemma general_n1_factor
    {r t : Real} (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t ≠ 0) :
    -generalN1 r t = t ^ 2 * (r + 1) * (r + t) ^ 2 * F_certificate r t
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [generalN1, generalR1, generalQ1, generalQ2, generalQ0,
    generalA4, generalA3, generalA2, generalA1, generalA0, F_certificate]
  field_simp [hc2]
  simp [discriminantC2, discriminantC1, discriminantC0]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.general_W_factor
statement:
lemma general_W_factor
    {r t : Real} (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t ≠ 0) :
    generalW r t = t ^ 3 * (r + 1) ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2 * G_certificate r t
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [generalW, generalN0, generalN1, generalR0, generalR1,
    generalQ1, generalQ2, generalQ0,
    generalA4, generalA3, generalA2, generalA1, generalA0, G_certificate]
  field_simp [hc2]
  simp [discriminantC2, discriminantC1, discriminantC0]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.general_n1_neg_of_range
statement:
lemma general_n1_neg_of_range
    {r t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 ≤ r)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t ≠ 0) :
    generalN1 r t < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
    have : 0 < 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    linarith
  have hrt : 0 < r + t := by linarith
  have hF := F_certificate_pos ht hr
  have hpos : 0 < t ^ 2 * (r + 1) * (r + t) ^ 2 * F_certificate r t := by
    positivity
  have hfac := general_n1_factor hc2
  nlinarith [hfac, hpos]

name: SRGInequality.general_W_pos_of_range
statement:
lemma general_W_pos_of_range
    {r t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 ≤ r)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t ≠ 0) :
    0 < generalW r t
proof:
:= by
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
    have : 0 < 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    linarith
  have hrt : 0 < r + t := by linarith
  have hG := G_certificate_pos ht hr
  rw [general_W_factor hc2]
  positivity

name: SRGInequality.no_strict_middle_for_quartic
statement:
lemma no_strict_middle_for_quartic
    {P : Polynomial Real} {muPlus mu muK : Real}
    (hrootcount : P.roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ 2)
    (hzero : 0 < P.eval 0) (hplus : P.eval muPlus < 0)
    (hmid : 0 < P.eval mu) (hK : P.eval muK < 0)
    (horder : 0 < muPlus ∧ muPlus < mu ∧ mu < muK) : False
proof:
:= by
  exact impossible_four_sign_changes_of_quartic hrootcount horder.1
    horder.2.1 horder.2.2 hzero hplus hmid hK

name: SRGInequality.general_remainder_vertex_neg_of_range
statement:
lemma general_remainder_vertex_neg_of_range
    {r t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 ≤ r)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0) :
    generalR1 r t *
        (-discriminantC1 r t / (2 * discriminantC2 r t)) +
      generalR0 r t < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc2ne : discriminantC2 r t ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt hc2
  have hW : 0 < generalW r t := general_W_pos_of_range ht hr hc2ne
  refine remainder_at_quadratic_vertex_neg
    (c2 := discriminantC2 r t) (c1 := discriminantC1 r t)
    (R1 := generalR1 r t) (R0 := generalR0 r t)
    (delta := -discriminantC2 r t) (n1 := generalN1 r t)
    (n0 := generalN0 r t) (W := generalW r t)
    hc2 (by rfl) (by rfl) (by rfl) ?_ hW
  rfl

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_not_strict_middle
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_not_strict_middle
    {r t muPlus mu muK : Real}
    (hrootcount : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ 2)
    (hzero : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t muPlus < 0)
    (hmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hK : absolutePolyGeneral r t muK < 0)
    (horder : 0 < muPlus ∧ muPlus < mu ∧ mu < muK) : False
proof:
:= by
  apply no_strict_middle_for_quartic hrootcount
  · simpa [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval] using hzero
  · simpa [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval] using hplus
  · simpa [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval] using hmu
  · simpa [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval] using hK
  · exact horder

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_at_muK_formula
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_at_muK_formula
    {r t : Real} (hE : energyE r t ≠ 0) :
    absolutePolyGeneral r t (muKFormula r t) =
      -4 * r ^ 3 * (r + 1) * (r + t) ^ 3 * (t - 1) ^ 2 *
        G1Formula r t * G2Formula r t / (energyE r t) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [absolutePolyGeneral, muKFormula, G1Formula, G2Formula]
  field_simp [hE]
  simp [energyE]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_at_muK_neg
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_at_muK_neg
    {r t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 ≤ r)
    (hE : 0 < energyE r t) :
    absolutePolyGeneral r t (muKFormula r t) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by
    have hs : 0 < 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 := by nlinarith
    linarith
  have hrt : 0 < r + t := by linarith
  have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  have hG1 : 0 < G1Formula r t := by
    dsimp [G1Formula]
    linarith
  have hG2 : 0 < G2Formula r t := by
    dsimp [G2Formula]
    have : 0 < 2 * t - 1 := by linarith
    nlinarith
  rw [absolutePolyGeneral_at_muK_formula (ne_of_gt hE)]
  have hden : 0 < (energyE r t) ^ 4 := by positivity
  have hp : 0 < 4 * r ^ 3 * (r + 1) * (r + t) ^ 3 *
      (t - 1) ^ 2 * G1Formula r t * G2Formula r t := by positivity
  exact div_neg_of_neg_of_pos (by nlinarith) hden

name: SRGInequality.discriminantPoly_at_muPlus_zero
statement:
lemma discriminantPoly_at_muPlus_zero
    {r t : Real} (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t ≠ 0)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t) :
    discriminantPoly r t (muPlusFormula r t) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [discriminantPoly_expand]
  dsimp [muPlusFormula]
  have hs : (Real.sqrt (discriminantQuadratic r t)) ^ 2 =
      discriminantQuadratic r t := by
    exact Real.sq_sqrt hdisc
  field_simp [hc2]
  dsimp [discriminantQuadratic] at hs ⊢
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.muPlus_pos_of_c2_neg_c0_pos
statement:
lemma muPlus_pos_of_c2_neg_c0_pos
    {r t : Real} (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t) :
    0 < muPlusFormula r t
proof:
:= by
  have hgt : discriminantC1 r t ^ 2 < discriminantQuadratic r t := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith
  have hs : (Real.sqrt (discriminantQuadratic r t)) ^ 2 =
      discriminantQuadratic r t := Real.sq_sqrt hdisc
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (discriminantQuadratic r t) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsp : -discriminantC1 r t < Real.sqrt (discriminantQuadratic r t) := by
    nlinarith
  have hden : 2 * discriminantC2 r t < 0 := by linarith
  dsimp [muPlusFormula]
  exact div_pos_of_neg_of_neg (by linarith) hden

name: SRGInequality.muMinus_neg_of_c2_neg_c0_pos
statement:
lemma muMinus_neg_of_c2_neg_c0_pos
    {r t : Real} (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t) :
    muMinusFormula r t < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hgt : discriminantC1 r t ^ 2 < discriminantQuadratic r t := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith
  have hs : (Real.sqrt (discriminantQuadratic r t)) ^ 2 =
      discriminantQuadratic r t := Real.sq_sqrt hdisc
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (discriminantQuadratic r t) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsp : discriminantC1 r t < Real.sqrt (discriminantQuadratic r t) := by
    nlinarith
  have hden : 2 * discriminantC2 r t < 0 := by linarith
  dsimp [muMinusFormula]
  exact div_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) hden

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_nonneg_up_to_muPlus
statement:
lemma discriminant_nonneg_up_to_muPlus
    {r t mu : Real} (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t)
    (hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0)
    (hmu : 0 ≤ mu)
    (horder : mu ≤ muPlusFormula r t) :
    0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t mu
proof:
:= by
  have hc2le : discriminantC2 r t ≤ 0 := le_of_lt hc2
  have hLpos : 0 < muPlusFormula r t :=
    muPlus_pos_of_c2_neg_c0_pos hc2 hc0 hdisc
  have hLzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t (muPlusFormula r t) := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_muPlus_zero (ne_of_lt hc2) hdisc]
  exact discriminant_nonneg_of_concave_threshold hc2le hmu horder hzero hLzero hLpos

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_at_muK_neg_of_q_pos
statement:
lemma discriminant_at_muK_neg_of_q_pos
    {r t : Real} (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 1 < t)
    (hE : 0 < energyE r t) (hQ : 0 < qGeneral r t) :
    discriminantPoly r t (muKFormula r t) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hid := discriminant_krein_identity (r := r) (t := t) (ne_of_gt hE)
  have hfac : 0 < r * (r + t) * (t - 1) * qGeneral r t := by
    have hrt : 0 < r + t := by linarith
    positivity
  have hEsq : 0 < (energyE r t) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hident :
      discriminantPoly r t (muKFormula r t) * (energyE r t) ^ 2 =
        -r * (r + t) * (t - 1) * qGeneral r t := by
    simpa [muKFormula, energyE] using hid
  nlinarith [hident]

name: SRGInequality.muPlus_lt_muK_of_q_pos
statement:
lemma muPlus_lt_muK_of_q_pos
    {r t : Real} (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 1 < t)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t)
    (hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0)
    (hE : 0 < energyE r t) (hQ : 0 < qGeneral r t)
    (hmuK : 0 ≤ muKFormula r t) :
    muPlusFormula r t < muKFormula r t
proof:
:= by
  have hneg := discriminant_at_muK_neg_of_q_pos hr ht hE hQ
  have hnot : ¬ muKFormula r t ≤ muPlusFormula r t := by
    intro hle
    have hnonneg := discriminant_nonneg_up_to_muPlus hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero
      hmuK hle
    linarith
  exact lt_of_not_ge hnot

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_negative_conflicts_with_absolute_middle
statement:
lemma discriminant_negative_conflicts_with_absolute_middle
    {r t mu muPlus muK : Real}
    (_hDneg : discriminantPoly r t mu < 0)
    (hrootcount : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ 2)
    (hzero : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t muPlus < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hK : absolutePolyGeneral r t muK < 0)
    (horder : 0 < muPlus ∧ muPlus < mu ∧ mu < muK) : False
proof:
:= by
  exact absolutePolyGeneral_not_strict_middle hrootcount hzero hplus hAmu hK horder

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_nonneg_of_absolute_cases
statement:
lemma discriminant_nonneg_of_absolute_cases
    {r t mu _muPlus muK : Real}
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t)
    (hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0)
    (hmu : 0 ≤ mu)
    (hrootcount : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ 2)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral r t muK < 0)
    (hcases : mu ≤ muPlusFormula r t ∨
      (0 < muPlusFormula r t ∧ muPlusFormula r t < mu ∧ mu < muK)) :
    0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t mu
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcases with hleft | hright
  · exact discriminant_nonneg_up_to_muPlus hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero hmu hleft
  · exfalso
    exact absolutePolyGeneral_not_strict_middle hrootcount hA0 hAplus hAmu hAK hright

name: SRGInequality.quartic_natDegree_of_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
statement:
lemma quartic_natDegree_of_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
    {a4 a3 a2 a1 a0 : Real} (h4 : Not (a4 = 0)) :
    (C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X + C a0).natDegree = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hp4 : (C a4 * X ^ 4).natDegree = 4 :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow 4 a4 h4
  have hp3 : LE.le (C a3 * X ^ 3).natDegree 3 := by
    by_cases h : a3 = 0
    case pos => simp [h]
    case neg => rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow 3 a3 h]
  have h43 : (C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3).natDegree = 4 := by
    have hlt : (C a3 * X ^ 3).natDegree < (C a4 * X ^ 4).natDegree := by
      rw [hp4]
      omega
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_add_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt hlt]
    exact hp4
  have hp2 : LE.le (C a2 * X ^ 2).natDegree 2 := by
    by_cases h : a2 = 0
    case pos => simp [h]
    case neg => rw [Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow 2 a2 h]
  have h432 : (C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2).natDegree = 4 := by
    have hlt : (C a2 * X ^ 2).natDegree <
        (C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3).natDegree := by
      rw [h43]
      omega
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_add_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt hlt]
    exact h43
  have hp1 : LE.le (C a1 * X).natDegree 1 := by
    by_cases h : a1 = 0
    case pos => simp [h]
    case neg =>
      exact le_of_eq (by simpa [pow_one] using
        (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_X_pow 1 a1 h))
  have h4321 :
      (C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X).natDegree = 4 := by
    have hlt : (C a1 * X).natDegree <
        (C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2).natDegree := by
      rw [h432]
      omega
    rw [Polynomial.natDegree_add_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt hlt]
    exact h432
  have hp0 : LE.le (C a0).natDegree 0 := by
    by_cases h : a0 = 0
    case pos => simp [h]
    case neg => simp [Polynomial.natDegree_C]
  have hlt : (C a0).natDegree <
      (C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X).natDegree := by
    rw [h4321]
    omega
  rw [Polynomial.natDegree_add_eq_left_of_natDegree_lt hlt]
  exact h4321

name: SRGInequality.quartic_coeffList_of_coefficients
statement:
lemma quartic_coeffList_of_coefficients
    {a4 a3 a2 a1 a0 : Real} (h4 : Not (a4 = 0)) :
    (C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X + C a0).coeffList =
      [a4, a3, a2, a1, a0]
proof:
:= by
  have hd := quartic_natDegree_of_leadingCoeff_ne_zero
    (a3 := a3) (a2 := a2) (a1 := a1) (a0 := a0) h4
  have hnz : Not (C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X + C a0 = 0) := by
    intro hz
    have hcoeff := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial Real => p.coeff 4) hz
    apply h4
    simpa [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow] using hcoeff
  rw [Polynomial.coeffList, Polynomial.degree_eq_natDegree hnz, hd]
  change [((C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X + C a0).coeff 4),
    ((C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X + C a0).coeff 3),
    ((C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X + C a0).coeff 2),
    ((C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X + C a0).coeff 1),
    ((C a4 * X ^ 4 + C a3 * X ^ 3 + C a2 * X ^ 2 + C a1 * X + C a0).coeff 0)] =
      [a4, a3, a2, a1, a0]
  simp [Polynomial.coeff_add]

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_coeffList
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_coeffList
    {r t : Real} (ht : 1 < t) :
    (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).coeffList =
      [generalA4 r t, generalA3 r t, generalA2 r t, generalA1 r t, generalA0 r t]
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : Not (generalA4 r t = 0) := by
    dsimp [generalA4]
    nlinarith
  have hcoeff := quartic_coeffList_of_coefficients
    (a4 := generalA4 r t) (a3 := generalA3 r t) (a2 := generalA2 r t)
    (a1 := generalA1 r t) (a0 := generalA0 r t) h4
  simpa [absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial, generalA4, generalA3, generalA2,
    generalA1, generalA0] using hcoeff

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_range
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_range
    {r t : Real} (hr : 0 < r) (ht : LE.le 4 t)
    (hr0 : LE.le (2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t) r) :
    LE.le ((absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x)) 2
proof:
:= by
  apply absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a2_nonpos
    (hcoeff := by
      simpa [generalA4, generalA3, generalA2, generalA1, generalA0] using
        (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_coeffList (r := r) (t := t) (by linarith)))
    hr ht hr0

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_pos_range
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_pos_range
    {r t : Real} (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 1 < t)
    (ha3 : generalA3 r t < 0) (ha1 : 0 < generalA1 r t) :
    LE.le ((absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x)) 2
proof:
:= by
  apply absolutePolyGeneral_positive_root_count_le_two_pos_a1
    (hcoeff := by
      simpa [generalA4, generalA3, generalA2, generalA1, generalA0] using
        (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_coeffList (r := r) (t := t) (by linarith)))
    hr ht
  · change generalA3 r t < 0
    exact ha3
  · change 0 < generalA1 r t
    exact ha1

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_neg_range
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_neg_range
    {r t : Real} (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 1 < t)
    (ha3 : generalA3 r t < 0) (ha2 : LE.le (generalA2 r t) 0)
    (ha1 : generalA1 r t < 0) :
    LE.le ((absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x)) 2
proof:
:= by
  apply absolutePolyGeneral_positive_root_count_le_two_neg_a1
    (hcoeff := by
      simpa [generalA4, generalA3, generalA2, generalA1, generalA0] using
        (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_coeffList (r := r) (t := t) (by linarith)))
    hr ht
  · change generalA3 r t < 0
    exact ha3
  · change LE.le (generalA2 r t) 0
    exact ha2
  · change generalA1 r t < 0
    exact ha1

name: SRGInequality.roots_countP_pos_le_two_of_signVariations
statement:
lemma roots_countP_pos_le_two_of_signVariations
    {P : Polynomial Real}
    (hvar : LE.le P.signVariations 2) :
    LE.le (P.roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x)) 2
proof:
:= by
  exact le_trans (Polynomial.roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations P) hvar

name: SRGInequality.integral_rational_is_integer
statement:
lemma integral_rational_is_integer
    {x : Complex} (hx : IsIntegral Int x) (hxr : ∃q : Rat, x = q) :
    ∃z : Int, x = z
proof:
:= by
  exact hx.exists_int_iff_exists_rat.mp hxr

name: SRGInequality.int_cast_add_one_le_of_real_lt
statement:
lemma int_cast_add_one_le_of_real_lt
    {s z : Int} (h : (s : Real) < (z : Real)) :
    (s : Real) + 1 ≤ (z : Real)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : s < z := by exact_mod_cast h
  have hz' : s + 1 ≤ z := by omega
  exact_mod_cast hz'

name: SRGInequality.quartic_signVariations_le_two
statement:
lemma quartic_signVariations_le_two
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a4 a3 a2 a1 a0 : Real}
    (hcoeff : P.coeffList = [a4, a3, a2, a1, a0])
    (ha4 : 0 < a4) (ha3 : a3 < 0) (ha1 : 0 < a1) (ha0 : 0 < a0) :
    P.signVariations ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs4 : SignType.sign a4 = 1 := sign_eq_one_iff.mpr ha4
  have hs3 : SignType.sign a3 = -1 := sign_eq_neg_one_iff.mpr ha3
  have hs1 : SignType.sign a1 = 1 := sign_eq_one_iff.mpr ha1
  have hs0 : SignType.sign a0 = 1 := sign_eq_one_iff.mpr ha0
  rw [Polynomial.signVariations, hcoeff]
  rcases lt_trichotomy a2 0 with ha2 | ha2 | ha2
  · have hs2 : SignType.sign a2 = -1 := sign_eq_neg_one_iff.mpr ha2
    simp [hs4, hs3, hs2, hs1, hs0]
    decide

  · subst a2
    simp [hs4, hs3, hs1, hs0]
    decide
  · have hs2 : SignType.sign a2 = 1 := sign_eq_one_iff.mpr ha2
    simp [hs4, hs3, hs2, hs1, hs0]
    decide

name: SRGInequality.quartic_positive_root_count_le_two
statement:
lemma quartic_positive_root_count_le_two
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a4 a3 a2 a1 a0 : Real}
    (hcoeff : P.coeffList = [a4, a3, a2, a1, a0])
    (ha4 : 0 < a4) (ha3 : a3 < 0) (ha1 : 0 < a1) (ha0 : 0 < a0) :
    P.roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    P.roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ P.signVariations :=
      P.roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations
    _ ≤ 2 := quartic_signVariations_le_two hcoeff ha4 ha3 ha1 ha0

name: SRGInequality.quartic_signVariations_le_two_neg_a1
statement:
lemma quartic_signVariations_le_two_neg_a1
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a4 a3 a2 a1 a0 : Real}
    (hcoeff : P.coeffList = [a4, a3, a2, a1, a0])
    (ha4 : 0 < a4) (ha3 : a3 < 0) (ha2 : a2 ≤0)
    (ha1 : a1 < 0) (ha0 : 0 < a0) :
    P.signVariations ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hs4 : SignType.sign a4 = 1 := sign_eq_one_iff.mpr ha4
  have hs3 : SignType.sign a3 = -1 := sign_eq_neg_one_iff.mpr ha3
  have hs1 : SignType.sign a1 = -1 := sign_eq_neg_one_iff.mpr ha1
  have hs0 : SignType.sign a0 = 1 := sign_eq_one_iff.mpr ha0
  rw [Polynomial.signVariations, hcoeff]
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ha2 with ha2 | rfl
  · have hs2 : SignType.sign a2 = -1 := sign_eq_neg_one_iff.mpr ha2
    simp [hs4, hs3, hs2, hs1, hs0]
    decide
  · simp [hs4, hs3, hs1, hs0]
    decide

name: SRGInequality.quartic_signVariations_le_two_of_a2_nonpos
statement:
lemma quartic_signVariations_le_two_of_a2_nonpos
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a4 a3 a2 a1 a0 : Real}
    (hcoeff : P.coeffList = [a4, a3, a2, a1, a0])
    (ha4 : 0 < a4) (ha3 : a3 < 0) (ha2 : a2 ≤0)
    (ha0 : 0 < a0) :
    P.signVariations ≤2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : a1 < 0
  · exact quartic_signVariations_le_two_neg_a1 hcoeff ha4 ha3 ha2 h1 ha0
  by_cases h1z : a1 = 0
  · have hs4 : SignType.sign a4 = 1 := sign_eq_one_iff.mpr ha4
    have hs3 : SignType.sign a3 = -1 := sign_eq_neg_one_iff.mpr ha3
    have hs0 : SignType.sign a0 = 1 := sign_eq_one_iff.mpr ha0
    rw [Polynomial.signVariations, hcoeff]
    subst a1
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le ha2 with ha2 | rfl
    · have hs2 : SignType.sign a2 = -1 := sign_eq_neg_one_iff.mpr ha2
      simp [hs4, hs3, hs2, hs0]
      decide
    · simp [hs4, hs3, hs0]
      decide
  · have h1nonneg : 0 ≤ a1 := le_of_not_gt h1
    have h1pos : 0 < a1 := lt_of_le_of_ne h1nonneg (Ne.symm h1z)
    exact quartic_signVariations_le_two hcoeff ha4 ha3 h1pos ha0

name: SRGInequality.quadratic_nonneg_of_concave_interval
statement:
lemma quadratic_nonneg_of_concave_interval
    {a b c x L : Real}
    (ha : a ≤ 0) (hL : 0 < L) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hxL : x ≤ L)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ c)
    (hLval : 0 ≤ a * L ^ 2 + b * L + c):
    0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c
proof:
:= by
  have hna : 0 ≤ -a := neg_nonneg.mpr ha
  have hLx : 0 ≤ L * x * (L - x) := by positivity
  have hmul : 0 ≤ L * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) := by
    have hid : L * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) =
        (L - x) * c + x * (a * L ^ 2 + b * L + c) +
          (-a) * L * x * (L - x) := by ring
    rw [hid]
    positivity
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3Polynomial_eval
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3Polynomial_eval (r x : Real) :
    (absolutePoly3Polynomial r).eval x = absolutePoly3 r x
proof:
:= by
  simp [absolutePoly3Polynomial, absolutePoly3]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.roots_countP_ge_three_of_distinct
statement:
lemma roots_countP_ge_three_of_distinct
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a b c : Real}
    (ha : a ∈ P.roots) (hb : b ∈ P.roots) (hc : c ∈ P.roots)
    (hapos : 0 < a) (hbpos : 0 < b) (hcpos : 0 < c)
    (hab : a < b) (hac : a < c) (hbc : b < c):
    3 ≤ P.roots.countP (0 < ·)
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle : ({c} : Multiset Real) ≤ P.roots := Multiset.singleton_le.mpr hc
  have hbc' : Multiset.cons b ({c} : Multiset Real) ≤ P.roots := by
    apply (Multiset.cons_le_of_notMem (by simp [ne_of_lt hbc])).2
    exact ⟨hb, hsingle⟩
  have hle : Multiset.cons a (Multiset.cons b ({c} : Multiset Real)) ≤ P.roots := by
    apply (Multiset.cons_le_of_notMem (by simp [ne_of_lt hab, ne_of_lt hac])).2
    exact ⟨ha, hbc'⟩
  have hcount := Multiset.countP_le_of_le (p := (fun x => 0 < x)) hle
  have hleft : 3 ≤ (Multiset.cons a (Multiset.cons b ({c} : Multiset Real))).countP (fun x => 0 < x) := by
    rw [Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos _ hapos, Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos _ hbpos]
    have hs : ({c} : Multiset Real) = Multiset.cons c 0 := rfl
    rw [hs, Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos _ hcpos]
    omega
  exact hleft.trans hcount

name: SRGInequality.exists_root_between_of_eval_neg_pos
statement:
lemma exists_root_between_of_eval_neg_pos
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a b : Real}
    (hab : a < b) (ha : P.eval a < 0) (hb : 0 < P.eval b):
    ∃ x, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ x ∈ P.roots
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (0 : Real) ∈ Set.Ioo (P.eval a) (P.eval b) := ⟨ha, hb⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxeq⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo hab.le P.continuous.continuousOn hz
  have hP : P ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; simp [hzero] at hb
  refine ⟨x, hx.1, hx.2, ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.mem_roots hP]
  exact hxeq

name: SRGInequality.exists_root_between_of_eval_pos_neg
statement:
lemma exists_root_between_of_eval_pos_neg
    {P : Polynomial Real} {a b : Real}
    (hab : a < b) (ha : 0 < P.eval a) (hb : P.eval b < 0):
    ∃ x, a < x ∧ x < b ∧ x ∈ P.roots
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (0 : Real) ∈ Set.Ioo (P.eval b) (P.eval a) := ⟨hb, ha⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxeq⟩ := intermediate_value_Ioo' hab.le P.continuous.continuousOn hz
  have hP : P ≠ 0 := by intro hzero; simp [hzero] at ha
  refine ⟨x, hx.1, hx.2, ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.mem_roots hP]
  exact hxeq

name: SRGInequality.impossible_four_sign_changes_of_quartic
statement:
lemma impossible_four_sign_changes_of_quartic
    {P : Polynomial Real} {x y z : Real}
    (hrootcount : P.roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ 2)
    (hxpos : 0 < x) (hxy : x < y) (hyz : y < z)
    (h0 : 0 < P.eval 0) (hx : P.eval x < 0)
    (hy : 0 < P.eval y) (hz : P.eval z < 0) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hroot1 := exists_root_between_of_eval_pos_neg (P := P) (a := 0) (b := x) hxpos h0 hx
  have hroot2 := exists_root_between_of_eval_neg_pos (P := P) (a := x) (b := y) hxy hx hy
  have hroot3 := exists_root_between_of_eval_pos_neg (P := P) (a := y) (b := z) hyz hy hz
  rcases hroot1 with ⟨a, ha0, hax, ha⟩
  rcases hroot2 with ⟨b, hbx, hby, hb⟩
  rcases hroot3 with ⟨c, hcy, hcz, hc⟩
  have hab : a < b := by linarith
  have hac : a < c := by linarith
  have hbc : b < c := by linarith
  have hthree := roots_countP_ge_three_of_distinct ha hb hc (by linarith) (by linarith) (by linarith) hab hac hbc
  omega

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3_coefficient_signs
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
  have hr1 : 0 < r + 1 := by linarith
  have hA : 0 < r ^ 2 - 21 * r - 12 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 21 / 2 : Real)]
  have hB : 0 < 5 * r ^ 3 - 93 * r ^ 2 - 108 * r - 18 := by
    have hprod : 0 ≤ r ^ 2 * (r - 35) :=
      mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg r) (by linarith)
    nlinarith
  have hC : 0 < 2 * r ^ 2 - 69 * r - 45 := by
    have hlin : 0 < 2 * r - 69 := by linarith
    have hprod : 0 < r * (2 * r - 69) := mul_pos hr0 hlin
    ring_nf at hprod
    nlinarith
  have h4 : 0 < (4 : Real) := by norm_num
  have h3 : -2 * (r ^ 2 - 21 * r - 12) < 0 := by nlinarith
  have h2 : -2 * (5 * r ^ 3 - 93 * r ^ 2 - 108 * r - 18) < 0 := by nlinarith
  have h1 : -6 * r * (r + 1) * (2 * r ^ 2 - 69 * r - 45) < 0 := by
    nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num : (0 : Real) < 6) hr0) (mul_pos hr1 hC)]
  have h0 : 0 < 324 * r ^ 2 * (r + 1) ^ 2 := by positivity
  exact ⟨h4, h3, h2, h1, h0⟩

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3_positive_root_count_le_two
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3_positive_root_count_le_two
    {P : Polynomial Real} {r : Real} (hr : 36 ≤ r)
    (hcoeff : P.coeffList =
      [4, -2 * (r ^ 2 - 21 * r - 12),
        -2 * (5 * r ^ 3 - 93 * r ^ 2 - 108 * r - 18),
        -6 * r * (r + 1) * (2 * r ^ 2 - 69 * r - 45),
        324 * r ^ 2 * (r + 1) ^ 2]) :
    P.roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h4, h3, h2, h1, h0⟩ := absolutePoly3_coefficient_signs hr
  exact le_trans P.roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations
    (quartic_signVariations_le_two_neg_a1 hcoeff h4 h3 (le_of_lt h2) h1 h0)

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3_no_strict_middle
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3_no_strict_middle
    {P : Polynomial Real} {r mu muPlus muK : Real}
    (hr : 36 ≤ r)
    (hcoeff : P.coeffList =
      [4, -2 * (r ^ 2 - 21 * r - 12),
        -2 * (5 * r ^ 3 - 93 * r ^ 2 - 108 * r - 18),
        -6 * r * (r + 1) * (2 * r ^ 2 - 69 * r - 45),
        324 * r ^ 2 * (r + 1) ^ 2])
    (hzero : 0 < P.eval 0)
    (hplus : P.eval muPlus < 0)
    (hmid : 0 < P.eval mu)
    (hK : P.eval muK < 0)
    (horder : 0 < muPlus ∧ muPlus < mu ∧ mu < muK) : False
proof:
:= by
  exact impossible_four_sign_changes_of_quartic
    (absolutePoly3_positive_root_count_le_two hr hcoeff)
    horder.1 horder.2.1 horder.2.2 hzero hplus hmid hK

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3_at_35_positive_root_count_le_two
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3_at_35_positive_root_count_le_two
    {P : Polynomial Real}
    (hcoeff : P.coeffList =
      [4, -2 * ((35 : Real) ^ 2 - 21 * 35 - 12),
        -2 * (5 * (35 : Real) ^ 3 - 93 * 35 ^ 2 - 108 * 35 - 18),
        -6 * (35 : Real) * (35 + 1) *
          (2 * (35 : Real) ^ 2 - 69 * 35 - 45),
        324 * (35 : Real) ^ 2 * (35 + 1) ^ 2]) :
    P.roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤2
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : (0 : Real) < 4 := by norm_num
  have h3 : -2 * ((35 : Real) ^ 2 - 21 * 35 - 12) < 0 := by norm_num
  have h2 : -2 * (5 * (35 : Real) ^ 3 - 93 * 35 ^ 2 - 108 * 35 - 18) < 0 := by norm_num
  have h1 : 0 < -6 * (35 : Real) * (35 + 1) *
      (2 * (35 : Real) ^ 2 - 69 * 35 - 45) := by norm_num
  have h0 : 0 < 324 * (35 : Real) ^ 2 * (35 + 1) ^ 2 := by norm_num
  exact quartic_positive_root_count_le_two hcoeff h4 h3 h1 h0

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial_eval (r t x : Real) :

proof:
