name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_positive_root_count_le_two_pos_a1
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_positive_root_count_le_two_pos_a1
    {r t : Real}
    (hcoeff : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).coeffList =
      [(t - 1) ^ 2,
        -2 * r ^ 2 + (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t - 3) * r
          + 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 - t,
        -4 * r ^ 3 * t + 2 * r ^ 3 + 6 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 4
          - 12 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 3 + 4 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 2 - 4 * r ^ 2 * t
          + 6 * r * t ^ 4 - 10 * r * t ^ 3 + r * t ^ 2 - 3 * r * t
          + t ^ 4 - t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2,
        -r * t * (r + 1) * (t - 1) *
          (2 * r ^ 2 - 4 * r * t ^ 3 + 4 * r * t ^ 2 + r * t
            - 2 * t ^ 3 + t ^ 2),
        r ^ 2 * t ^ 4 * (r + 1) ^ 2 * (t - 1) ^ 2])
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 1 < t)
    (ha3 : -2 * r ^ 2 + (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t - 3) * r
      + 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 - t < 0)
    (ha1 : 0 < -r * t * (r + 1) * (t - 1) *
      (2 * r ^ 2 - 4 * r * t ^ 3 + 4 * r * t ^ 2 + r * t
        - 2 * t ^ 3 + t ^ 2)) :
    (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤2
proof:
:= by
  apply quartic_positive_root_count_le_two hcoeff
  · positivity
  · exact ha3
  · exact ha1
  · positivity

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_positive_root_count_le_two_neg_a1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations
  exact quartic_signVariations_le_two_neg_a1 hcoeff (by positivity) ha3 ha2 ha1 (by positivity)

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_a3_neg_of_range
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_a3_neg_of_range
    {r t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 ≤ r) :
    -2 * r ^ 2 + (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t - 3) * r
      + 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 - t < 0
proof:
:= by
  let p : Real := r - (2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2)
  have hp : 0 < p := by dsimp [p]; linarith
  have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  have hpoly :
      -(-2 * r ^ 2 + (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t - 3) * r
        + 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 - t) =
        2 * p ^ 2 + (t - 1) * (4 * t ^ 2 - 3) * p
          + t * (t - 1) ^ 2 * (2 * t - 1) ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [p]
    ring
  have hpos : 0 < -(-2 * r ^ 2 + (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t - 3) * r
      + 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 - t) := by
    rw [hpoly]
    have hp2 : 0 ≤2 * p ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hmid : 0 ≤(t - 1) * (4 * t ^ 2 - 3) * p := by
      have hm : 0 ≤4 * t ^ 2 - 3 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) hm) (le_of_lt hp)
    have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
    have ht2 : 0 < 2 * t - 1 := by linarith
    have hlast : 0 < t * (t - 1) ^ 2 * (2 * t - 1) ^ 2 := by positivity
    nlinarith
  linarith

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_a1_pos_of_range
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_a1_pos_of_range
    {r t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr0 : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 ≤ r)
    (hr1 : r ≤2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t) :
    0 < -r * t * (r + 1) * (t - 1) *
      (2 * r ^ 2 - 4 * r * t ^ 3 + 4 * r * t ^ 2 + r * t
        - 2 * t ^ 3 + t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let r0 : Real := 2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t
  let P1 : Real → Real := fun x =>
    2 * x ^ 2 - 4 * x * t ^ 3 + 4 * x * t ^ 2 + x * t
      - 2 * t ^ 3 + t ^ 2
  have hPmono : ∀ x, 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 ≤ x → x ≤ r0 → P1 x ≤ P1 r0 := by
    intro x hx0 hx1
    have hfac : 0 ≤(r0 - x) *
        (2 * (r0 + x) - 4 * t ^ 3 + 4 * t ^ 2 + t) := by
      have hsecond : 0 ≤2 * (r0 + x) - 4 * t ^ 3 + 4 * t ^ 2 + t := by
        dsimp [r0]
        nlinarith
      positivity
    have hid : P1 r0 - P1 x =
        (r0 - x) * (2 * (r0 + x) - 4 * t ^ 3 + 4 * t ^ 2 + t) := by
      dsimp [P1]
      ring
    have hnon : 0 ≤ P1 r0 - P1 x := by
      rw [hid]
      exact hfac
    linarith
  have hP0 : P1 r0 = -2 * t ^ 2 * (t - 1) * (t + 1) := by
    dsimp [P1, r0]
    ring
  have hPneg : P1 r < 0 := by
    have hle := hPmono r hr0 hr1
    rw [hP0] at hle
    have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
    have : 0 < 2 * t ^ 2 * (t - 1) * (t + 1) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hS : 0 < 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 := by
    have ht2 : 0 < 2 * t - 3 := by linarith
    have hfac : 0 < t ^ 2 * (2 * t - 3) := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by linarith
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have hr1pos : 0 < r + 1 := by linarith
  have ht1pos : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  have hbase : 0 < r * t * (r + 1) * (t - 1) := by positivity
  have hneg : -r * t * (r + 1) * (t - 1) < 0 := by nlinarith [hbase]
  exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hneg hPneg

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_a2_nonpos_of_range
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_a2_nonpos_of_range
    {r t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr : 2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t ≤ r) :
    -4 * r ^ 3 * t + 2 * r ^ 3 + 6 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 4
      - 12 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 3 + 4 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 2 - 4 * r ^ 2 * t
      + 6 * r * t ^ 4 - 10 * r * t ^ 3 + r * t ^ 2 - 3 * r * t
      + t ^ 4 - t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 ≤0
proof:
:= by
  let r0 : Real := 2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t
  let p : Real := r - r0
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := by dsimp [p, r0]; linarith
  have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  have hq2 : 0 < 9 * t ^ 2 - 3 * t - 5 := by
    let u : Real := t - 4
    have hu : 0 ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; linarith
    have hid : 9 * t ^ 2 - 3 * t - 5 = 9 * u ^ 2 + 69 * u + 127 := by
      dsimp [u]
      ring
    rw [hid]
    positivity
  have hq1 : 0 < 24 * t ^ 5 - 24 * t ^ 4 - 28 * t ^ 3
      + 22 * t ^ 2 + 12 * t - 3 := by
    let u : Real := t - 4
    have hu : 0 ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; linarith
    have hid : 24 * t ^ 5 - 24 * t ^ 4 - 28 * t ^ 3
        + 22 * t ^ 2 + 12 * t - 3 =
        24 * u ^ 5 + 456 * u ^ 4 + 3428 * u ^ 3 +
          12742 * u ^ 2 + 23420 * u + 17037 := by
      dsimp [u]
      ring
    rw [hid]
    positivity
  have hq0 : 0 < 8 * t ^ 6 - 24 * t ^ 4 + 4 * t ^ 3
      + 18 * t ^ 2 - 1 := by
    let u : Real := t - 4
    have hu : 0 ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; linarith
    have hid : 8 * t ^ 6 - 24 * t ^ 4 + 4 * t ^ 3
        + 18 * t ^ 2 - 1 =
        8 * u ^ 6 + 192 * u ^ 5 + 1896 * u ^ 4 +
          9860 * u ^ 3 + 28482 * u ^ 2 + 43344 * u + 27167 := by
      dsimp [u]
      ring
    rw [hid]
    positivity
  have hpoly :
      -(-4 * r ^ 3 * t + 2 * r ^ 3 + 6 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 4
        - 12 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 3 + 4 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 2 - 4 * r ^ 2 * t
        + 6 * r * t ^ 4 - 10 * r * t ^ 3 + r * t ^ 2 - 3 * r * t
        + t ^ 4 - t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2) =
      2 * (2 * t - 1) * p ^ 3 +
        2 * t * (t - 1) * (9 * t ^ 2 - 3 * t - 5) * p ^ 2 +
        t * (t - 1) * (24 * t ^ 5 - 24 * t ^ 4 - 28 * t ^ 3
          + 22 * t ^ 2 + 12 * t - 3) * p +
        t ^ 2 * (t - 1) ^ 2 *
          (8 * t ^ 6 - 24 * t ^ 4 + 4 * t ^ 3 + 18 * t ^ 2 - 1) := by
    dsimp [p, r0]
    ring
  have hnon : 0 ≤-(-4 * r ^ 3 * t + 2 * r ^ 3 + 6 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 4
      - 12 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 3 + 4 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 2 - 4 * r ^ 2 * t
      + 6 * r * t ^ 4 - 10 * r * t ^ 3 + r * t ^ 2 - 3 * r * t
      + t ^ 4 - t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2) := by
    rw [hpoly]
    have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
    have htm : 0 < 2 * t - 1 := by linarith
    positivity
  linarith

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a2_nonpos
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a2_nonpos
    {r t : Real}
    (hcoeff : (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).coeffList =
      [(t - 1) ^ 2,
        -2 * r ^ 2 + (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t - 3) * r
          + 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 - t,
        -4 * r ^ 3 * t + 2 * r ^ 3 + 6 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 4
          - 12 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 3 + 4 * r ^ 2 * t ^ 2 - 4 * r ^ 2 * t
          + 6 * r * t ^ 4 - 10 * r * t ^ 3 + r * t ^ 2 - 3 * r * t
          + t ^ 4 - t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2,
        -r * t * (r + 1) * (t - 1) *
          (2 * r ^ 2 - 4 * r * t ^ 3 + 4 * r * t ^ 2 + r * t
            - 2 * t ^ 3 + t ^ 2),
        r ^ 2 * t ^ 4 * (r + 1) ^ 2 * (t - 1) ^ 2])
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr0 : 2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t ≤ r) :
    (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_trans (absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations
  have hrS : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 ≤ r := by
    have hdiff : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 - t - 1 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - (1 / 2 : Real))]
    linarith
  have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  have ha4 : 0 < (t - 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos ht1
  have ha0 : 0 < r ^ 2 * t ^ 4 * (r + 1) ^ 2 * (t - 1) ^ 2 := by
    positivity
  exact quartic_signVariations_le_two_of_a2_nonpos hcoeff ha4
    (absolutePolyGeneral_a3_neg_of_range ht hrS)
    (absolutePolyGeneral_a2_nonpos_of_range ht hr0) ha0

name: SRGInequality.absolutePolyGeneral_formula_identity
statement:
lemma absolutePolyGeneral_formula_identity
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hk : k = r * t + mu)
    (hf : f = k * (t - 1) * (k + t) / (mu * (r + t)))
    (hg : g = (k + f * r) / t)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hmu : mu ≠ 0) (hrt : r + t ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    absolutePolyGeneral r t mu =
      mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2 * (f * (f + 3) - 2 * v)
proof:
:= by
  subst k
  subst f
  subst g
  subst v
  unfold absolutePolyGeneral
  field_simp [hmu, hrt, ht]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3_formula_identity
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3_formula_identity
    {r mu k f g v : Real}
    (hk : k = r * 3 + mu)
    (hf : f = k * (3 - 1) * (k + 3) / (mu * (r + 3)))
    (hg : g = (k + f * r) / 3)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hmu : mu ≠ 0) (hrt : r + 3 ≠ 0) :
    absolutePoly3 r mu = mu ^ 2 * (r + 3) ^ 2 *
      (f * (f + 3) - 2 * v)
proof:
:= by
  subst k
  subst f
  subst g
  subst v
  unfold absolutePoly3
  field_simp [hmu, hrt]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.discriminantPoly_expand
statement:
lemma discriminantPoly_expand (r t mu : Real) :
    discriminantPoly r t mu =
      discriminantC2 r t * mu ^ 2 +
        discriminantC1 r t * mu + discriminantC0 r t
proof:
:= by
  simp [discriminantPoly, discriminantC2, discriminantC1, discriminantC0]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.discriminantPoly_at_zero
statement:
lemma discriminantPoly_at_zero (r t : Real) :
    discriminantPoly r t 0 = discriminantC0 r t
proof:
:= by
  simp [discriminantPoly, discriminantC0]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_t3_krein_identity
statement:
lemma discriminant_t3_krein_identity {r : Real} (hr : r ≠ 3) :
    discriminantPoly r 3 (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) * (r - 3) ^ 2 =
      -2 * r * (r + 3) * qThree r
proof:
:= by
  unfold discriminantPoly qThree
  field_simp [hr]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_krein_identity
statement:
lemma discriminant_krein_identity {r t : Real}
    (hE : r + 2 * t - t ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    discriminantPoly r t
        (r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) / (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2)) *
        (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) ^ 2 =
      -r * (r + t) * (t - 1) * qGeneral r t
proof:
:= by
  unfold discriminantPoly qGeneral
  have hE' : r + t * 2 - t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    convert hE using 1 <;> ring
  field_simp [hE, hE']
  ring

name: SRGInequality.qGeneral_zero
statement:
lemma qGeneral_zero (t : Real) :
    qGeneral 0 t = t ^ 5 * (t - 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qGeneral]

name: SRGInequality.qGeneral_at_a
proof:
:= by
  simp [qGeneral]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.qGeneral_at_S
statement:
lemma qGeneral_at_S (t : Real) :
    qGeneral (2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2) t =
      -4 * t ^ 5 * (t - 1) ^ 4 * (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t + 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [qGeneral]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.qGeneral_zero_pos
statement: lemma qGeneral_zero_pos {t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t) : 0 < qGeneral 0 t
proof:
:= by
  rw [qGeneral_zero]
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have ht2 : 0 < t - 2 := by linarith
  have : 0 < t ^ 5 * (t - 2) := by positivity
  exact this

name: SRGInequality.qGeneral_middle_factor_pos
statement:
lemma qGeneral_middle_factor_pos {t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    0 < t ^ 6 - 2 * t ^ 5 - t ^ 4 + 4 * t ^ 3 -
      3 * t ^ 2 - 2 * t + 2
proof:
:= by
  let u : Real := t - 4
  have hu : 0 ≤ u := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have hid : t ^ 6 - 2 * t ^ 5 - t ^ 4 + 4 * t ^ 3 -
      3 * t ^ 2 - 2 * t + 2 =
      u ^ 6 + 22 * u ^ 5 + 199 * u ^ 4 + 948 * u ^ 3 +
        2509 * u ^ 2 + 3494 * u + 1994 := by
    dsimp [u]
    ring
  rw [hid]
  positivity

name: SRGInequality.qGeneral_at_a_neg
statement:
lemma qGeneral_at_a_neg {t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    qGeneral (t * (t - 2) * (t + 1)) t < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [qGeneral_at_a]
  have ht2 : 0 < t - 2 := by linarith
  have h1 : 0 < 2 * t ^ 2 - t - 4 := by nlinarith
  have h2 : 0 < t ^ 6 - 2 * t ^ 5 - t ^ 4 + 4 * t ^ 3 -
      3 * t ^ 2 - 2 * t + 2 := qGeneral_middle_factor_pos ht
  have hp : 0 < t ^ 4 * (t - 2) * (2 * t ^ 2 - t - 4) *
      (t ^ 6 - 2 * t ^ 5 - t ^ 4 + 4 * t ^ 3 -
        3 * t ^ 2 - 2 * t + 2) := by positivity
  have hid : -t ^ 4 * (t - 2) * (2 * t ^ 2 - t - 4) *
      (t ^ 6 - 2 * t ^ 5 - t ^ 4 + 4 * t ^ 3 -
        3 * t ^ 2 - 2 * t + 2) = -(
      t ^ 4 * (t - 2) * (2 * t ^ 2 - t - 4) *
      (t ^ 6 - 2 * t ^ 5 - t ^ 4 + 4 * t ^ 3 -
        3 * t ^ 2 - 2 * t + 2)) := by ring
  rw [hid]
  exact neg_lt_zero.mpr hp

name: SRGInequality.qGeneral_at_S_neg
statement:
lemma qGeneral_at_S_neg {t : Real} (ht : 4 ≤ t) :
    qGeneral (2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2) t < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [qGeneral_at_S]
  have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  have hfactor : 0 < 4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t + 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - 1)]
  have hp : 0 < 4 * t ^ 5 * (t - 1) ^ 4 *
      (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t + 2) := by positivity
  have hid : -4 * t ^ 5 * (t - 1) ^ 4 *
      (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t + 2) = -(
      4 * t ^ 5 * (t - 1) ^ 4 *
      (4 * t ^ 3 - 8 * t ^ 2 + 3 * t + 2)) := by ring
  rw [hid]
  exact neg_lt_zero.mpr hp

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3_at_krein
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3_at_krein {r : Real} (hr : r ≠ 3) :
    absolutePoly3 r (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) =
      -16 * r ^ 3 * (r + 1) * (r + 3) ^ 3 * (r - 27) * (5 * r - 3) /
        (r - 3) ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  unfold absolutePoly3
  field_simp [hr]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.absolutePoly3_at_krein_neg
statement:
lemma absolutePoly3_at_krein_neg {r : Real} (hr : 35 ≤ r) :
    absolutePoly3 r (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr3 : r ≠ 3 := by linarith
  have hdiff : 0 < r - 3 := by linarith
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
  have hr1 : 0 < r + 1 := by linarith
  have hr3p : 0 < r + 3 := by linarith
  have hr27 : 0 < r - 27 := by linarith
  have h5r : 0 < 5 * r - 3 := by linarith
  rw [absolutePoly3_at_krein hr3]
  have hden : 0 < (r - 3) ^ 4 := by
    positivity
  have hp : 0 < 16 * r ^ 3 * (r + 1) * (r + 3) ^ 3 *
      (r - 27) * (5 * r - 3) := by
    positivity
  have : 0 < 16 * r ^ 3 * (r + 1) * (r + 3) ^ 3 *
      (r - 27) * (5 * r - 3) / (r - 3) ^ 4 := by
    positivity
  have hform :
      -16 * r ^ 3 * (r + 1) * (r + 3) ^ 3 * (r - 27) * (5 * r - 3) /
          (r - 3) ^ 4 =
        -(16 * r ^ 3 * (r + 1) * (r + 3) ^ 3 * (r - 27) * (5 * r - 3) /
          (r - 3) ^ 4) := by ring
  rw [hform]
  exact neg_lt_zero.mpr this

name: SRGInequality.qThree_neg_on_13_34
statement:
lemma qThree_neg_on_13_34 {r : Real} (hr13 : 13 ≤ r) (hr34 : r ≤ 34) :
    qThree r < 0
proof:
:= by
  let x : Real := (r - 13) / 21
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by dsimp [x]; linarith
  have hx1 : x ≤1 := by dsimp [x]; linarith
  have hid : qThree r =
      -256624 * (1 - x) ^ 4
        - 1977880 * x * (1 - x) ^ 3
        - 5071272 * x ^ 2 * (1 - x) ^ 2
        - 4327822 * x ^ 3 * (1 - x)
        - 5401 * x ^ 4 := by
    dsimp [x, qThree]
    field_simp
    ring
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (1 - x) ^ 4 := by positivity
  have h2 : 0 ≤ x * (1 - x) ^ 3 := by positivity
  have h3 : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 * (1 - x) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h4 : 0 ≤ x ^ 3 * (1 - x) := by positivity
  have h5 : 0 ≤ x ^ 4 := by positivity
  have hstrict :
      0 < 256624 * (1 - x) ^ 4 + 5401 * x ^ 4 := by
    by_cases hx : x ≤(1 / 2 : Real)
    · have : 0 < 1 - x := by linarith
      positivity
    · have : 0 < x := by linarith
      positivity
  rw [hid]
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.qThree_pos_of_ge_35
statement:
lemma qThree_pos_of_ge_35 {r : Real} (hr : 35 ≤ r) :
    0 < qThree r
proof:
:= by
  let x : Real := r - 35
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := by dsimp [x]; linarith
  have hid : qThree r =
      5 * x ^ 4 + 538 * x ^ 3 + 19452 * x ^ 2 +
        242368 * x + 218048 := by
    dsimp [x, qThree]
    ring
  rw [hid]
  have : 0 < (218048 : Real) := by norm_num
  positivity

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_t3_at_krein_neg
statement:
lemma discriminant_t3_at_krein_neg {r : Real} (hr : 35 ≤ r) :
    discriminantPoly r 3 (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) < 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr3 : r ≠ 3 := by linarith
  have hq : 0 < qThree r := qThree_pos_of_ge_35 hr
  have hright : -2 * r * (r + 3) * qThree r < 0 := by
    have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
    have hrp : 0 < r + 3 := by linarith
    have hp : 0 < 2 * r * (r + 3) * qThree r := by positivity
    linarith
  have hid := discriminant_t3_krein_identity hr3
  have hdiff : r - 3 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hr3
  have hs : 0 < (r - 3) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hdiff
  by_contra hnot
  have hnon : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 3 (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) := le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hmul : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 3 (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) * (r - 3) ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg hnon (le_of_lt hs)
  nlinarith [hid]

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_t3_at_krein_pos_of_range
proof:
:= by
  have hr3 : r ≠ 3 := by linarith
  have hq : qThree r < 0 := qThree_neg_on_13_34 hr13 hr34
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by linarith
  have hrp : 0 < r + 3 := by linarith
  have hright : 0 < -2 * r * (r + 3) * qThree r := by
    have hnq : 0 < -qThree r := neg_pos.mpr hq
    have hp : 0 < 2 * r * (r + 3) * (-qThree r) := by positivity
    linarith
  have hdiff : r - 3 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hr3
  have hs : 0 < (r - 3) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hdiff
  have hid := discriminant_t3_krein_identity hr3
  by_contra hnot
  have hnon : discriminantPoly r 3 (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) ≤0 := le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hmul : discriminantPoly r 3 (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) * (r - 3) ^ 2 ≤0 :=
    mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hnon (le_of_lt hs)
  nlinarith [hid]

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_t2_nonneg_of_interval
statement:
lemma discriminant_t2_nonneg_of_interval
    {r mu : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hmu0 : 0 ≤ mu) (hmuL : mu ≤ r + 4)
    (hendpoint : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 2 (r + 4)) :
    0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 2 mu
proof:
:= by
  have ha : discriminantC2 r 2 ≤0 := by
    simp [discriminantC2]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg r]
  have hL : 0 < r + 4 := by linarith
  have hc : 0 ≤ discriminantC0 r 2 := by
    simp [discriminantC0]
    positivity
  have hendpoint' := hendpoint
  rw [discriminantPoly_expand] at hendpoint'
  have hquad := quadratic_nonneg_of_concave_interval
    (a := discriminantC2 r 2) (b := discriminantC1 r 2)
    (c := discriminantC0 r 2) (x := mu) (L := r + 4)
    ha hL hmu0 hmuL hc hendpoint'
  rw [discriminantPoly_expand]
  exact hquad

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_nonneg_of_concave_threshold
statement:
lemma discriminant_nonneg_of_concave_threshold
    {r t mu L : Real}
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t ≤ 0)
    (hmu0 : 0 ≤ mu) (hmuL : mu ≤ L)
    (hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0)
    (hL : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t L)
    (hLpos : 0 < L) :
    0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t mu
proof:
:= by
  have hzero' := hzero
  rw [discriminantPoly_expand] at hzero'
  have hzero'' : 0 ≤ discriminantC0 r t := by simpa using hzero'
  have hL' := hL
  rw [discriminantPoly_expand] at hL'
  have hquad := quadratic_nonneg_of_concave_interval
    (a := discriminantC2 r t) (b := discriminantC1 r t)
    (c := discriminantC0 r t) (x := mu) (L := L)
    hc2 hLpos hmu0 hmuL hzero'' hL'
  rw [discriminantPoly_expand]
  exact hquad

name: SRGInequality.c2_neg_implies_E_pos
statement:
lemma c2_neg_implies_E_pos {r t : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 2 ≤ t)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0) :
    0 < r + 2 * t - t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hE
  have hq : r ≤ t * (t - 2) := by nlinarith
  by_cases ht2 : t = 2
  · subst t
    nlinarith
  have ht2' : 2 < t := lt_of_le_of_ne ht (Ne.symm ht2)
  have hL : 0 < t * (t - 2) := by positivity
  have hzero : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 * (t - 2) := by positivity
  have hend : 0 ≤     -(t * (t - 2)) ^ 2 +
        t * (t - 2) * (t + 1) * (t * (t - 2)) +
        t ^ 2 * (t - 2) := by
    have hid :
        -(t * (t - 2)) ^ 2 +
            t * (t - 2) * (t + 1) * (t * (t - 2)) +
            t ^ 2 * (t - 2) =
          t ^ 2 * (t - 2) * (t * (t - 2) + 1) := by ring
    rw [hid]
    positivity
  have hquad := quadratic_nonneg_of_concave_interval
    (a := (-1 : Real)) (b := t * (t - 2) * (t + 1))
    (c := t ^ 2 * (t - 2)) (x := r) (L := t * (t - 2))
    (by norm_num) hL (le_of_lt hr) hq hzero (by nlinarith [hend])
  have hc2non : 0 ≤ discriminantC2 r t := by
    simpa [discriminantC2] using hquad
  linarith

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_t2_endpoint_formula
statement:
lemma discriminant_t2_endpoint_formula (r : Real) :
    discriminantPoly r 2 (r + 4) =
      -(r + 2) * (3 * r ^ 3 - 16 * r ^ 2 - 44 * r - 16)
proof:
:= by
  simp [discriminantPoly]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.discriminant_t2_endpoint_nonneg_of_le_seven
statement:
lemma discriminant_t2_endpoint_nonneg_of_le_seven
    {r : Real} (hr : 0 < r) (hr7 : r ≤ 7) :
    0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 2 (r + 4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [discriminant_t2_endpoint_formula]
  have h7r : 0 ≤ 7 - r := by linarith
  have hsq : 0 ≤ r ^ 2 := sq_nonneg r
  have hcube : 0 ≤ r ^ 2 * (7 - r) :=
    mul_nonneg hsq h7r
  have hlin : 0 ≤ r * (7 - r) :=
    mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hr) h7r
  have hpoly : 3 * r ^ 3 - 16 * r ^ 2 - 44 * r - 16 < 0 := by
    nlinarith
  have hr2 : 0 < r + 2 := by linarith
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.target_gap_factorization
statement:
lemma target_gap_factorization
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hk : k = r * t + mu)
    (hf : f = k * (t - 1) * (k + t) / (mu * (r + t)))
    (hg : g = (k + f * r) / t)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hmu : mu ≠ 0) (hrt : r + t ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  subst k
  subst f
  subst g
  subst v
  dsimp [discriminantPoly, auxiliaryPoly]
  field_simp [hmu, hrt, ht]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.target_of_nonnegative_discriminant
statement:
lemma target_of_nonnegative_discriminant
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t mu)
    (hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly r t mu)
    (hden : 0 < mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2) :
    v * k ≤ g * (v - g) * t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hquot : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
      (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2) :=
    div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hD hN) (le_of_lt hden)
  have hgap' : 0 ≤ t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k := by
    rw [hgap]
    exact hquot
  have hident : g * (v - g) * t ^ 2 = t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) := by
    rw [hv]
    ring
  rw [hident]
  linarith

name: SRGInequality.target_divided_of_nonnegative_discriminant
statement:
lemma target_divided_of_nonnegative_discriminant
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t mu)
    (hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly r t mu)
    (hden : 0 < mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    v * k / t ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  apply (target_division_equiv ht).2
  exact target_of_nonnegative_discriminant hv hgap hD hN hden

name: SRGInequality.mu_le_krein_threshold
statement:
lemma mu_le_krein_threshold
    {k mu r t : Real}
    (hK : KreinBound k r t) (hk : k = r * t + mu)
    (hE : 0 < r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) :
    mu ≤ r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) / (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := KreinBound.substituted hK hk
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hE).2
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.auxiliaryPoly_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hlin : 0 < 2 * t - 1 := by linarith
  have htm : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  have h2 : 0 < r * (2 * t - 1) * mu :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos hr hlin) hmu
  have h3 : 0 < r ^ 2 * t * (t - 1) := by
    positivity
  dsimp [auxiliaryPoly]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg mu]

name: SRGInequality.coefficient_relation
statement:
lemma coefficient_relation (r t : Real) :
    -(coefficientB r t) =
      discriminantC2 r t + r * t * (t ^ 2 - t + 1) + t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientB, discriminantC2]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.discriminantC0_pos
statement:
lemma discriminantC0_pos {r t : Real} (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 2 ≤ t) :
    0 < discriminantC0 r t
proof:
:= by
  have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
  dsimp [discriminantC0]
  positivity

name: SRGInequality.discriminantC1_pos_of_B_neg
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
  have hr1 : 0 < r + 1 := by linarith
  have hB' : r ^ 2 - 2 * r * t ^ 3 + 2 * r * t ^ 2 + r * t - t ^ 3 + t ^ 2 < 0 := by
    simpa [coefficientB] using hB
  dsimp [discriminantC1]
  have hfactor : (-t) * (r + 1) < 0 :=
    mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_lt_zero.mpr ht0) hr1
  exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hfactor hB'

name: SRGInequality.equal_multiplicities_trace_relation
statement:
lemma equal_multiplicities_trace_relation
    {v k f r s : Real}
    (hpart : v = 1 + f + f)
    (htrace : k + f * r + f * s = 0) :
    2 * k + (v - 1) * (r + s) = 0
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination 2 * htrace + (r + s) * hpart

name: SRGInequality.srg_equal_multiplicities_relation
statement:
lemma srg_equal_multiplicities_relation
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) 
    (hf : positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu) :
    2 * (k : Real) + (v - 1) *
        (restrictedPos k lambda mu + restrictedNeg k lambda mu) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨part, htrace, htrace2, hsum, hprod⟩
  apply equal_multiplicities_trace_relation
  · rw [hf] at part; exact part
  · rw [hf] at htrace; nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.srg_equal_multiplicities_parameter_relation
statement:
lemma srg_equal_multiplicities_parameter_relation
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) 
    (hf : positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu =
      negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu) :
    2 * (k : Real) + (v - 1) * ((lambda : Real) - mu) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrel := srg_equal_multiplicities_relation G h hc hne hf
  have hsum := restricted_sum k lambda mu
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.srg_restrictedNeg_ne_neg_one
statement:
lemma srg_restrictedNeg_ne_neg_one
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ (⊤ : SimpleGraph V)) :
    restrictedNeg k lambda mu ≠ (-1)
proof:
:= by
  intro hs
  have hsum := restricted_sum k lambda mu
  have hprod := restricted_product_of_nonneg (spectral_discriminant_nonneg_of_ne_complete G h hne)
  rw [hs] at hsum hprod
  ring_nf at hsum hprod
  have hkrel : (k : Real) = (lambda : Real) + 1 := by nlinarith [hprod, hsum]
  have hmu := mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hnadj⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
  have hvk : k < v - 1 := by
    rw [← h.card]
    have hnot : ¬ G.IsUniversal a := by
      intro hu; exact hnadj (hu hab)
    have hdeg := (G.degree_lt_card_sub_one a).mpr hnot
    simpa [h.regular.degree_eq] using hdeg
  have hlam := lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hlk : lambda + 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hvk1 : k + 1 ≤ v := by omega
  have hkl : 1 ≤ k - lambda := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hlam
  have hvdiff : 1 ≤ v - k := by omega
  have hcastkl : ((k - lambda : Nat) : Real) = (k : Real) - lambda := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : lambda ≤ k)]
  have hcastvk : ((v - k : Nat) : Real) = (v : Real) - k := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : k ≤ v)]
  have hcastkl1 : ((k - lambda - 1 : Nat) : Real) = (k : Real) - lambda - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hkl, hcastkl]; norm_num
  have hcastvk1 : ((v - k - 1 : Nat) : Real) = (v : Real) - k - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hvdiff, hcastvk]; norm_num
  have hparam := srg_parameter_identity G h (by
    rw [← h.card]
    exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hc.nonempty)
  have hmuR : (0 : Real) < mu := by exact_mod_cast hmu
  have hparamR := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : Real)) hparam
  norm_num [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub hlk, Nat.cast_sub hvk1] at hparamR
  rw [hcastkl1, hcastvk1] at hparamR
  have hvdiffRnat : (1 : Real) ≤ ((v - k : Nat) : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hvdiff
  rw [hcastvk] at hvdiffRnat
  have hvdiff2 : 2 ≤ v - k := by omega
  have hvdiffR : 0 < (v : Real) - k - 1 := by
    have hvdiffRnat2 : (2 : Real) ≤ ((v - k : Nat) : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hvdiff2
    rw [hcastvk] at hvdiffRnat2
    linarith
  nlinarith [hparamR]

name: SRGInequality.discriminantPoly_pos_of_coeffs
statement:
lemma discriminantPoly_pos_of_coeffs {r t mu : Real}
    (hc2 : 0 ≤ discriminantC2 r t)
    (hc1 : 0 < discriminantC1 r t)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hmu : 0 < mu) :
    0 < discriminantPoly r t mu
proof:
:= by
  rw [discriminantPoly_expand]
  have hm2 : 0 < mu ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hmu
  have hterm2 : 0 ≤ discriminantC2 r t * mu ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg hc2 (le_of_lt hm2)
  have hterm1 : 0 < discriminantC1 r t * mu := mul_pos hc1 hmu
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.discriminantPoly_pos_of_c2_nonneg
statement:
lemma discriminantPoly_pos_of_c2_nonneg {r t mu : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hc2 : 0 ≤ discriminantC2 r t) :
    0 < discriminantPoly r t mu
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < r * t * (t ^ 2 - t + 1) + t ^ 2 := by
    have ht0 : 0 < t := by linarith
    have hquad : 0 < t ^ 2 - t + 1 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - (1 / 2 : Real))]
    positivity
  have hB : coefficientB r t < 0 := by
    have hrel := coefficient_relation r t
    nlinarith
  have hc1 : 0 < discriminantC1 r t :=
    discriminantC1_pos_of_B_neg hr ht hB
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t := discriminantC0_pos hr ht
  exact discriminantPoly_pos_of_coeffs hc2 hc1 hc0 hmu

name: SRGInequality.quartic_division_certificate
statement:
lemma quartic_division_certificate
    {a4 a3 a2 a1 a0 c2 c1 c0 x : Real} (hc2 : c2 ≠ 0) :
    let q2 := a4 / c2
    let q1 := (a3 - q2 * c1) / c2
    let q0 := (a2 - q2 * c0 - q1 * c1) / c2
    let r1 := a1 - q1 * c0 - q0 * c1
    let r0 := a0 - q0 * c0
    a4 * x ^ 4 + a3 * x ^ 3 + a2 * x ^ 2 + a1 * x + a0 =
      (q2 * x ^ 2 + q1 * x + q0) * (c2 * x ^ 2 + c1 * x + c0) +
        r1 * x + r0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp
  field_simp [hc2]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.srg_gap_factorization
statement:
lemma srg_gap_factorization
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (ht0 : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu ≠ 0) :
    (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 *
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) + 1) -
        (v : Real) * k =
      discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) *
        auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
          (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) /
        ((mu : Real) ^ 2 *
          (restrictedPos k lambda mu - restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨hpart, htrace, htrace2, _, _⟩
  have hk0 := degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne
  have hk : (k : Real) = r * t + (mu : Real) := by
    dsimp [r, t]
    nlinarith [hk0]
  have hf0 := srg_multiplicity_formula G h hc hne
  have hf : f = (k : Real) * (t - 1) * ((k : Real) + t) /
      ((mu : Real) * (r + t)) := by
    dsimp [f, r, t]
    exact hf0
  have hg : g = ((k : Real) + f * r) / t := by
    have htr : (k : Real) + f * r - g * t = 0 := by
      dsimp [f, g, r, t]
      nlinarith [htrace]
    apply (eq_div_iff (show t ≠ 0 by exact ht0)).2
    nlinarith
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast hpart
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hgap := target_gap_factorization hk hf hg hv
    (by exact_mod_cast (mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne).ne')
    (by
      have hgappos := restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
      dsimp [r, t]
      exact ne_of_gt hgappos)
    ht0
  simpa [r, t, f, g, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc,
    mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hgap

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_D_nonneg
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_D_nonneg
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (ht0 : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu ≠ 0)
    (hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))
    (hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real)) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨hpart, htrace, htrace2, _, _⟩
  have hk0 := degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne
  have hk : (k : Real) = r * t + (mu : Real) := by
    dsimp [r, t]
    nlinarith [hk0]
  have hf0 := srg_multiplicity_formula G h hc hne
  have hf : f = (k : Real) * (t - 1) * ((k : Real) + t) /
      ((mu : Real) * (r + t)) := by
    dsimp [f, r, t]
    exact hf0
  have hg : g = ((k : Real) + f * r) / t := by
    have htr : (k : Real) + f * r - g * t = 0 := by
      dsimp [f, g, r, t]
      nlinarith [htrace]
    apply (eq_div_iff (show t ≠ 0 by exact ht0)).2
    nlinarith
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast hpart
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hgap := target_gap_factorization hk hf hg hv
    (by exact_mod_cast (mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne).ne')
    (by
      have hgappos := restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
      dsimp [r, t]
      exact ne_of_gt hgappos)
    ht0
  have hden : 0 < (mu : Real) ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2 := by
    have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
    have hrt : 0 < r + t := by
      dsimp [r, t]
      exact restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
    positivity
  have htarget := target_divided_of_nonnegative_discriminant hv hgap hD hN hden ht0
  simpa [r, t, f, g] using htarget

name: SRGInequality.srg_absolutePoly3_nonneg
statement:
lemma srg_absolutePoly3_nonneg
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3)
    (hr3 : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu + 3)
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    0 ≤ absolutePoly3 (restrictedPos k lambda mu) (mu : Real)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨hpart, htrace, _, _, _⟩
  have hk0 := degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne
  have hk : (k : Real) = r * 3 + (mu : Real) := by
    dsimp [r]
    nlinarith [hk0, htEq]
  have hf0 := srg_multiplicity_formula G h hc hne
  have hf : f = (k : Real) * (3 - 1) * ((k : Real) + 3) /
      ((mu : Real) * (r + 3)) := by
    dsimp [f, r]
    rw [← htEq]
    exact hf0
  have hg : g = ((k : Real) + f * r) / 3 := by
    have htr : (k : Real) + f * r - g * 3 = 0 := by
      dsimp [f, g, r]
      nlinarith [htrace, htEq]
    apply (eq_div_iff (by norm_num : (3 : Real) ≠ 0)).2
    nlinarith
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast hpart
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hid := absolutePoly3_formula_identity hk hf hg hv
    (by exact_mod_cast (mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne).ne')
    (by
      have hp := restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
      dsimp [r]
      nlinarith [htEq])
  have hAr := absoluteBound_gap_nonneg hA
  rw [hid]
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hr3' : 0 < r + 3 := by simpa [r] using hr3
  have hgap : 0 ≤ f * (f + 3) - 2 * (v : Real) := by
    simpa [f] using hAr
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ (mu : Real) ^ 2 * (r + 3) ^ 2 := by positivity
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hfactor hgap]

name: SRGInequality.srg_absolutePolyGeneral_nonneg
statement:
lemma srg_absolutePolyGeneral_nonneg
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (ht : 0 < -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real)) :
    0 ≤ absolutePolyGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨hpart, htrace, _, _, _⟩
  have hk : (k : Real) = r * t + (mu : Real) := by
    dsimp [r, t]
    nlinarith [degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne]
  have hf : f = (k : Real) * (t - 1) * ((k : Real) + t) /
      ((mu : Real) * (r + t)) := by
    dsimp [f, r, t]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using
      (srg_multiplicity_formula G h hc hne)
  have hg : g = ((k : Real) + f * r) / t := by
    have htr : (k : Real) + f * r - g * t = 0 := by
      dsimp [f, g, r, t]
      nlinarith [htrace]
    apply (eq_div_iff (ne_of_gt ht)).2
    nlinarith
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast hpart
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hid := absolutePolyGeneral_formula_identity hk hf hg hv
    (by exact_mod_cast (mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne).ne')
    (by
      have hp := restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
      dsimp [r, t]
      exact_mod_cast hp.ne')
    (ne_of_gt ht)
  have hAr := absoluteBound_gap_nonneg hA
  rw [hid]
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hgap : 0 ≤ f * (f + 3) - 2 * (v : Real) := by
    simpa [f] using hAr
  have hfactor : 0 ≤ (mu : Real) ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2 := by positivity
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hfactor hgap]

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_t3_mid
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_t3_mid
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (hr13 : 13 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hr34 : restrictedPos k lambda mu ≤ 34)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by dsimp [t]; linarith [htEq]
  have hk : (k : Real) = r * t + (mu : Real) := by
    dsimp [r, t]
    nlinarith [degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne, htEq]
  have hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0 := by
    dsimp [r, t]
    rw [htEq]
    simp [discriminantC2]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 6)]
  have hE : 0 < r + 2 * t - t ^ 2 :=
    c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr (by dsimp [t]; linarith [htEq]) hc2
  have hLpos : 0 < r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) /
      (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) := by
    have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by dsimp [t]; linarith [htEq]
    have htr : 0 < t ^ 2 + r := by positivity
    positivity
  have hmuL : (mu : Real) ≤ r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) /
      (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) := by
    have hK' : KreinBound (k : Real) r t := by
      simpa [r, t] using hK
    exact mu_le_krein_threshold hK' hk hE
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt (discriminantC0_pos hr (by dsimp [t]; linarith [htEq]))
  have hendpoint : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t
      (r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) / (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2)) := by
    have hp := le_of_lt (discriminant_t3_at_krein_pos_of_range
      (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu) hr13 hr34)
    dsimp [r, t]
    rw [htEq]
    have heq :
        restrictedPos k lambda mu * (3 - 1) *
            (3 ^ 2 + restrictedPos k lambda mu) /
          (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 2 * 3 - 3 ^ 2) =
        2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu *
            (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
          (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3) := by ring
    rw [heq]
    exact hp
  have hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t (mu : Real) :=
    discriminant_nonneg_of_concave_threshold (le_of_lt hc2)
      (le_of_lt hmu) hmuL hzero hendpoint hLpos
  have hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly r t (mu : Real) :=
    le_of_lt (auxiliaryPoly_pos hr (by dsimp [t]; linarith [htEq]) hmu)
  exact srg_target_of_D_nonneg G h hc hne ht0 hD hN

name: SRGInequality.srg_t3_high_not_at_krein
statement:
lemma srg_t3_high_not_at_krein
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (hr35 : 35 ≤ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (htEq : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 3)
    (hr3 : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu + 3)
    (hA : AbsoluteBound (v : Real) (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real))
    (hmuK : (mu : Real) =
      2 * restrictedPos k lambda mu *
        (restrictedPos k lambda mu + 9) /
        (restrictedPos k lambda mu - 3)) : False
proof:
:= by
  have hnon := srg_absolutePoly3_nonneg G h hc hne htEq hr3 hA
  rw [hmuK] at hnon
  have hneg := absolutePoly3_at_krein_neg hr35
  nlinarith [hnon, hneg]

name: SRGInequality.conference_branch_target
proof:
:= by
  have hw1 : 0 < w + 1 := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < (w + 1) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hw1
  have hfac : 0 ≤ (w - 1) ^ 3 * (w ^ 2 + 4 * w + 1) := by

name: SRGInequality.complete_multipartite_branch_target
statement:
lemma complete_multipartite_branch_target {m n : Real}
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    (m * n * (m * (n - 1)) / (-m) ^ 2) ≤
      (n - 1) * (m * n - (n - 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by linarith
  have hn1 : 0 < n - 1 := by linarith
  have hden : 0 < (-m) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero (by linarith)
