name: SRGInequality.target_of_c2_nonneg
statement:
theorem target_of_c2_nonneg
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hc2 : 0 ≤ discriminantC2 r t)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (ht0 : t ≠ 0) :
    v * k / t ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  apply target_divided_of_nonnegative_discriminant hv hgap
    (le_of_lt (discriminantPoly_pos_of_c2_nonneg hr ht hmu hc2))
    (le_of_lt (auxiliaryPoly_pos hr ht hmu))
  · have hrt : 0 < r + t := by linarith
    positivity
  · exact ht0

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_c2_nonneg
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_c2_nonneg
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (ht : 2 ≤ -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (hc2 : 0 ≤ discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have ht0 : -restrictedNeg k lambda mu ≠ 0 := by
    linarith
  have hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) := by
    exact le_of_lt (discriminantPoly_pos_of_c2_nonneg hr ht hmu hc2)
  have hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) := by
    exact le_of_lt (auxiliaryPoly_pos hr ht hmu)
  exact srg_target_of_D_nonneg G h hc hne ht0 hD hN

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_Q_nonpos
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_Q_nonpos
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (ht : 4 ≤ -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound (k : Real) (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
    (hQ : qGeneral (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ≤ 0) :
    (v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 ≤
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by dsimp [t]; linarith
  have hk : (k : Real) = r * t + (mu : Real) := by
    dsimp [r, t]
    nlinarith [degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t G h hc hne]
  have hE : 0 < r + 2 * t - t ^ 2 :=
    c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr (by dsimp [t]; linarith) (by simpa [r, t] using hc2)
  have hLpos : 0 < r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) /
      (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) := by
    have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by dsimp [t]; linarith
    have htr : 0 < t ^ 2 + r := by positivity
    positivity
  have hmuL : (mu : Real) ≤ r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) /
      (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) :=
    mu_le_krein_threshold hK hk hE
  have hright : 0 ≤ -r * (r + t) * (t - 1) * qGeneral r t := by
    have hrt : 0 < r + t := by
      dsimp [r, t]
      exact restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
    have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by dsimp [t]; linarith
    have hqneg : 0 ≤ -qGeneral r t := by
      apply neg_nonneg.mpr
      simpa [r, t] using hQ
    have hp : 0 ≤ r * (r + t) * (t - 1) * (-qGeneral r t) := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hE0 : r + 2 * t - t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hE
  have hident := discriminant_krein_identity hE0
  have hEsq : 0 < (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hE
  have hendpoint : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t
      (r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) / (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2)) := by
    by_contra hn
    have hneg := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hmul := mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg hEsq
    nlinarith [hident]
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt (discriminantC0_pos hr (by dsimp [t]; linarith))
  have hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t (mu : Real) :=
    discriminant_nonneg_of_concave_threshold (le_of_lt (by simpa [r, t] using hc2))
      (le_of_lt hmu) hmuL hzero hendpoint hLpos
  have hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly r t (mu : Real) :=
    le_of_lt (auxiliaryPoly_pos hr (by dsimp [t]; linarith) hmu)
  exact srg_target_of_D_nonneg G h hc hne ht0 hD hN

name: SRGInequality.target_of_t2_interval
statement:
theorem target_of_t2_interval
    {r mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hmu : 0 < mu) (hmuL : mu ≤ r + 4)
    (hendpoint : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 2 (r + 4))
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : 2 ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r 2 mu * auxiliaryPoly r 2 mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + 2) ^ 2)) :
    v * k / 2 ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 2 mu :=
    discriminant_t2_nonneg_of_interval hr (le_of_lt hmu) hmuL hendpoint
  have hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly r 2 mu := by
    dsimp [auxiliaryPoly]
    positivity
  have hden : 0 < mu ^ 2 * (r + 2) ^ 2 := by
    have hr2 : 0 < r + 2 := by linarith
    positivity
  have ht0 : (2 : Real) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  exact target_divided_of_nonnegative_discriminant hv hgap hD hN hden ht0

name: SRGInequality.target_of_t2_small
statement:
theorem target_of_t2_small
    {r mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hr7 : r ≤ 7) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hmuL : mu ≤ r + 4)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : 2 ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r 2 mu * auxiliaryPoly r 2 mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + 2) ^ 2)) :
    v * k / 2 ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  apply target_of_t2_interval hr hmu hmuL
    (discriminant_t2_endpoint_nonneg_of_le_seven hr hr7) hv hgap

name: SRGInequality.target_of_t3_mid
statement:
theorem target_of_t3_mid
    {r mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr13 : 13 ≤ r) (hr34 : r ≤ 34) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hmuK : mu ≤ 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3))
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : 3 ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r 3 mu * auxiliaryPoly r 3 mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + 3) ^ 2)) :
    v * k / 3 ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < r := by linarith
  have hc2 : discriminantC2 r 3 ≤ 0 := by
    simp [discriminantC2]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 6)]
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 3 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    dsimp [discriminantC0]
    positivity
  have hLpos : 0 < 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3) := by
    have : 0 < r - 3 := by linarith
    positivity
  have hL : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 3
      (2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) :=
    le_of_lt (discriminant_t3_at_krein_pos_of_range hr13 hr34)
  have hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r 3 mu :=
    discriminant_nonneg_of_concave_threshold hc2 (le_of_lt hmu) hmuK
      hzero hL hLpos
  have hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly r 3 mu := by
    dsimp [auxiliaryPoly]
    positivity
  have hden : 0 < mu ^ 2 * (r + 3) ^ 2 := by
    have : 0 < r + 3 := by linarith
    positivity
  have ht0 : (3 : Real) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  exact target_divided_of_nonnegative_discriminant hv hgap hD hN hden ht0

name: SRGInequality.target_of_concave_krein_threshold
statement:
theorem target_of_concave_krein_threshold
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 2 ≤ t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound k r t) (hk : k = r * t + mu)
    (hendpoint : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t
      (r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) / (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2)))
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2)) :
    v * k / t ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : 0 < r + 2 * t - t ^ 2 :=
    c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr ht hc2
  have hLpos : 0 < r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) /
      (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) := by
    have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
    have ht2r : 0 < t ^ 2 + r := by positivity
    positivity
  have hmuL : mu ≤ r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) /
      (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) :=
    mu_le_krein_threshold hK hk hE
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt (discriminantC0_pos hr ht)
  have hD : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t mu :=
    discriminant_nonneg_of_concave_threshold (le_of_lt hc2)
      (le_of_lt hmu) hmuL hzero hendpoint hLpos
  have hN : 0 ≤ auxiliaryPoly r t mu :=
    le_of_lt (auxiliaryPoly_pos hr ht hmu)
  have hden : 0 < mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2 := by
    have hrt : 0 < r + t := by linarith
    positivity
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by linarith
  exact target_divided_of_nonnegative_discriminant hv hgap hD hN hden ht0

name: SRGInequality.target_of_general_Q_nonpos
statement:
theorem target_of_general_Q_nonpos
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 4 ≤ t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound k r t) (hk : k = r * t + mu)
    (hQ : qGeneral r t ≤ 0)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2)) :
    v * k / t ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  have hE : 0 < r + 2 * t - t ^ 2 :=
    c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr (by linarith) hc2
  have hE0 : r + 2 * t - t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hE
  have hright : 0 ≤ -r * (r + t) * (t - 1) * qGeneral r t := by
    have hrt : 0 < r + t := by linarith
    have ht1 : 0 < t - 1 := by linarith
    have hqneg : 0 ≤ -qGeneral r t := neg_nonneg.mpr hQ
    have hp : 0 ≤ r * (r + t) * (t - 1) * (-qGeneral r t) := by
      positivity
    nlinarith
  have hident := discriminant_krein_identity hE0
  have hEsq : 0 < (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hE
  have hendpoint : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t
      (r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) / (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2)) := by
    by_contra hn
    have hneg : discriminantPoly r t
        (r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) / (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2)) < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hmul : discriminantPoly r t
        (r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r) / (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2)) *
          (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) ^ 2 < 0 :=
      mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hneg hEsq
    nlinarith [hident]
  exact target_of_concave_krein_threshold hr (by linarith) hmu hc2 hK hk
    hendpoint hv hgap

name: SRGInequality.target_of_verified_arithmetic_cases
statement:
theorem target_of_verified_arithmetic_cases
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hmu : 0 < mu) (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hcase :
      (t = 2 ∧ r ≤ 7 ∧ mu ≤ r + 4) ∨
      (t = 3 ∧ 13 ≤ r ∧ r ≤ 34 ∧
        mu ≤ 2 * r * (r + 9) / (r - 3)) ∨
      (2 ≤ t ∧ 0 ≤ discriminantC2 r t) ∨
      (4 ≤ t ∧ discriminantC2 r t < 0 ∧
        KreinBound k r t ∧ k = r * t + mu ∧
          qGeneral r t ≤ 0)) :
    v * k / t ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcase with h2 | h3 | hc2 | hq
  · rcases h2 with ⟨rfl, hr7, hmuL⟩
    exact target_of_t2_small hr hr7 hmu hmuL hv hgap
  · rcases h3 with ⟨rfl, hr13, hr34, hmuK⟩
    exact target_of_t3_mid hr13 hr34 hmu hmuK hv hgap
  · exact target_of_c2_nonneg hr hc2.1 hmu hc2.2 hv hgap (by linarith)
  · rcases hq with ⟨ht, hc2, hK, hk, hQ⟩
    exact target_of_general_Q_nonpos hr ht hmu hc2 hK hk hQ hv hgap

name: SRGInequality.target_of_absolute_gap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem target_of_absolute_gap_eq_zero
    {t k f g v : Real} (ht : Not (t = 0))
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k = 0) :
    v * k / t ^ 2 = g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  have hvg : v - g = f + 1 := by linarith [hv]
  have ht2 : Not (t ^ 2 = 0) := pow_ne_zero 2 ht
  rw [hvg]
  field_simp [ht2]
  nlinarith [hgap]

name: SRGInequality.target_of_D_nonneg_or_gap_zero
statement:
theorem target_of_D_nonneg_or_gap_zero
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hD : Or (LE.le 0 (discriminantPoly r t mu))
      (t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k = 0))
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly r t mu)) :
    LE.le (v * k / t ^ 2) (g * (v - g))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hD with hD | hzero
  · have hden : 0 < mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2 := by
      have hrt : 0 < r + t := by linarith
      positivity
    exact target_divided_of_nonnegative_discriminant hv hgap hD hN hden (ne_of_gt ht)
  · have heq := target_of_absolute_gap_eq_zero (ne_of_gt ht) hv hzero
    exact le_of_eq heq

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_D_or_gap_zero
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_D_or_gap_zero
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0))
    (hD : Or
      (LE.le 0 (discriminantPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real)))
      ((-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 *
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) + 1) -
        (v : Real) * k = 0))
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real))) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨hpart, htrace, _, _, _⟩
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast hpart
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - (v : Real) * k =
      discriminantPoly r t (mu : Real) * auxiliaryPoly r t (mu : Real) /
        ((mu : Real) ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2) := by
    dsimp [r, t, f, g]
    exact srg_gap_factorization G h hc hne ht0
  rcases hD with hD | hzero
  · exact srg_target_of_D_nonneg G h hc hne ht0 hD hN
  · have heq := target_of_absolute_gap_eq_zero ht0 hv (by
      simpa [t, f, g] using hzero)
    exact le_of_eq (by simpa [t, f, g] using heq)

name: SRGInequality.target_of_verified_cases_or_gap_zero
statement:
theorem target_of_verified_cases_or_gap_zero
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : Not (t = 0)) (hmu : 0 < mu) (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hcase : Or (ArithmeticCase r t mu k)
      (t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k = 0)) :
    LE.le (v * k / t ^ 2) (g * (v - g))
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcase with hcase | hzero
  · exact target_of_verified_arithmetic_cases hr hmu hv hgap
      (by simpa [ArithmeticCase] using hcase)
  · have heq := target_of_absolute_gap_eq_zero
      ht hv hzero
    exact le_of_eq heq

name: SRGInequality.srg_target_of_verified_cases_or_gap_zero
statement:
theorem srg_target_of_verified_cases_or_gap_zero
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v k lambda mu : Nat}
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (ht0 : Not (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0))
    (hr : 0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hcase : Or
      (ArithmeticCase (restrictedPos k lambda mu)
        (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) (mu : Real) (k : Real))
      ((-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2 *
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) + 1) -
        (v : Real) * k = 0)) :
    LE.le ((v : Real) * k / (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu) ^ 2)
      ((negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        ((v : Real) - negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  let r : Real := restrictedPos k lambda mu
  let t : Real := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu
  let f : Real := positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  let g : Real := negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨hpart, htrace, _, _, _⟩
  have hv : (v : Real) = f + g + 1 := by
    have hp : (v : Real) = 1 +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) := by
      exact_mod_cast hpart
    dsimp [f, g]
    nlinarith [hp]
  have hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - (v : Real) * k =
      discriminantPoly r t (mu : Real) * auxiliaryPoly r t (mu : Real) /
        ((mu : Real) ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2) := by
    dsimp [r, t, f, g]
    exact srg_gap_factorization G h hc hne ht0
  have hr' : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact hr
  have hmu : 0 < (mu : Real) := by
    exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hcase' : Or (ArithmeticCase r t (mu : Real) (k : Real))
      (t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - (v : Real) * k = 0) := by
    rcases hcase with hcase | hzero
    · exact Or.inl (by simpa [r, t] using hcase)
    · exact Or.inr (by simpa [t, f, g] using hzero)
  have hout := target_of_verified_cases_or_gap_zero
    hr' (by simpa [t] using ht0) hmu hv hgap hcase'
  simpa [r, t, f, g] using hout

name: SRGInequality.target_of_strict_absolute_case
statement:
theorem target_of_strict_absolute_case
    {r t mu muK k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hdisc : LE.le 0 (discriminantQuadratic r t))
    (hzero : LE.le 0 (discriminantPoly r t 0))
    (hrootcount : LE.le ((absolutePolyGeneralPolynomial r t).roots.countP (fun x => 0 < x)) 2)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral r t muK < 0)
    (hcases : Or (LE.le mu (muPlusFormula r t))
      (And (0 < muPlusFormula r t) (And (muPlusFormula r t < mu) (mu < muK))))
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly r t mu)) :
    LE.le (v * k / t ^ 2) (g * (v - g))
proof:
:= by
  have hD := discriminant_nonneg_of_absolute_cases
    (_muPlus := muPlusFormula r t) hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero
    (le_of_lt hmu) hrootcount hA0 hAplus hAmu hAK hcases
  exact target_of_D_nonneg_or_gap_zero hr ht hmu hv hgap
    (Or.inl hD) hN

name: SRGInequality.target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_a2_range
statement:
theorem target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_a2_range
    {r t mu muK k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hdisc : LE.le 0 (discriminantQuadratic r t))
    (hzero : LE.le 0 (discriminantPoly r t 0))
    (ht4 : LE.le 4 t)
    (hr0 : LE.le (2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t) r)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral r t muK < 0)
    (hcases : Or (LE.le mu (muPlusFormula r t))
      (And (0 < muPlusFormula r t) (And (muPlusFormula r t < mu) (mu < muK))))
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly r t mu)) :
    LE.le (v * k / t ^ 2) (g * (v - g))
proof:
:= by
  have hroot := absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_range hr ht4 hr0
  exact target_of_strict_absolute_case hr ht hmu hv hgap hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero
    hroot hA0 hAplus hAmu hAK hcases hN

name: SRGInequality.target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_a1_pos_range
statement:
theorem target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_a1_pos_range
    {r t mu muK k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hdisc : LE.le 0 (discriminantQuadratic r t))
    (hzero : LE.le 0 (discriminantPoly r t 0))
    (ht1 : 1 < t)
    (ha3 : generalA3 r t < 0) (ha1 : 0 < generalA1 r t)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral r t muK < 0)
    (hcases : Or (LE.le mu (muPlusFormula r t))
      (And (0 < muPlusFormula r t) (And (muPlusFormula r t < mu) (mu < muK))))
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly r t mu)) :
    LE.le (v * k / t ^ 2) (g * (v - g))
proof:
:= by
  have hroot := absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_pos_range hr ht1 ha3 ha1
  exact target_of_strict_absolute_case hr ht hmu hv hgap hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero
    hroot hA0 hAplus hAmu hAK hcases hN

name: SRGInequality.target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_q_pos_a2_range
statement:
theorem target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_q_pos_a2_range
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (ht4 : 4 ≤ t) (hr0 : 2 * t ^ 3 - 2 * t ^ 2 - t ≤ r)
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound k r t) (hk : k = r * t + mu)
    (hQ : 0 < qGeneral r t)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muKFormula r t) < 0)
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly r t mu)) :
    LE.le (v * k / t ^ 2) (g * (v - g))
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t := discriminantC0_pos hr (by linarith [ht4])
  have hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (discriminantC1 r t),
      mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc2 hc0]
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt hc0
  have hE : 0 < energyE r t := c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr (by linarith [ht4]) hc2
  have hmuK : mu ≤ muKFormula r t := by
    have hL := mu_le_krein_threshold hK hk hE
    simpa [muKFormula, energyE] using hL
  have hmuK_nonneg : 0 ≤ muKFormula r t :=
    le_trans (le_of_lt hmu) hmuK
  have hplusK : muPlusFormula r t < muKFormula r t :=
    muPlus_lt_muK_of_q_pos hr (by linarith) hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero hE hQ hmuK_nonneg
  have hmuK_strict : mu < muKFormula r t := by
    by_contra hn
    have heq : mu = muKFormula r t := le_antisymm hmuK (le_of_not_gt hn)
    rw [heq] at hAmu
    linarith
  have hcases : Or (mu ≤ muPlusFormula r t)
      (And (0 < muPlusFormula r t)
        (And (muPlusFormula r t < mu) (mu < muKFormula r t))) := by
    by_cases hleft : mu ≤ muPlusFormula r t
    · exact Or.inl hleft
    · exact Or.inr ⟨muPlus_pos_of_c2_neg_c0_pos hc2 hc0 hdisc,
        lt_of_not_ge hleft, hmuK_strict⟩
  exact target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_a2_range hr ht hmu hv hgap hc2 hc0
    hdisc hzero ht4 hr0 hA0 hAplus hAmu hAK hcases hN

name: SRGInequality.target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_a1_neg_range
statement:
theorem target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_a1_neg_range
    {r t mu muK k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t)
    (hdisc : LE.le 0 (discriminantQuadratic r t))
    (hzero : LE.le 0 (discriminantPoly r t 0))
    (ht1 : 1 < t)
    (ha3 : generalA3 r t < 0) (ha2 : LE.le (generalA2 r t) 0)
    (ha1 : generalA1 r t < 0)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral r t muK < 0)
    (hcases : Or (LE.le mu (muPlusFormula r t))
      (And (0 < muPlusFormula r t) (And (muPlusFormula r t < mu) (mu < muK))))
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly r t mu)) :
    LE.le (v * k / t ^ 2) (g * (v - g))
proof:
:= by
  have hroot := absolutePolyGeneral_roots_le_two_of_a1_neg_range hr ht1 ha3 ha2 ha1
  exact target_of_strict_absolute_case hr ht hmu hv hgap hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero
    hroot hA0 hAplus hAmu hAK hcases hN

name: SRGInequality.target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_q_pos_a1_sign
statement:
theorem target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_q_pos_a1_sign
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (ht4 : 4 ≤ t) (ha3 : generalA3 r t < 0)
    (hsign : 0 < generalA1 r t ∨
      (LE.le (generalA2 r t) 0 ∧ generalA1 r t < 0))
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound k r t) (hk : k = r * t + mu)
    (hQ : 0 < qGeneral r t)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muKFormula r t) < 0)
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly r t mu)) :
    LE.le (v * k / t ^ 2) (g * (v - g))
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : 0 < discriminantC0 r t := discriminantC0_pos hr (by linarith [ht4])
  have hdisc : 0 ≤ discriminantQuadratic r t := by
    dsimp [discriminantQuadratic]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (discriminantC1 r t),
      mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hc2 hc0]
  have hzero : 0 ≤ discriminantPoly r t 0 := by
    rw [discriminantPoly_at_zero]
    exact le_of_lt hc0
  have hE : 0 < energyE r t := c2_neg_implies_E_pos hr (by linarith [ht4]) hc2
  have hmuK : mu ≤ muKFormula r t := by
    have hL := mu_le_krein_threshold hK hk hE
    simpa [muKFormula, energyE] using hL
  have hmuK_nonneg : 0 ≤ muKFormula r t := le_trans (le_of_lt hmu) hmuK
  have hplusK : muPlusFormula r t < muKFormula r t :=
    muPlus_lt_muK_of_q_pos hr (by linarith [ht4]) hc2 hc0 hdisc hzero hE hQ hmuK_nonneg
  have hmuK_strict : mu < muKFormula r t := by
    by_contra hn
    have heq : mu = muKFormula r t := le_antisymm hmuK (le_of_not_gt hn)
    rw [heq] at hAmu
    linarith
  have hcases : Or (mu ≤ muPlusFormula r t)
      (And (0 < muPlusFormula r t)
        (And (muPlusFormula r t < mu) (mu < muKFormula r t))) := by
    by_cases hleft : mu ≤ muPlusFormula r t
    · exact Or.inl hleft
    · exact Or.inr ⟨muPlus_pos_of_c2_neg_c0_pos hc2 hc0 hdisc,
        lt_of_not_ge hleft, hmuK_strict⟩
  rcases hsign with ha1pos | ha1neg
  · exact target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_a1_pos_range hr ht hmu hv hgap hc2 hc0
      hdisc hzero (by linarith [ht4]) ha3 ha1pos hA0 hAplus hAmu hAK hcases hN
  · exact target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_a1_neg_range hr ht hmu hv hgap hc2 hc0
      hdisc hzero (by linarith [ht4]) ha3 ha1neg.1 ha1neg.2
      hA0 hAplus hAmu hAK hcases hN

name: SRGInequality.target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_q_pos_range
statement:
theorem target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_q_pos_range
    {r t mu k f g v : Real}
    (hr : 0 < r) (ht : 0 < t) (hmu : 0 < mu)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k =
      discriminantPoly r t mu * auxiliaryPoly r t mu /
        (mu ^ 2 * (r + t) ^ 2))
    (ht4 : 4 ≤ t)
    (hr0 : 2 * t ^ 3 - 3 * t ^ 2 + 1 ≤ r)
    (hsign : 0 < generalA1 r t ∨
      (LE.le (generalA2 r t) 0 ∧ generalA1 r t < 0))
    (hc2 : discriminantC2 r t < 0)
    (hK : KreinBound k r t) (hk : k = r * t + mu)
    (hQ : 0 < qGeneral r t)
    (hA0 : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t 0)
    (hAplus : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muPlusFormula r t) < 0)
    (hAmu : 0 < absolutePolyGeneral r t mu)
    (hAK : absolutePolyGeneral r t (muKFormula r t) < 0)
    (hN : LE.le 0 (auxiliaryPoly r t mu)) :
    LE.le (v * k / t ^ 2) (g * (v - g))
proof:
:= by
  have ha3 : generalA3 r t < 0 := generalA3_neg_bridge ht4 hr0
  exact target_of_strict_absolute_case_of_q_pos_a1_sign hr ht hmu hv hgap ht4
    ha3 hsign hc2 hK hk hQ hA0 hAplus hAmu hAK hN

name: SRGInequality.absoluteBound_gap_nonneg
statement:
lemma absoluteBound_gap_nonneg {v f : Real} (hA : AbsoluteBound v f) :
    0 <= f * (f + 3) - 2 * v
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [AbsoluteBound] at hA
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.absoluteBound_gap_nonneg_real
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.restricted_root_aux
statement:
private lemma restricted_root_aux (k lambda mu : Nat)
    (hdisc : 0 <= ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu))
    (sgn : Real) (hsgn : sgn ^ 2 = 1) :
    let x := (((lambda : Real) - mu) + sgn * spectralDelta k lambda mu) / 2
    x ^ 2 - ((lambda : Real) - mu) * x - ((k : Real) - mu) = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [spectralDelta]
  have hsqrt :
      (Real.sqrt (((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu))) ^ 2 =
        ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu) :=
    Real.sq_sqrt hdisc
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.restrictedPos_is_root
statement:
lemma restrictedPos_is_root
    (hdisc : 0 <= ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu)) :
    restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 -
        ((lambda : Real) - mu) * restrictedPos k lambda mu -
        ((k : Real) - mu) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [restrictedPos] using
    restricted_root_aux k lambda mu hdisc (1 : Real) (by norm_num)

name: SRGInequality.restrictedNeg_is_root
statement:
lemma restrictedNeg_is_root
    (hdisc : 0 <= ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu)) :
    restrictedNeg k lambda mu ^ 2 -
        ((lambda : Real) - mu) * restrictedNeg k lambda mu -
        ((k : Real) - mu) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [restrictedNeg, sub_eq_add_neg] using
    restricted_root_aux k lambda mu hdisc (-1 : Real) (by norm_num)

name: SRGInequality.eq_restrictedPos_or_restrictedNeg_of_quadratic
statement:
lemma eq_restrictedPos_or_restrictedNeg_of_quadratic
    (hdisc : 0 <= ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu))
    {x : Real}
    (hx : x ^ 2 - ((lambda : Real) - mu) * x - ((k : Real) - mu) = 0) :
    x = restrictedPos k lambda mu ∨ x = restrictedNeg k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  have hp := restrictedPos_is_root (k := k) (lambda := lambda) (mu := mu) hdisc
  have hn := restrictedNeg_is_root (k := k) (lambda := lambda) (mu := mu) hdisc
  have hsum :
      restrictedPos k lambda mu + restrictedNeg k lambda mu =
        (lambda : Real) - mu := by
    simp [restrictedPos, restrictedNeg]
    ring
  have hprod :
      restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu =
        (mu : Real) - k := by
    nlinarith
  rw [show x ^ 2 - ((lambda : Real) - mu) * x - ((k : Real) - mu) =
      (x - restrictedPos k lambda mu) *
        (x - restrictedNeg k lambda mu) by
          calc
            _ = x ^ 2 -
                (restrictedPos k lambda mu + restrictedNeg k lambda mu) * x +
                restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu := by
                  rw [hsum, hprod]
                  ring
            _ = _ := by ring] at hx
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hx with hx | hx
  · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp hx)
  · exact Or.inr (sub_eq_zero.mp hx)

name: SRGInequality.compl_adjMatrix_mulVec_of_sum_eq_zero
statement:
lemma compl_adjMatrix_mulVec_of_sum_eq_zero
    {x : V -> Real} (hxsum : (∑ i, x i) = 0) :
    Matrix.mulVec (Gᶜ.adjMatrix Real) x = -x - Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) x
proof:
:= by
  have hm :
      G.adjMatrix Real + Gᶜ.adjMatrix Real =
        (SimpleGraph.completeGraph V).adjMatrix Real :=
    SimpleGraph.IsCompl.adjMatrix_add_adjMatrix_eq_adjMatrix_completeGraph Real
      (isCompl_compl : IsCompl G Gᶜ)
  rw [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_completeGraph_eq_of_one_sub_one] at hm
  have hc : Gᶜ.adjMatrix Real = Matrix.of 1 - 1 - G.adjMatrix Real := by
    rw [← hm]
    abel
  rw [hc, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec]
  funext i
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hxsum]

name: SRGInequality.restricted_quadratic_of_eigenvector
statement:
lemma restricted_quadratic_of_eigenvector
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) {x : Real} {u : V -> Real}
    (hu : Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) u = x • u)
    (husum : (∑ i, u i) = 0) (hne : u ≠ 0) :
    x ^ 2 - ((lambda : Real) - mu) * x - ((k : Real) - mu) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmatrix := congrArg (fun A : Matrix V V Real => Matrix.mulVec A u) h.matrix_eq
  have hcomp := compl_adjMatrix_mulVec_of_sum_eq_zero G husum
  rw [pow_two, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, hu, Matrix.mulVec_smul] at hmatrix
  simp only [Matrix.add_mulVec, Matrix.smul_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, hcomp] at hmatrix
  rw [hu] at hmatrix
  have hpoint : ∃ i, u i ≠ 0 := Function.ne_iff.mp hne
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hpoint
  have := congrFun hmatrix i
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.neg_apply] at this
  norm_num at this
  have hzero :
      (x ^ 2 - ((lambda : Real) - mu) * x - ((k : Real) - mu)) * u i = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = x * (x * u i) -
          ((k : Real) * u i + (lambda : Real) * (x * u i) +
            (mu : Real) * (-u i - x * u i)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [this]; ring
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_right hi

name: SRGInequality.sum_adjMatrix_mulVec
statement:
lemma sum_adjMatrix_mulVec (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (u : V -> Real) :
    (∑ i, Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) u i) = (k : Real) * ∑ i, u i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let one : V -> Real := Function.const V 1
  have hp : Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) one = Function.const V (k : Real) :=
    principal_eigenvector G h
  calc
    (∑ i, Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) u i) =
        dotProduct one (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) u) := by
      simp [one, dotProduct]
    _ = dotProduct one (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real).transpose u) := by
      rw [SimpleGraph.transpose_adjMatrix]
    _ = dotProduct u (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) one) :=
      Matrix.dotProduct_transpose_mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) one u
    _ = (k : Real) * ∑ i, u i := by
      rw [hp]
      simp only [dotProduct, Function.const_apply]
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      ring

name: SRGInequality.sum_eq_zero_of_eigenvector_of_ne_degree
statement:
lemma sum_eq_zero_of_eigenvector_of_ne_degree
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) {x : Real} {u : V -> Real}
    (hu : Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) u = x • u) (hx : x ≠ (k : Real)) :
    (∑ i, u i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum := congrArg (fun w : V -> Real => ∑ i, w i) hu
  rw [sum_adjMatrix_mulVec G h] at hsum
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hsum
  have hprod : ((k : Real) - x) * ∑ i, u i = 0 := by linarith
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hx.symm)

name: SRGInequality.adjacencyEigenvalue_eq_degree_or_restricted
statement:
lemma adjacencyEigenvalue_eq_degree_or_restricted
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu)
    (hdisc : 0 <= ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu)) (i : V) :
    adjacencyEigenvalues G i = (k : Real) ∨
      adjacencyEigenvalues G i = restrictedPos k lambda mu ∨
      adjacencyEigenvalues G i = restrictedNeg k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hik : adjacencyEigenvalues G i = (k : Real)
  · exact Or.inl hik
  · right
    let hA := G.isHermitian_adjMatrix Real
    let u : V -> Real := ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)
    have hu : Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) u = adjacencyEigenvalues G i • u := by
      simpa [adjacencyEigenvalues, hA, u] using hA.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
    have husum : (∑ j, u j) = 0 :=
      sum_eq_zero_of_eigenvector_of_ne_degree G h hu hik
    have hune : u ≠ 0 := by
      exact (WithLp.ofLp_eq_zero 2).ne.2 <| hA.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.ne_zero i
    exact eq_restrictedPos_or_restrictedNeg_of_quadratic hdisc
      (restricted_quadratic_of_eigenvector G h hu husum hune)

name: SRGInequality.mu_le_degree_of_ne_complete
statement:
lemma mu_le_degree_of_ne_complete (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    mu ≤ k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hnab⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
  rw [← h.of_not_adj hab hnab]
  simpa [h.regular.degree_eq] using G.card_commonNeighbors_le_degree_left a b

name: SRGInequality.spectral_discriminant_nonneg_of_ne_complete
statement:
lemma spectral_discriminant_nonneg_of_ne_complete
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    0 <= ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmu : mu ≤ k := mu_le_degree_of_ne_complete G h hne
  have hmuR : (mu : Real) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hmu
  positivity

name: SRGInequality.adjacencyEigenvalue_eq_degree_or_restricted_of_ne_complete
statement:
lemma adjacencyEigenvalue_eq_degree_or_restricted_of_ne_complete
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) (i : V) :
    adjacencyEigenvalues G i = (k : Real) ∨
      adjacencyEigenvalues G i = restrictedPos k lambda mu ∨
      adjacencyEigenvalues G i = restrictedNeg k lambda mu
proof:
:=
  adjacencyEigenvalue_eq_degree_or_restricted G h
    (spectral_discriminant_nonneg_of_ne_complete G h hne) i

name: SRGInequality.eigenvector_eq_const_of_eigenvalue_degree
statement:
lemma eigenvector_eq_const_of_eigenvalue_degree
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) {u : V -> Real}
    (hu : Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) u = (k : Real) • u) :
    ∃ c : Real, u = Function.const V c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlap : Matrix.mulVec (G.lapMatrix Real) u = 0 := by
    funext i
    rw [SimpleGraph.lapMatrix_mulVec_apply]
    have hui := congrFun hu i
    rw [SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_mulVec_apply] at hui
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hui
    rw [h.regular.degree_eq, hui]
    norm_num
  have hconst := (SimpleGraph.lapMatrix_mulVec_eq_zero_iff_forall_reachable G).mp hlap
  letI : Nonempty V := hc.nonempty
  let a : V := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty V)
  refine ⟨u a, funext fun i => ?_⟩
  exact hconst i a (hc.preconnected i a)

name: SRGInequality.degree_eigenvalue_index_unique
statement:
lemma degree_eigenvalue_index_unique
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) {i j : V}
    (hi : adjacencyEigenvalues G i = (k : Real))
    (hj : adjacencyEigenvalues G j = (k : Real)) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  let hA := G.isHermitian_adjMatrix Real
  let ui : V -> Real := ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis i)
  let uj : V -> Real := ⇑(hA.eigenvectorBasis j)
  have hi' : hA.eigenvalues i = (k : Real) := by
    simpa [adjacencyEigenvalues, hA] using hi
  have hj' : hA.eigenvalues j = (k : Real) := by
    simpa [adjacencyEigenvalues, hA] using hj
  have hui : Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) ui = (k : Real) • ui := by
    simpa [ui, hi'] using hA.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis i
  have huj : Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) uj = (k : Real) • uj := by
    simpa [uj, hj'] using hA.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis j
  obtain ⟨ci, hci⟩ := eigenvector_eq_const_of_eigenvalue_degree G h hc hui
  obtain ⟨cj, hcj⟩ := eigenvector_eq_const_of_eigenvalue_degree G h hc huj
  by_contra hij
  have hinner := hA.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.inner_eq_zero hij
  have hdot : dotProduct ui uj = 0 := by
    simpa [EuclideanSpace.inner_eq_star_dotProduct, ui, uj, dotProduct_comm] using hinner
  rw [hci, hcj] at hdot
  letI : Nonempty V := hc.nonempty
  have hcard : (Fintype.card V : Real) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hci0 : ci ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hui0 : ui = 0 := by simp [hci, hzero]
    exact (WithLp.ofLp_eq_zero 2).ne.2 (hA.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.ne_zero i) hui0
  have hcj0 : cj ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have huj0 : uj = 0 := by simp [hcj, hzero]
    exact (WithLp.ofLp_eq_zero 2).ne.2 (hA.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.ne_zero j) huj0
  simp only [dotProduct, Function.const_apply, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    nsmul_eq_mul] at hdot
  exact (mul_ne_zero hcard (mul_ne_zero hci0 hcj0)) hdot

name: SRGInequality.degree_eigenvalue_index_exists
statement:
lemma degree_eigenvalue_index_exists
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) :
    ∃ i : V, adjacencyEigenvalues G i = (k : Real)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Nonempty V := hc.nonempty
  let hA := G.isHermitian_adjMatrix Real
  let hT := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hA
  let oneE : EuclideanSpace Real V := WithLp.toLp 2 (Function.const V 1)
  have honeig : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (G.adjMatrix Real) oneE = (k : Real) • oneE := by
    rw [Matrix.toLpLin_apply]
    change WithLp.toLp 2 (Matrix.mulVec (G.adjMatrix Real) (Function.const V 1)) = _
    rw [principal_eigenvector G h]
    ext i
    simp [oneE]
  have hone_ne : oneE ≠ 0 := by
    intro hone
    have hz := congrArg WithLp.ofLp hone
    let a : V := Classical.choice (inferInstance : Nonempty V)
    have hza := congrFun hz a
    simp [oneE] at hza
  have hvec :
      Module.End.HasEigenvector (Matrix.toEuclideanLin (G.adjMatrix Real)) (k : Real) oneE :=
    ⟨Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.mpr honeig, hone_ne⟩
  have heig := Module.End.hasEigenvalue_of_hasEigenvector hvec
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hT.exists_eigenvalues_eq finrank_euclideanSpace heig
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card V) ≃ V :=
    Fintype.equivOfCardEq (Fintype.card_fin (Fintype.card V))
  refine ⟨e j, ?_⟩
  simpa [adjacencyEigenvalues, Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues,
    Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues₀, hA, hT, e] using hj

name: SRGInequality.degree_eigenMultiplicity_eq_one
statement:
lemma degree_eigenMultiplicity_eq_one
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) :
    eigenMultiplicity G (k : Real) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eigenMultiplicity, Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := degree_eigenvalue_index_exists G h hc
  refine ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, fun j => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  exact degree_eigenvalue_index_unique G h hc j.property hi

name: SRGInequality.card_eq_sum_three_fibers
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hba : b ≠ a := Ne.symm hab
  have hca : c ≠ a := Ne.symm hac
  have hcb : c ≠ b := Ne.symm hbc
  let e : I ≃ ({i : I // q i = a} ⊕ ({i : I // q i = b} ⊕ {i : I // q i = c})) :=
    { toFun := fun i =>
      if ha : q i = a then Sum.inl ⟨i, ha⟩
      else if hb : q i = b then Sum.inr (Sum.inl ⟨i, hb⟩)
      else Sum.inr (Sum.inr ⟨i, (hall i).resolve_left ha |>.resolve_left hb⟩)
      invFun := fun x => match x with
      | Sum.inl i => i
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inl i) => i
      | Sum.inr (Sum.inr i) => i
      left_inv := fun i => by
        by_cases ha : q i = a
        · simp [ha]
        · by_cases hb : q i = b
          · simp [hb, hba]
          · simp [ha, hb]
      right_inv := fun x => by
        rcases x with i | i
        · simp [i.property]
        · rcases i with i | i
          · simp [i.property, hba]
          · simp [i.property, hca, hcb] }
  calc
    Fintype.card I =
        Fintype.card ({i : I // q i = a} ⊕
          ({i : I // q i = b} ⊕ {i : I // q i = c})) := Fintype.card_congr e
    _ = _ := by simp [add_assoc]

name: SRGInequality.multiplicity_partition_of_distinct
statement:
lemma multiplicity_partition_of_distinct
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤)
    (hkr : (k : Real) ≠ restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (hks : (k : Real) ≠ restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
    (hrs : restrictedPos k lambda mu ≠ restrictedNeg k lambda mu) :
    v = 1 + positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu + negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  have hall := adjacencyEigenvalue_eq_degree_or_restricted_of_ne_complete G h hne
  have hcard := card_eq_sum_three_fibers (adjacencyEigenvalues G) hkr hks hrs hall
  rw [h.card] at hcard
  change v = eigenMultiplicity G (k : Real) +
      eigenMultiplicity G (restrictedPos k lambda mu) +
      eigenMultiplicity G (restrictedNeg k lambda mu) at hcard
  rw [degree_eigenMultiplicity_eq_one G h hc] at hcard
  simpa [positiveMultiplicity, negativeMultiplicity] using hcard

name: SRGInequality.degree_pos_of_connected_ne_complete
statement:
lemma degree_pos_of_connected_ne_complete
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    0 < k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, _⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
  letI : Nontrivial V := ⟨⟨a, b, hab⟩⟩
  have hp := hc.preconnected.degree_pos_of_nontrivial a
  simpa [h.regular.degree_eq] using hp

name: SRGInequality.lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete
statement:
lemma lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    lambda < k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hk : 0 < k := degree_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  obtain ⟨a, b, _, _⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
  obtain ⟨b', hab⟩ := (G.degree_pos_iff_exists_adj a).mp (by
    simpa [h.regular.degree_eq] using hk)
  rw [← h.of_adj a b' hab]
  simpa [h.regular.degree_eq] using hab.card_commonNeighbors_lt_degree

name: SRGInequality.spectral_discriminant_pos_of_connected_ne_complete
statement:
lemma spectral_discriminant_pos_of_connected_ne_complete
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    0 < ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmu : mu ≤ k := mu_le_degree_of_ne_complete G h hne
  have hlam : lambda < k := lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  by_cases hmk : mu < k
  · have hmkR : 0 < (k : Real) - mu := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hmk)
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((lambda : Real) - mu)]
  · have hkm : k = mu := Nat.le_antisymm (Nat.not_lt.mp hmk) hmu
    have hlamu : lambda < mu := by simpa [hkm] using hlam
    have hlamuR : (lambda : Real) - mu ≠ 0 := by
      apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_lt hlamu)
    have hsquare : 0 < ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hlamuR
    simpa [hkm] using hsquare

name: SRGInequality.restrictedPos_ne_restrictedNeg_of_connected_ne_complete
statement:
lemma restrictedPos_ne_restrictedNeg_of_connected_ne_complete
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    restrictedPos k lambda mu ≠ restrictedNeg k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hd := spectral_discriminant_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  intro heq
  have hsqrt : spectralDelta k lambda mu = 0 := by
    dsimp [restrictedPos, restrictedNeg] at heq
    linarith
  have := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hd
  exact (ne_of_gt this) hsqrt

name: SRGInequality.mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete
statement:
lemma mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    0 < mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hnab⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
  have hdist := hc.one_lt_dist_of_ne_of_not_adj hab hnab
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hc.preconnected a b |>.exists_walk_length_eq_dist
  obtain ⟨x, y, z, hxy, hyz, hnxz, hxz⟩ := p.exists_adj_adj_not_adj_ne hp hdist
  have hycommon : y ∈ G.commonNeighbors x z := by
    simp only [SimpleGraph.mem_commonNeighbors]
    exact ⟨hxy, hyz.symm⟩
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card (G.commonNeighbors x z) :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨y, hycommon⟩
  rw [h.of_not_adj hxz hnxz] at hpos
  exact hpos

name: SRGInequality.restrictedPos_ne_degree_of_connected_ne_complete
statement:
lemma restrictedPos_ne_degree_of_connected_ne_complete
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    (k : Real) ≠ restrictedPos k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmu : 0 < mu := mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hdisc := spectral_discriminant_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  intro heq
  have hroot := restrictedPos_is_root (k := k) (lambda := lambda) (mu := mu) hdisc.le
  rw [← heq] at hroot
  obtain ⟨a, _, _, _⟩ := SimpleGraph.ne_top_iff_exists_not_adj.mp hne
  have hvk : k < v := by
    rw [← h.card]
    simpa [h.regular.degree_eq] using G.degree_lt_card_verts a
  have hlam := lambda_lt_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hlk : lambda + 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hvk' : k + 1 ≤ v := by omega
  have hkl : 1 ≤ k - lambda := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hlam
  have hvdiff : 1 ≤ v - k := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hvk
  have hcastkl : ((k - lambda : Nat) : Real) = (k : Real) - lambda := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : lambda ≤ k)]
  have hcastvk : ((v - k : Nat) : Real) = (v : Real) - k := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : k ≤ v)]
  have hcastkl1 : ((k - lambda - 1 : Nat) : Real) = (k : Real) - lambda - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hkl, hcastkl]
    norm_num
  have hcastvk1 : ((v - k - 1 : Nat) : Real) = (v : Real) - k - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hvdiff, hcastvk]
    norm_num
  have hparam := srg_parameter_identity G h (by
    rw [← h.card]
    exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hc.nonempty)
  have hmuR : (0 : Real) < mu := by exact_mod_cast hmu
  have hvR : (0 : Real) < v := by
    rw [← h.card]
    exact_mod_cast (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hc.nonempty)
  have hparamR := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : Real)) hparam
  norm_num [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub hlk, Nat.cast_sub hvk'] at hparamR
  rw [hcastkl1, hcastvk1] at hparamR
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.multiplicity_partition
statement:
lemma multiplicity_partition
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    v = 1 + positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu + negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  apply multiplicity_partition_of_distinct G h hc hne
  · exact restrictedPos_ne_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  · exact restrictedNeg_ne_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  · exact restrictedPos_ne_restrictedNeg_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne

name: SRGInequality.sum_eq_weighted_three_fibers
statement:
private lemma sum_eq_weighted_three_fibers {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (q : I -> Real) {a b c : Real}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hall : ∀ i, q i = a ∨ q i = b ∨ q i = c) :
    (∑ i, q i) =
      (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = a} : Real) * a +
      (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = b} : Real) * b +
      (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = c} : Real) * c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpoint : ∀ i, q i = (if q i = a then a else if q i = b then b else c) := by
    intro i
    rcases hall i with ha | hb | hc
    · rw [if_pos ha]
      exact ha
    · have hqa : q i ≠ a := fun hqa => hab (hqa.symm.trans hb)
      rw [if_neg hqa, if_pos hb]
      exact hb
    · have hqa : q i ≠ a := fun hqa => hac (hqa.symm.trans hc)
      have hqb : q i ≠ b := fun hqb => hbc (hqb.symm.trans hc)
      rw [if_neg hqa, if_neg hqb, hc]
  calc
    (∑ i, q i) = ∑ i, (if q i = a then a else if q i = b then b else c) := by
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hpoint i)
    _ = (∑ i, if q i = a then a else 0) +
          ∑ i, if q i = a then 0 else if q i = b then b else c := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      by_cases ha' : q i = a <;> simp [ha']
    _ = (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = a} : Real) * a +
          ((Fintype.card {i : I // q i = b} : Real) * b +
            (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = c} : Real) * c) := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_ite, Finset.sum_const,
        nsmul_eq_mul, Fintype.card_subtype]
      have hbset :
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : I => ¬ q x = a)).filter (fun x => q x = b) =
            Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x = b) := by
        ext x
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        constructor
        · exact And.right
        · intro hxb
          constructor
          · intro hxa
            exact hab (hxa.symm.trans hxb)
          · exact hxb
      have hcset :
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : I => ¬ q x = a)).filter (fun x => ¬ q x = b) =
            Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x = c) := by
        ext x
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        constructor
        · intro h
          rcases hall x with hxa | hxb | hxc
          · exact False.elim (h.1 hxa)
          · exact False.elim (h.2 hxb)
          · exact hxc
        · intro hxc
          constructor
          · intro hxa
            exact hac (hxa.symm.trans hxc)
          · intro hxb
            exact hbc (hxb.symm.trans hxc)
      have hbcard := congrArg Finset.card hbset
      have hccard := congrArg Finset.card hcset
      rw [hbcard, hccard]
      ring
    _ = (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = a} : Real) * a +
          (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = b} : Real) * b +
          (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = c} : Real) * c := by ring

name: SRGInequality.sum_sq_eq_weighted_three_fibers
statement:
private lemma sum_sq_eq_weighted_three_fibers {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (q : I → Real) {a b c : Real}
    (hab : a ≠ b) (hac : a ≠ c) (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hall : ∀ i, q i = a ∨ q i = b ∨ q i = c) :
    (∑ i, (q i) ^ 2) =
      (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = a} : Real) * a ^ 2 +
      (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = b} : Real) * b ^ 2 +
      (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = c} : Real) * c ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpoint : ∀ i, q i ^ 2 =
      (if q i = a then a ^ 2 else if q i = b then b ^ 2 else c ^ 2) := by
    intro i
    rcases hall i with ha | hb | hc
    · rw [if_pos ha]; exact congrArg (fun x : Real => x ^ 2) ha
    · have hqa : q i ≠ a := fun hqa => hab (hqa.symm.trans hb)
      rw [if_neg hqa, if_pos hb]
      exact congrArg (fun x : Real => x ^ 2) hb
    · have hqa : q i ≠ a := fun hqa => hac (hqa.symm.trans hc)
      have hqb : q i ≠ b := fun hqb => hbc (hqb.symm.trans hc)
      rw [if_neg hqa, if_neg hqb]
      exact congrArg (fun x : Real => x ^ 2) hc
  have hsum := sum_eq_weighted_three_fibers q hab hac hbc hall
  calc
    (∑ i, q i ^ 2) = ∑ i, (if q i = a then a ^ 2 else if q i = b then b ^ 2 else c ^ 2) := by
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hpoint i)
    _ = (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = a} : Real) * a ^ 2 +
          (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = b} : Real) * b ^ 2 +
          (Fintype.card {i : I // q i = c} : Real) * c ^ 2 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_ite]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite]
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul,
        Fintype.card_subtype]
      have hbset :
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : I => ¬ q x = a)).filter (fun x => q x = b) =
            Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x = b) := by
        ext x
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        constructor
        · exact And.right
        · intro hxb
          exact ⟨fun hxa => hab (hxa.symm.trans hxb), hxb⟩
      have hcset :
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : I => ¬ q x = a)).filter (fun x => ¬ q x = b) =
            Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x = c) := by
        ext x
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        constructor
        · intro h
          rcases hall x with hxa | hxb | hxc
          · exact False.elim (h.1 hxa)
          · exact False.elim (h.2 hxb)
          · exact hxc
        · intro hxc
          exact ⟨fun hxa => hac (hxa.symm.trans hxc),
            fun hxb => hbc (hxb.symm.trans hxc)⟩
      rw [congrArg Finset.card hbset, congrArg Finset.card hcset]
      ring

name: SRGInequality.trace_eigenvalue_identity
statement:
lemma trace_eigenvalue_identity
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    (k : Real) + (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) * restrictedPos k lambda mu +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) * restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hall := adjacencyEigenvalue_eq_degree_or_restricted_of_ne_complete G h hne
  have hsum := sum_eq_weighted_three_fibers (adjacencyEigenvalues G)
    (restrictedPos_ne_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne)
    (restrictedNeg_ne_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne)
    (restrictedPos_ne_restrictedNeg_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne) hall
  have htrace : (G.adjMatrix Real).trace = 0 := by
    simp [Matrix.trace, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_apply]
  have heigtrace := (G.isHermitian_adjMatrix Real).trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues
  rw [htrace] at heigtrace
  change 0 = ∑ i, adjacencyEigenvalues G i at heigtrace
  have hcardk := degree_eigenMultiplicity_eq_one G h hc
  have hcardk' : Fintype.card {i : V // adjacencyEigenvalues G i = (k : Real)} = 1 := by
    simpa [eigenMultiplicity] using hcardk
  rw [hsum] at heigtrace
  rw [hcardk'] at heigtrace
  have htrace' :
      0 = (k : Real) +
        (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) * restrictedPos k lambda mu +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) * restrictedNeg k lambda mu := by
    simpa [positiveMultiplicity, negativeMultiplicity, eigenMultiplicity,
      mul_comm, add_assoc] using heigtrace
  linarith

name: SRGInequality.trace_adjMatrix_sq
statement:
lemma trace_adjMatrix_sq
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) :
    (G.adjMatrix Real * G.adjMatrix Real).trace = (v : Real) * k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, SimpleGraph.adjMatrix_mul_self_apply_self]
  have hfilter (i : V) :
      {x ∈ G.neighborFinset i | G.Adj i x} = G.neighborFinset i := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact hx.1
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨hx, (SimpleGraph.mem_neighborFinset (G := G) (v := i) x).mp hx⟩
  calc
    (∑ i, (G.degree i : Real)) = ∑ _i, (k : Real) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [h.regular.degree_eq]
    _ = (Fintype.card V : Real) * k := by simp
    _ = (v : Real) * k := by rw [h.card]

name: SRGInequality.restricted_sum
statement:
lemma restricted_sum (k lambda mu : Nat) :
    restrictedPos k lambda mu + restrictedNeg k lambda mu =
      (lambda : Real) - mu
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrictedPos, restrictedNeg]
  ring

name: SRGInequality.restricted_product_of_nonneg
statement:
lemma restricted_product_of_nonneg
    (hdisc : 0 ≤ ((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 + 4 * ((k : Real) - mu)) :
    restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu =
      (mu : Real) - k
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt := Real.sq_sqrt hdisc
  simp [restrictedPos, restrictedNeg, spectralDelta] at hsqrt ⊢
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.hermitian_trace_sq_eq_sum_eigenvalue_sq
statement:
lemma hermitian_trace_sq_eq_sum_eigenvalue_sq
    {A : Matrix V V Real} (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (A * A).trace = ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let T : EuclideanSpace Real V →ₗ[Real] EuclideanSpace Real V :=
    Matrix.toEuclideanLin A
  let U := T.comp T
  have hsum := LinearMap.trace_eq_sum_inner U hA.eigenvectorBasis
  have htrace : U.trace Real (EuclideanSpace Real V) = (A * A).trace := by
    rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace Real
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun V Real).toBasis U]
    simp [U, T, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply, Matrix.toLpLin_apply,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.col, Matrix.trace]
  rw [htrace] at hsum
  have heig (i : V) : T (hA.eigenvectorBasis i) =
      (hA.eigenvalues i) • hA.eigenvectorBasis i := by
    change WithLp.toLp 2 (A.mulVec (hA.eigenvectorBasis i).ofLp) = _
    rw [hA.mulVec_eigenvectorBasis]
    rfl
  have hnorm (i : V) : ‖hA.eigenvectorBasis i‖ = (1 : Real) :=
    hA.eigenvectorBasis.orthonormal.1 i
  simp only [U, LinearMap.comp_apply, heig, map_smul, inner_smul_right,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hsum
  simp_rw [hnorm] at hsum
  simp at hsum
  simpa [pow_two] using hsum

name: SRGInequality.trace_square_eigenvalue_identity
statement:
lemma trace_square_eigenvalue_identity
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    (k : Real) ^ 2 + (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 +
      (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
        restrictedNeg k lambda mu ^ 2 = (v : Real) * k
proof:
:= by
  have hall := adjacencyEigenvalue_eq_degree_or_restricted_of_ne_complete G h hne
  have hsq := sum_sq_eq_weighted_three_fibers (adjacencyEigenvalues G)
    (restrictedPos_ne_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne)
    (restrictedNeg_ne_degree_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne)
    (restrictedPos_ne_restrictedNeg_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne) hall
  have htrace := hermitian_trace_sq_eq_sum_eigenvalue_sq
    (A := G.adjMatrix Real) (G.isHermitian_adjMatrix Real)
  have hmat := trace_adjMatrix_sq G h
  have hsum : (∑ i, (adjacencyEigenvalues G i) ^ 2) = (v : Real) * k := by
    calc
      (∑ i, (adjacencyEigenvalues G i) ^ 2) =
          (G.adjMatrix Real * G.adjMatrix Real).trace := htrace.symm
      _ = (v : Real) * k := hmat
  rw [hsq] at hsum
  have hcardk := degree_eigenMultiplicity_eq_one G h hc
  have hcardk' : Fintype.card {i : V // adjacencyEigenvalues G i = (k : Real)} = 1 := by
    simpa [eigenMultiplicity] using hcardk
  rw [hcardk'] at hsum
  simpa [positiveMultiplicity, negativeMultiplicity, eigenMultiplicity,
    mul_comm, add_assoc] using hsum

name: SRGInequality.srg_spectral_relations
statement:
lemma srg_spectral_relations
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    (v : Real) = 1 + positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu +
        negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu ∧
      (k : Real) + (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
          restrictedPos k lambda mu +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
          restrictedNeg k lambda mu = 0 ∧
      (k : Real) ^ 2 + (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
          restrictedPos k lambda mu ^ 2 +
        (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) *
          restrictedNeg k lambda mu ^ 2 = (v : Real) * k ∧
      restrictedPos k lambda mu + restrictedNeg k lambda mu =
        (lambda : Real) - mu ∧
      restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu =
        (mu : Real) - k
proof:
:= by
  have hpart := multiplicity_partition G h hc hne
  have htrace := trace_eigenvalue_identity G h hc hne
  have htrace2 := trace_square_eigenvalue_identity G h hc hne
  have hsum := restricted_sum k lambda mu
  have hprod := restricted_product_of_nonneg
    (spectral_discriminant_nonneg_of_ne_complete G h hne)
  exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hpart, htrace, htrace2, hsum, hprod⟩

name: SRGInequality.degree_eq_mu_sub_restricted_product
statement:
lemma degree_eq_mu_sub_restricted_product
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (_hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    (k : Real) = (mu : Real) -
      restrictedPos k lambda mu * restrictedNeg k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hprod := restricted_product_of_nonneg
    (spectral_discriminant_nonneg_of_ne_complete G h hne)
  linarith

name: SRGInequality.degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t
statement:
lemma degree_eq_mu_add_restrictedPos_mul_t
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    (k : Real) = (mu : Real) + restrictedPos k lambda mu *
      (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmain := degree_eq_mu_sub_restricted_product G h hc hne
  ring_nf at hmain ⊢
  exact hmain

name: SRGInequality.multiplicity_numerator_identity
statement:
lemma multiplicity_numerator_identity
    {v k mu f g r t : Real}
    (hpart : v = 1 + f + g)
    (htrace : k + f * r - g * t = 0)
    (htrace2 : k ^ 2 + f * r ^ 2 + g * t ^ 2 = v * k)
    (hk : k = r * t + mu) :
    f * mu * (r + t) = k * (t - 1) * (k + t)
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination
    -t * htrace2 - k * t * hpart - (t ^ 2 - k) * htrace -
      f * (r + t) * hk

name: SRGInequality.srg_multiplicity_numerator_identity
statement:
lemma srg_multiplicity_numerator_identity
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) * (mu : Real) *
        (restrictedPos k lambda mu - restrictedNeg k lambda mu) =
      (k : Real) * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu - 1) *
        ((k : Real) - restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := srg_spectral_relations G h hc hne
  rcases hs with ⟨hpart, htrace, htrace2, hsum, hprod⟩
  have hk := degree_eq_mu_sub_restricted_product G h hc hne
  apply multiplicity_numerator_identity
    (v := (v : Real)) (k := (k : Real)) (mu := (mu : Real))
    (f := (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real))
    (g := (negativeMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real))
    (r := restrictedPos k lambda mu)
    (t := -restrictedNeg k lambda mu)
  · exact_mod_cast hpart
  · nlinarith [htrace]
  · nlinarith [htrace2]
  · nlinarith [hk]

name: SRGInequality.krein_substitution
statement:
lemma krein_substitution
    {k mu r t : Real} (hk : k = r * t + mu) :
    ((r + 1) * (k + r - 2 * r * t) ≤ (k + r) * (t - 1) ^ 2) ↔
      (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) * mu ≤ r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hk]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.KreinBound.substituted
statement:
lemma KreinBound.substituted
    {k mu r t : Real} (hK : KreinBound k r t)
    (hk : k = r * t + mu) :
    (r + 2 * t - t ^ 2) * mu ≤ r * (t - 1) * (t ^ 2 + r)
proof:
:= by
  exact (krein_substitution hk).mp hK

name: SRGInequality.multiplicity_formula_of_numerator
statement:
lemma multiplicity_formula_of_numerator
    {k mu f r t : Real}
    (hnum : f * mu * (r + t) = k * (t - 1) * (k + t))
    (hmu : 0 < mu) (hrt : 0 < r + t) :
    f = k * (t - 1) * (k + t) / (mu * (r + t))
proof:
:= by
  field_simp
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete
statement:
lemma restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    0 < restrictedPos k lambda mu - restrictedNeg k lambda mu
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hd := spectral_discriminant_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  have hs : 0 < Real.sqrt (((lambda : Real) - mu) ^ 2 +
      4 * ((k : Real) - mu)) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hd
  simp [restrictedPos, restrictedNeg, spectralDelta]
  nlinarith

name: SRGInequality.srg_multiplicity_formula
statement:
lemma srg_multiplicity_formula
    (h : G.IsSRGWith v k lambda mu) (hc : G.Connected) (hne : G ≠ ⊤) :
    (positiveMultiplicity G k lambda mu : Real) =
      (k : Real) * (-restrictedNeg k lambda mu - 1) *
        ((k : Real) - restrictedNeg k lambda mu) /
      ((mu : Real) * (restrictedPos k lambda mu - restrictedNeg k lambda mu))
proof:
:= by
  apply multiplicity_formula_of_numerator
    (srg_multiplicity_numerator_identity G h hc hne)
  · exact_mod_cast mu_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne
  · exact restricted_gap_pos_of_connected_ne_complete G h hc hne

name: SRGInequality.target_equiv_core
statement:
lemma target_equiv_core
    {v k f g r t : Real}
    (hpart : v = 1 + f + g)
    (htrace2 : k ^ 2 + f * r ^ 2 + g * t ^ 2 = v * k) :
    (v * k ≤ g * (v - g) * t ^ 2) ↔
      (k ^ 2 + f * r ^ 2 ≤ f * g * t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hpart]
  have htrace2' := htrace2
  rw [hpart] at htrace2'
  constructor <;> intro h <;> nlinarith [htrace2']

name: SRGInequality.target_division_equiv
statement:
lemma target_division_equiv
    {v k g s : Real} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    (v * k / s ^ 2 ≤ g * (v - g)) ↔
      v * k ≤ g * (v - g) * s ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : 0 < s ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_ne_zero hs
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hsq]

name: SRGInequality.target_of_absolute_gap_eq_zero_standalone
statement:
theorem target_of_absolute_gap_eq_zero_standalone
    {t k f g v : Real} (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hv : v = f + g + 1)
    (hgap : t ^ 2 * g * (f + 1) - v * k = 0) :
    v * k / t ^ 2 = g * (v - g)
proof:
:= by
  have hvg : v - g = f + 1 := by linarith [hv]
  have ht2 : t ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 ht
  rw [hvg]
  field_simp [ht2]
  nlinarith [hgap]
